An online delivery option exists alongside the standard on-campus version, structured around 40-hour placement weeks and compulsory on-campus intensives at the City or Bedford Park campus for the skills components that can't be done remotely - simulated clinical scenarios, practical assessment, that kind of thing. That hybrid model has become more common in nursing education generally, but Flinders' version is fairly explicit about which parts stay in-person.

Registration as a nurse in Australia runs through the Nursing and Midwifery Board, and the degree is built to satisfy that board's accreditation standard rather than being a general health science degree with a nursing label - the placement hours and clinical competency assessments are non-negotiable structural features, not optional enrichment.
curriculum:
Year 1: foundations of nursing practice, anatomy and physiology, health assessment, introductory clinical placement block
Year 2: medical-surgical nursing, mental health nursing, pharmacology, clinical placements in hospital and community settings
Year 3: complex care nursing, aged care and chronic disease management, final clinical placement blocks
Total clinical placement across the degree: 800 hours minimum, guaranteed within South Australia
Online delivery option available with compulsory on-campus intensives at City or Bedford Park campus
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent, plus health/immunisation checks and (for clinical placements) police check (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 overall, no band below 7.0 (typical registration-body bar for nursing/health programs, approximate)

name: Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics
description: The Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics at Flinders University prepares graduates to become accredited practising dietitians. The program combines nutrition and dietetics coursework with around 110 days of professional placements across clinical, community and food service settings, taught at Bedford Park and the City campus. Entry requires an IELTS overall score of 7.0. Graduates work as dietitians in hospitals, community health, food industry and private practice. Indicative international tuition is around 40,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 121095D.

name: Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics 3.5 years
description: This is the three-and-a-half-year full-time pathway to the Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics at Flinders University, which prepares graduates to become accredited practising dietitians. Students complete around 110 days of professional placements across clinical, community and food service settings and learn alongside students from other health disciplines in an interprofessional model. The program is backed by 50 years of nutrition and dietetics education at Flinders. Graduates work as dietitians in hospitals, community health, food industry and private practice. Indicative international tuition is around 61,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 121095D.

name: Bachelor of Nutrition Science - Exit Only
Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours) at Flinders University prepares graduates to register and practise as occupational therapists. The program combines coursework in occupational therapy practice, health and human development with substantial clinical placements across metropolitan and regional South Australia, and includes a research component. Entry requires an IELTS overall score of 7.0. Graduates work as occupational therapists across hospital, community, disability, mental health and paediatric settings. Indicative international tuition is around 54,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 121093F.

name: Bachelor of Occupational Therapy 3.5 Years
description: This is the three-and-a-half-year full-time pathway to the Bachelor of Occupational Therapy at Flinders University, which prepares graduates to register and practise as occupational therapists. Students begin in a shared first-semester allied health model alongside other health disciplines before progressing into occupational therapy study, and complete substantial clinical placements. Graduates work as occupational therapists across hospital, community, disability, mental health and paediatric settings. Indicative international tuition is around 61,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 121093F.

name: Bachelor of Paramedicine
description: The Bachelor of Paramedicine at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree that prepares graduates to register and practise as paramedics. Taught at the Bedford Park campus, the program combines coursework in clinical practice, physiology and emergency care with hands-on skills training and clinical placement. Entry is competitive and requires an IELTS overall score of 7.0. Graduates work as registered paramedics in ambulance services and related emergency and retrieval settings. Indicative international tuition is around 39,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111908K.

name: Bachelor of Performance
description: The Bachelor of Performance at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree taught at the Bedford Park campus, with specialist streams in acting, directing and theatre-making. Entry involves an audition or interview and a portfolio. Students develop craft through studio training and production work, building a body of practical performance experience. Graduates work across theatre, screen and live performance as performers, directors and theatre makers. Indicative international tuition is around 33,400 Australian dollars per year.

name: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Physiotherapy (Honours) at Flinders University prepares graduates to assess, treat and prevent injury and movement disorders and to register as physiotherapists. The program combines coursework in physiotherapy practice, anatomy and physiology with substantial hands-on clinical placements, taught at Bedford Park and the City campus. Entry requires an IELTS overall score of 7.0. Graduates work as physiotherapists across hospital, community, sports and private practice settings. Indicative international tuition is around 54,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 121087D.

name: Bachelor of Psychological Science
description: The Bachelor of Psychological Science at Flinders University is a three-year full-time APAC-accredited degree that builds a strong foundation in psychological theory, research and practice. It prepares students for a fourth year of psychology study or for careers in mental health, counselling, research, human resources, marketing and related fields. Graduates who continue can progress toward registration as psychologists. Indicative international tuition is around 35,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 077358M.

name: Bachelor of Psychological Studies (Graduate Entry)
description: The Bachelor of Psychological Studies (Graduate Entry) at Flinders University is a one-year full-time program that gives graduates of any discipline a nationally accredited psychology major. Students develop knowledge of psychological theory and research and the factors that influence behaviour, and can use the qualification to progress to further study in psychology. Graduates work in areas such as youth work, marketing, policy and research, human resources, program coordination and welfare. Indicative international tuition is around 33,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 085908G.

name: Bachelor of Psychology (Honours)
description:
For psychology students, the fourth honours year is the hinge point of an entire career pathway - it's the year that has to be APAC-accredited for graduates to have any shot at professional registration later, and admission into it is competitive, ranked on second- and third-year psychology grades from an already-accredited three-year sequence. Flinders' honours year combines advanced coursework with a substantial research thesis under individual supervision, which is a different rhythm from the coursework-heavy undergraduate years that precede it.

What the year actually leads to matters more than what's inside it: this isn't a terminal qualification for most students, but a bridge into Flinders' own Master of Professional Psychology or Master of Clinical Psychology, or equivalent postgraduate programs elsewhere, on the way to psychologist registration with the Psychology Board of Australia. Students who complete the honours year but don't continue to a registration-track masters still come away with a research-intensive qualification that reads well for policy, HR or research assistant roles.

Because entry is competitive rather than automatic, the honours year functions as a genuine filter within the psychology pipeline - not everyone who wants to become a registered psychologist gets a place, which is worth knowing going in rather than discovering after three years of undergraduate study.
curriculum:
Semester 1: advanced research methods and statistics, seminars in selected psychology specialisations, thesis proposal development
Semester 1-2: major research thesis under individual academic supervision, presented and examined at year's end
Semester 2: advanced coursework in areas such as clinical psychology foundations, cognitive and behavioural science, or organisational psychology
Entry requires completion of an APAC-accredited 3-year undergraduate psychology sequence; selection based on second- and third-year grades
Leads to further study (Master of Professional or Clinical Psychology) toward registration as a psychologist
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 70-85 for competitive entry (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Public Health
description: The Bachelor of Public Health at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree that prepares graduates to improve population health through health promotion, policy and research. Students learn from public health academics and gain hands-on experience, with pathways into research, health promotion and policy. Demand for public health professionals is growing across government, non-profit and private sectors. Graduates work in health promotion, policy, program coordination and research roles. Indicative international tuition is around 31,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 102949J.

name: Bachelor of Public Health (Honours) 1 year
description: The Bachelor of Public Health (Honours) at Flinders University is a one-year full-time research program for high-achieving students who have completed a bachelor degree in public health, medical science or a related health field. Students complete an independent thesis in a specialised area of public health under expert supervision, present their findings and develop the high-level research skills needed for public health leadership and further study. Students work across leading research themes addressing current and emerging health challenges with access to modern laboratories and facilities. Indicative international tuition is around 41,400 Australian dollars per year.

name: Bachelor of Science (Marine Biology)
description:
This is a degree built around getting students out of the classroom and into the water early and often - reef monitoring, wildlife surveys and field data collection are treated as core skills rather than optional add-ons. Flinders runs local field trips across South Australia's coastline alongside international research trips (South Africa has been a recent destination) and offers scientific diving courses in Palau, which is an unusual level of overseas fieldwork access for an undergraduate marine biology program.

Coursework moves from broad ecology and biodiversity foundations into specific upper-level units like Marine Mammals, Birds and Reptiles, Fisheries Biology, Science and Management, and Restoration Ecology, culminating in a dedicated Research Project in Marine Science. The specialisation runs three years full-time within the broader Bachelor of Science structure, so students graduate with both the general science degree credential and a clearly labelled marine biology specialisation.

Climate change, conservation and fisheries management run through the curriculum as recurring themes rather than a single unit, reflecting where a lot of marine biology employment actually sits now - government environment departments, fisheries management bodies and conservation NGOs as much as pure research roles.
curriculum:
Year 1: foundational biology, chemistry, and earth/environmental science units shared across Bachelor of Science
Year 2: marine and freshwater biology, ecology, introductory biodiversity and conservation units
Year 3: BIOL3701 Restoration Ecology, BIOL3702 Marine and Freshwater Biology, BIOL3751 Marine Mammals, Birds and Reptiles, BIOL3752 Fisheries Biology, Science and Management
Year 3 (continued): BIOL3800 Research Project in Marine Science - independent research project
Field components: South Australian coastal field trips, international research trips, scientific diving training (Palau)
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 65-75 (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Social Work (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Social Work (Honours) at Flinders University is a four-year full-time degree for students who want to work toward justice, equality and community impact. It gives students the skills to support individuals, families and communities facing complex challenges such as poverty and family violence, with a strong focus on real-world placement experience and critical thinking. Graduates are eligible for professional recognition and work as social workers across community, health, child protection and policy settings. The course holds CRICOS registration 083453F.

name: Bachelor of Speech Pathology
description: The Bachelor of Speech Pathology at Flinders University is a full-time pre-registration degree that prepares graduates to assess, diagnose and manage communication and swallowing disorders across the lifespan. Students learn in a contemporary allied health environment alongside other health disciplines, building interprofessional and culturally responsive practice skills, and complete substantial clinical placements. The program is backed by more than 50 years of speech pathology education at Flinders. Graduates work as speech pathologists across health, education, disability and private practice settings. Indicative international tuition is around 41,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 121092G.

name: Bachelor of Speech Pathology 3.5 years
description: This is the three-and-a-half-year full-time pathway to the Bachelor of Speech Pathology at Flinders University, which prepares graduates to register and practise as speech pathologists. Students build skills to assess, diagnose and manage communication and swallowing disorders across the lifespan, learning alongside other allied health students and completing clinical placements. The program is backed by more than 50 years of speech pathology education at Flinders. Graduates work across health, education, disability and private practice settings. Indicative international tuition is around 61,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 121092G.

name: Bachelor of Speech, Language and Hearing Science - Exit Only
Bachelor of Sport and Active Recreation
description: The Bachelor of Sport and Active Recreation at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree focused on the role of sport and active recreation in health, wellbeing and community connection. Students tailor their studies with majors in sport coaching and development, outdoor education or sports business, with a minor option in strength and conditioning, and build experience through placements in coaching, management, outdoor adventure and community programs. Graduates work in coaching, sport administration, event management and outdoor education. Indicative international tuition is around 34,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 113275M.

name: Bachelor of Sport, Health and Physical Activity
Bachelor of Tourism and Events
description: The Bachelor of Tourism and Events at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree, delivered as an event management and tourism major within the Bachelor of Business. Students study how creativity and business come together across sustainable tourism development, destination marketing, and event design and management, with flexible study options and industry connections. Graduates work in event planning, destination marketing, sustainable tourism and large-scale event management. Indicative international tuition is around 31,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 058294B.

name: Bachelor of Tourism and Events Management
description: The Bachelor of Tourism and Events Management at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree, delivered as an event management and tourism major within the Bachelor of Business. Students learn to design memorable experiences, promote destinations and manage large-scale events, covering sustainable tourism development, destination marketing and event management, with industry connections built into the program. Graduates work in event planning, destination marketing and tourism roles. Indicative international tuition is around 33,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 058294B.

name: Bachelor of Urban and Regional Planning
description: The Bachelor of Urban and Regional Planning at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree, described by the university as Australia's first three-year accredited planning degree, with accreditation pending Planning Institute of Australia approval. Students learn to develop and implement plans and policies for urban and rural land use, weigh economic, environmental and social factors, and work with government, architects and other specialists to design public spaces and conserve heritage. Graduates can enter a planning career on graduation. The course holds CRICOS registration 117650E.

name: Bachelor of Visual Effects and Entertainment Design
description: The Bachelor of Visual Effects and Entertainment Design at Flinders University is a three-year full-time degree delivered in partnership with CDW Studios, with streams in 2D, 3D, animation and visual effects. Students are taught by instructors with industry experience across major film and game projects and have access to a multipurpose production stage on campus. Graduates work in film, television, gaming, animation and digital design. Indicative international tuition is around 37,300 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119230J.

name: Diploma in Business
description: The Diploma in Business at Flinders University is a one-year full-time program that builds industry-relevant skills across accounting, marketing, human resources, economics and strategy. It provides a flexible pathway into second-year entry of a range of business bachelor degrees, with specialisation options in areas such as marketing, management, human resource management and sports management. Graduates use it to enter further study or to start business support roles across retail, finance, government, technology and tourism. Indicative international tuition is around 30,500 Australian dollars per year.

name: Diploma in Health
description: The Diploma in Health at Flinders University is a one-year full-time program that provides foundational knowledge and skills for a career in health, with flexible online study options. It is designed as a short introductory qualification and a pathway into further health study. Graduates use it to enter health support roles across varied care settings or to continue into a bachelor degree. Indicative international tuition is around 33,000 Australian dollars per year.

name: Doctor of Medicine
description:
Flinders compresses what's traditionally a six-year medical education into four years of graduate-entry study, which is the single fact that shapes almost everything else about the program. Students already hold a prior degree, so the MD moves fast: the first two years are based at the Adelaide campus building the biomedical science foundation, and years three and four put students into clinical rotations across metropolitan Adelaide and rural South Australia.

The university's South Australian Rural Medicine (SARM) stream is worth calling out specifically, since it's not just a placement option but a genuinely different pathway - students live and study in the Riverland or Mount Gambier region for years one and two, then continue clinical training somewhere in the Hills Mallee Fleurieu, Barossa Valley, Riverland or Greater Green Triangle areas. Flinders has leaned into rural medical training longer than most Australian medical schools, and this pipeline is a large part of why.

Across both the standard and rural pathways, the course is explicit about pairing biomedical science with the social determinants of health - it's not purely a hospital-medicine curriculum. Graduates sit the same national licensing pathway as any other Australian medical graduate, so the compressed timeline doesn't mean a lighter qualification, just a more intensive one for people who've already done a first degree.
curriculum:
Year 1: biomedical and clinical sciences foundations, clinical skills training, Adelaide-based (or SARM regional site for the rural stream)
Year 2: continued biomedical sciences integrated with early clinical exposure, population and Indigenous health, Adelaide or regional SARM site
Year 3: clinical rotations across core specialties - medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynaecology, psychiatry, general practice - Adelaide or rural South Australia placements
Year 4: advanced clinical rotations, elective placement, transition-to-practice preparation, rural or metropolitan sites depending on stream
Graduate entry only; SARM stream requires residence in Riverland, Mount Gambier or Greater Green Triangle regions for years 1-2
admission_requirements: Completed bachelor's degree, GAMSAT score, and interview (approximate, typical bar for graduate-entry medicine)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Doctor of Philosophy (Mathematics/Statistics)
description: The Doctor of Philosophy (Mathematics and Statistics) at Flinders University is a research-based higher degree, typically four years full-time, in which candidates undertake an original program of research under expert supervision within the computing, information technology and mathematical sciences discipline. Candidates produce a substantial thesis and develop advanced research, analysis and communication skills. Graduates pursue careers in academic and industry research, data science and analytics leadership. Indicative international tuition is around 39,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 106272F.

name: Graduate Certificate in Archaeology
description: The Graduate Certificate in Archaeology at Flinders University is a six-month full-time entry point into the university's archaeology and heritage management program, which serves graduates with an interest in Australian archaeology, archaeological field practice and cultural heritage consultancy. Students build theoretical knowledge, research skills and applied field skills across related specialisations, and can continue into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Archaeology and Heritage Management. Graduates work in heritage consultancy, government and community organisations. Indicative international tuition is around 34,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 059113D.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business Administration
description: The Graduate Certificate in Business Administration at Flinders University is a six-month full-time qualification for professionals who want to move into leadership, operations or strategy roles. Students build practical capability in leadership, problem solving and organisational strategy, covering how organisational systems work from supply chains to staffing and budgets. It is designed as a standalone credential and as a direct pathway into the Flinders MBA, with credit carried forward. Graduates step into management, operations and strategy roles across a wide range of industries, or continue into the Graduate Diploma or Master of Business Administration. Indicative international tuition is around 37,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107693K.

name: Graduate Certificate in Clinical Rehabilitation
description: The Graduate Certificate in Clinical Rehabilitation at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program for health professionals from any allied health, medical or nursing background who want to strengthen their knowledge and skills in clinical rehabilitation. It is the entry point to a stackable set of qualifications, with students who complete the Graduate Certificate guaranteed entry into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Clinical Rehabilitation. The course develops evidence-based practice in assessment, goal setting and rehabilitation across a range of conditions and care settings. Graduates apply these skills in hospital, community and private rehabilitation services. Indicative international tuition is around 37,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 055067D.

name: Graduate Certificate in Counselling (Behavioural Health)
description: The Graduate Certificate in Counselling (Behavioural Health) at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program and the entry point to an articulated set of counselling qualifications. Students build knowledge and skills in evidence-based therapeutic approaches sought in health care, not-for-profit, private practice and education settings, and can continue into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Counselling (Behavioural Health). Graduates work as counsellors supporting individuals, families and communities. Indicative international tuition is around 39,300 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111882D.

name: Graduate Certificate in Disability Policy and Leadership
description: The Graduate Certificate in Disability Policy and Leadership at Flinders University is a six-month full-time course for senior practitioners and managers working in disability and human services. It builds the knowledge and skills to lead and sustain positive change in disability practice, policy and workforce development. Students examine contemporary disability policy, service design and leadership, connecting national reform directions with day-to-day professional practice. Graduates use the qualification to move into policy, service leadership and workforce development roles, and it can be credited toward further postgraduate study in disability practice and leadership at Flinders. Indicative international tuition is around 39,300 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111469F.

name: Graduate Certificate in Disability Practice
description: The Graduate Certificate in Disability Practice at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program that builds specialised skills to work alongside people with disability, their families and advocates to promote wellbeing and inclusion. It suits professionals in allied health, education, community and human services, and articulates into further postgraduate study in disability practice and leadership. Graduates apply the qualification across disability, health and community service roles. Indicative international tuition is around 39,300 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111470B.

name: Graduate Certificate in Geospatial Information Systems
description: The Graduate Certificate in Geospatial Information Systems at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program and, according to the university, the only postgraduate GIS stream available in South Australia. It blends science, computer science, data analytics, geography and cartography, giving students theoretical and practical grounding in spatial data capture and analysis for applications from environmental conservation to city planning. It articulates into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Geospatial Information Systems. Graduates work as GIS analysts across government, environment and planning. Indicative international tuition is around 35,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 110620A.

name: Graduate Certificate in Health Promotion
description: The Graduate Certificate in Health Promotion at Flinders University is a six-month full-time qualification that builds the skills to apply public health principles in practice, reduce health inequalities and promote better health outcomes. It suits professionals from health, community and policy backgrounds who want a focused grounding in health promotion planning, program design and evaluation. Entry normally requires a bachelor degree or relevant professional experience, and the course credits toward the Flinders Master of Public Health. Graduates work in health promotion, community health and policy roles. Indicative international tuition is around 37,500 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Certificate in International Relations
description: The Graduate Certificate in International Relations at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program and the entry point to the Master of International Relations. Students build a foundation in the dynamics that shape contemporary international relations and the core skills required by managers and analysts working in foreign affairs, international trade, defence and security. The certificate credits toward the Graduate Diploma and Master of International Relations. Graduates work in government, diplomacy and international organisations. Indicative international tuition is around 33,000 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Certificate in Leading Mental Health and Wellbeing (Workplace and Community)
description: The Graduate Certificate in Leading Mental Health and Wellbeing (Workplace and Community) at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program that builds the capacity of leaders, staff and volunteers to enact evidence-based mental health and wellbeing practice. Rather than focusing on clinical treatment, it covers promoting wellbeing, supporting people experiencing difficulty, and designing mentally healthy workplaces and communities. Graduates lead wellbeing initiatives in organisational and community settings. Indicative international tuition is around 35,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 113437J.

name: Graduate Certificate in Media and Communication
description: The Graduate Certificate in Media and Communication at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program and the entry point to the Master of Media and Communication, designed for creative practitioners, journalists, entrepreneurs and other professionals. Students learn the intricacies of communication in a digital world and how disruptive technologies such as artificial intelligence are reshaping the field, and can continue into the Graduate Diploma and Master. Graduates work in communications, content, journalism and digital media roles. Indicative international tuition is around 34,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119370H.

name: Graduate Certificate in Older Adult Care and Wellbeing
description: The Graduate Certificate in Older Adult Care and Wellbeing at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program for healthcare professionals and caregivers who want to develop specialised skills in promoting the health and wellbeing of older adults. It covers ageing, health assessment and policy application, equipping graduates to optimise care and advocate for older adults across diverse settings. Graduates strengthen aged care and older adult health roles. Indicative international tuition is around 37,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 113747F.

name: Graduate Certificate in Palliative Care
description: The Graduate Certificate in Palliative and End-of-Life Care at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program taught by a group with a long international record in palliative care education. It develops the knowledge and skills to provide high-quality end-of-life care across hospital, hospice and community settings, covering symptom management, communication and coordinated care. Entry requires a bachelor degree in a listed health discipline plus at least one year of relevant health sector experience, and the course articulates into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Palliative and End-of-Life Care. Graduates strengthen palliative care practice in their existing health roles. Indicative international tuition is around 37,500 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Certificate in Project Management
description: The Graduate Certificate in Project Management at Flinders University is a short postgraduate qualification, completed in around six months full-time, that prepares students to plan, lead and deliver projects across industries. It covers core project management knowledge including scope, scheduling, risk, stakeholder engagement and project delivery. Entry is open to applicants with a bachelor degree, one year of relevant work experience or two years of unrelated work experience, and the course can be credited toward the Graduate Diploma and Master of Project Management. Graduates work as project coordinators and project managers in construction, IT, government, health and consulting. Indicative international tuition is around 32,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119406A.

name: Graduate Certificate in Public Administration

name: Graduate Certificate in Public Health

Graduates apply public health thinking in health services, government and community organisations. Indicative international tuition is around 34,200 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Certificate in Public Policy

name: Graduate Certificate in Research Methods

Graduates use the qualification as a pathway into masters and doctoral research. Indicative international tuition is around 30,000 Australian dollars per year.

Graduates work in water management, environmental consulting and government. Indicative international tuition is around 38,000 Australian dollars per year. name: Graduate Certificate in Social Impact

Graduates lead social impact initiatives and programs across purpose-driven organisations. Indicative international tuition is around 37,600 Australian dollars per year. name: Graduate Certificate in Society and the Individual
description: The Graduate Certificate in Society and the Individual at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program for graduates of any discipline who want to work in the Australian human services and welfare sectors or move toward becoming an accredited social worker. It brings together sociology, anthropology, social theory, history, economics and political science to build the knowledge needed to understand and work with people in context, and provides a pathway into the Master of Social Work (Graduate Entry). Graduates work in community services, welfare and human services roles. Indicative international tuition is around 34,200 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Certificate in Sustainable Development
description: The Graduate Certificate in Sustainable Development at Flinders University is a six-month full-time program, described by the university as South Australia's only postgraduate degree in sustainable development. Students build the knowledge, skills and tools to address sustainability challenges, working through real questions on how human activity has shaped the world and what is needed to secure a sustainable future. It articulates into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Sustainable Development. Graduates work in sustainability, policy and environmental roles. Indicative international tuition is around 35,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111240E.

name: Graduate Certificate in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL)

It combines theory with teaching methodology to prepare students for classroom practice, and can be studied on campus, online or in a mix of the two. It articulates into the Graduate Diploma and Master. Graduates teach English in Australia and internationally. Indicative international tuition is around 34,200 Australian dollars per year. name: Graduate Certificate in Teaching Studies

Students develop academic skills for postgraduate study while gaining an introduction to the Australian curriculum, professional standards, teacher registration requirements and the teaching profession. Graduates progress into an initial teacher education masters. Indicative international tuition is around 38,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119310J.

name: Graduate Certificate in Virtual Production

name: Graduate Diploma in Archaeology and Heritage Management

name: Graduate Diploma in Data Science

name: Master of Business Administration
description:
Up to 36 weeks of work-integrated learning across the two-year program is a lot for an MBA, and it signals what Flinders is actually trying to produce - not just credentialed managers but graduates who've spent real time embedded with industry partners. Specialisations run across Business Analytics, Marketing, Healthcare Management, Human Resource Management, Finance, International Business and Social Impact, letting students steer the generalist MBA core toward a specific sector or function.

One distinctive strand is the industry-focused entrepreneurial stream tied to Flinders' advanced manufacturing and Industry 4.0 capabilities, aimed at students working on small-to-medium enterprise problems using the university's own prototyping and manufacturing research infrastructure - a fairly unusual pairing for a business school MBA to have direct access to. Delivery is flexible: on-campus in the Adelaide CBD, blended online/on-campus, and part-time options for people continuing to work.

Healthcare Management as a named specialisation is worth flagging given Flinders' strong health sciences and medical faculty presence - it gives the MBA a genuine connection to the university's clinical and health services expertise rather than being a generic add-on specialisation borrowed from a template.
curriculum:
Year 1, Semester 1: core units - accounting for managers, economics for business, organisational behaviour, marketing management
Year 1, Semester 2: core units continued - strategic management, business analytics foundations, corporate finance
Year 2: specialisation units (choice of Business Analytics, Marketing, Healthcare Management, HR Management, Finance, International Business, or Social Impact)
Year 2: work-integrated learning / industry project component (up to 36 weeks across the program)
Delivery: on-campus (Adelaide CBD), blended, or part-time options available
admission_requirements: Relevant bachelor's degree (or equivalent); some programs consider work experience in lieu (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

Master of Computer Science
description:
Flinders built this degree around the idea that computer science is now a broad enough field that a good master's should let students choose their own weighting between theory and application. You'll pull topics from computer science, information technology, digital media, software engineering and mathematics, so two graduates can come out with genuinely different skill sets depending on whether they leaned toward robotics, intelligent systems, or software engineering practice.

Accreditation from the Australian Computer Society at the professional level matters here because Flinders' course is also recognised through the Seoul Accord, which means the qualification carries weight for skilled migration and professional registration well beyond South Australia. That international recognition is a bigger deal for this degree than it sounds on paper, since a large share of the cohort is international students planning a career move to Australia or elsewhere.

The final two semesters shift from coursework to a supervised masters project, and Flinders explicitly frames it as a chance to dig into an advanced niche - robotics, video game technology, or biomedical computing among them - under a named supervisor rather than a generic capstone brief. For someone who already has an undergraduate degree in an unrelated field, the first year is where the real foundational catch-up happens; for those with a CS background already, it's more of an accelerant into a specialisation.
curriculum:
Year 1, Semester 1: foundations in programming and data structures, discrete mathematics for computing, computer systems
Year 1, Semester 2: database systems, software engineering principles, choice of an elective stream (AI, networks, or digital media)
Year 2, Semester 1: advanced electives drawn from robotics, intelligent and interactive systems, or systems engineering
Year 2, Semester 2: masters project (part 1) plus specialised electives such as heuristic optimisation or advanced software engineering
Final semester: masters project (part 2) - independent supervised research or applied development in an area such as robotics, biomedical computing or game technology
72 units total, full accreditation from the Australian Computer Society at the professional level
admission_requirements: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in computer science, information technology, ICT-based engineering, or a closely related discipline (or hold the Graduate Diploma in Computer Science); assumed knowledge of at least second-year undergraduate computer science.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (Flinders postgraduate standard).

name: Master of Digital Communications
description: The Master of Digital Communications at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree built for a fast-changing digital communication field. Students learn the intricacies of communication in a digital world, how to adapt as new platforms emerge, and how disruptive technologies such as blockchain and artificial intelligence are reshaping the field. It suits journalists, entrepreneurs, creative practitioners and communication professionals. Graduates work in digital communications, content strategy, public relations and media roles. Indicative international tuition is around 38,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119370H.

name: Master of Disability Practice and Leadership (Developmental Education)
description: The Master of Disability Practice and Leadership (Developmental Education) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that prepares senior practitioners to work as developmental educators, allied health professionals who support people with disability, their families and advocates. Students gain work-relevant knowledge and leadership skills they can apply across disability, health and human services, with policy and practice content shaped by the National Disability Insurance Scheme. Graduates work as developmental educators and in disability leadership roles. Indicative international tuition is around 40,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111471A.

name: Master of Disability Practice and Leadership [1.5 years]
description: The Master of Disability Practice and Leadership at Flinders University, in its shorter pathway of around eighteen months full-time, enhances the leadership capability of senior practitioners and managers working in a disability field shaped by the National Disability Insurance Scheme. Students can choose specialist study options including policy and trauma-responsive practice. Graduates lead across disability policy, practice and workforce development. Indicative international tuition is around 39,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111468G.

name: Master of Disability Practice and Leadership [2 years]
description: The Master of Disability Practice and Leadership at Flinders University, in its two-year full-time pathway, delivers advanced knowledge and skills and builds leadership capability for a disability field shaped by the National Disability Insurance Scheme. Students choose from specialist study options including policy and trauma-responsive practice. Graduates move into senior roles across disability policy, practice and workforce development. Indicative international tuition is around 40,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111468G.

name: Master of Education
description: The Master of Education at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree for practising education professionals who want to advance their career, specialise in an area of interest and contribute to the future teaching workforce. It extends knowledge and skills across a range of workplace contexts and prepares graduates to meet growing demand for educator professional development. Students personalise the program around their goals and sharpen their research and analytical skills across educational policy and practice, choosing breadth or a specialised focus. It can be studied online or in person. Indicative international tuition is around 33,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 002648K.

name: Master of Education [1.5 years]
description: This is the shorter pathway to the Master of Education at Flinders University, taken over around eighteen months full-time by education professionals who hold relevant prior qualifications or experience. Students extend their knowledge and skills across a range of workplace contexts, personalise the program around their goals, and sharpen research and analytical skills in educational policy and practice. It can be studied online or in person. Graduates move into specialist and leadership roles in education. Indicative international tuition is around 34,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 002648K.

name: Master of Engineering (Mechanical)
description: The Master of Engineering (Mechanical) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree for graduates with a background in mechanical engineering or a related field who want to extend their expertise. It offers advanced topics across solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, design and manufacturing, materials and control, and can be entered through the Graduate Diploma. Graduates work in mechanical engineering design, analysis and project roles across industry. Indicative international tuition is around 40,400 Australian dollars per year.

name: Master of Engineering Management
description: Flinders University Master of Engineering Management is a two-year, 72-unit program from the College of Science and Engineering that balances business and management study with design and engineering study. First year covers human resource management, marketing strategy, decision making, accounting and engineering project management alongside engineering design, design communication and systems engineering; second year adds commercial law, supply chains and operations, manufacturing design and sustainability in engineering, plus electives such as managing negotiations, waste management and Industry 4.0 and a major capstone project. Entry requires a bachelor degree or equivalent, a Flinders graduate certificate or diploma in engineering management, or a TAFE diploma plus at least three years of engineering experience. Indicative international tuition is around A$40,400 per year. Graduates oversee engineering teams and projects across construction, manufacturing, energy, defence acquisition and large-scale software.

name: Master of Engineering Science (Specialisations)
description: The Master of Engineering Science (Specialisations) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that gives students a comprehensive understanding of the natural, physical, material and mathematical theories underpinning engineering, along with skills to investigate, plan, design, manufacture and maintain engineering systems. Students choose a specialisation, and the degree can be taken as a standalone qualification or as a pathway into Flinders' accredited Master of Engineering degrees. Graduates work in engineering-related technical and analytical roles. Indicative international tuition is around 40,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 114861G.

name: Master of Environmental Health
description: The Master of Environmental Health at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree covering how the physical, biological, chemical and social environment affects health, including water, food, air, buildings and waste. It provides professional qualifications to enter or advance careers in environmental health, a branch of public health concerned with the natural and built environment. Graduates work as environmental health officers and in public and environmental health roles across government and industry. Indicative international tuition is around 38,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 080526G.

name: Master of Environmental Management and Sustainability
description: The Master of Environmental Management and Sustainability at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that combines the social sciences and humanities with physical geography, earth sciences and biology to build the breadth expected of environmental managers. It focuses on environmental policy, strategy and management systems and the development of sustainable practice in urban and non-urban environments. Graduates work in environmental management, sustainability and policy roles across government, industry and consulting. Indicative international tuition is around 37,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107182M.

name: Master of Forensic Science
description: The Master of Forensic Science at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree for students with a science background who want to specialise in forensic and analytical science. The program covers how chemical and biological techniques are used in forensic investigations, and how to produce scientific, objective findings that stand up in an investigation. Students complete coursework addressing current concerns in industry and society alongside a masters thesis. Graduates are prepared for employment in forensic laboratories and agencies, or for enrolment in a research higher degree. Indicative international tuition is around 40,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111207F.

name: Master of Geospatial Information Systems
description: The Master of Geospatial Information Systems at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree, part of what the university describes as the only postgraduate GIS stream in South Australia. It blends science, computer science, data analytics, geography and cartography, giving students theoretical and practical grounding in capturing and analysing spatial data for applications from environmental conservation to city planning. Graduates work as GIS analysts and spatial scientists across government, environment, planning and defence. Indicative international tuition is around 36,300 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 110620A.

name: Master of Health Administration
description: The Master of Health Administration at Flinders University, in its shorter pathway of around eighteen months full-time, prepares professionals to manage healthcare systems and shape health policy. Students learn to navigate health systems, apply digital health technologies and use practical management strategies across leadership, financial management, ethics, policy, quality and safety, for the evolving demands of health and aged care. Graduates work in health service management and policy roles. Indicative international tuition is around 38,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 023592C.

name: Master of Health Administration [2 years]
description: The Master of Health Administration at Flinders University, in its two-year full-time pathway, prepares professionals to manage healthcare systems and shape health policy. Students learn to navigate health systems, apply digital health technologies and use practical management strategies across leadership, financial management, ethics, policy, quality and safety. Graduates work in health service management, policy and quality roles across health and aged care. Indicative international tuition is around 42,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 023592C.

name: Master of Health and Clinical Research
description: The Master of Health and Clinical Research at Flinders University is an 18-month full-time higher degree by research pathway for professionals in any health field. It combines advanced coursework topics with a supervised, time-based research project that culminates in an externally examined thesis, giving graduates specialised knowledge and skills in research methods. The program is a recognised pathway into PhD study. Graduates strengthen careers in government, private and corporate consulting, academia and research institutions. Indicative international tuition is around 37,500 Australian dollars per year.

name: Master of Health Management and Leadership 1.5 years
description: The Master of Health Management and Leadership at Flinders University, in its shorter pathway of around eighteen months full-time, is built around the university's MBA (Healthcare Management) specialisation. Students study core business principles with a healthcare focus and sustainability embedded across topics, preparing to apply contemporary management concepts in health and aged care settings. Graduates move into leadership roles in health and aged care organisations. Indicative international tuition is around 47,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107691A.

name: Master of Health Management and Leadership 2 years
description: The Master of Health Management and Leadership at Flinders University, in its two-year full-time pathway, is built around the university's MBA (Healthcare Management) specialisation. Students study core business principles with a healthcare focus and sustainability embedded across topics, developing the capability to lead and improve performance in health and aged care organisations. Graduates take on management and leadership roles across the health sector. Indicative international tuition is around 47,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107691A.

name: Master of Inclusive and Specialised Education
description: The Master of Inclusive and Specialised Education at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree for education professionals who want to lead in inclusive and specialised education and advocate for children and young people with additional needs. Students can study a range of minors to develop expertise across areas such as disability, learning difficulties and gifted education, or build their own program from a broad selection of topics. The course develops the analytical, ethical, problem-solving and research skills needed to evaluate provisions and practices for learners with special needs. Graduates work as specialist teachers, coordinators and leaders in schools and education systems. Indicative international tuition is around 33,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 105117C.

name: Master of Inclusive and Specialised Education [1.5 years]
description: This is the shorter pathway to the Master of Inclusive and Specialised Education at Flinders University, taken over around eighteen months full-time by education professionals with relevant prior qualifications. It promotes the educational entitlement of all learners, particularly those with disability, learning difficulties or intellectual giftedness. Students choose minors to build expertise across areas of inclusive and specialised education or design their own program. Graduates work as specialist teachers and education leaders. Indicative international tuition is around 34,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 105117C.

name: Master of Information Technology (Network and Cybersecurity Systems)
description: The Master of Information Technology (Network and Cybersecurity Systems) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time coursework degree for graduates with an IT or computer science background who want to specialise in enterprise networks and cybersecurity. It provides advanced study of the techniques needed to design, develop, secure and manage an organisation's networked information systems. Graduates work as network and security engineers, security analysts and systems architects. Indicative international tuition is around 36,300 Australian dollars per year.

name: Master of International Relations
description: The Master of International Relations at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree covering the dynamics that shape contemporary international relations, including the political and security landscapes of the Asia-Pacific and beyond. Students develop the core skills required by managers and analysts working in foreign affairs, international trade, defence, and national and international security. The program builds critical analysis, research and public speaking skills, and connects theory with current policy practice. Graduates work in government, diplomacy, international organisations, security and trade. Indicative international tuition is around 33,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 045233M.

name: Master of Laws (Research)
description: The Master of Laws (Research) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time research degree in which students undertake independent research on an area of law of their choice under supervision. It develops advanced research, critical thinking, legal writing, communication and project management skills within a research community that spans established and emerging areas of legal scholarship. Graduates pursue careers in legal practice, policy, academia and research. Indicative international tuition is around 33,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 020070J.

name: Master of Leadership in Education [1.5 years]
Master of Maritime Archaeology
description: The Master of Maritime Archaeology at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree, described by the university as the leading named degree of its kind in Australia. Students learn practical maritime and underwater archaeology skills in the classroom and through field schools led by internationally recognised experts, using digital technology including 3D recording, marine geophysics and conservation across topics from historic shipwrecks to submerged landscapes. Graduates work in maritime heritage, cultural resource management and research. Indicative international tuition is around 35,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 046437B.

name: Master of Media and Communication (2 years)
description: The Master of Media and Communication at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree designed for creative practitioners, journalists, entrepreneurs and other professionals working in a fast-growing field. Students learn the intricacies of communication in a digital world and how to adapt as new technologies and platforms emerge, examining the implications of digital disruption and technologies such as artificial intelligence. Graduates work in communications, content, journalism and digital media roles. Indicative international tuition is around 35,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119370H.

name: Master of Nursing (Acute Care)
description: The Master of Nursing (Acute Care) at Flinders University is a program of around eighteen months full-time for registered nurses who want advanced skills in caring for acutely and critically ill patients. It covers nursing across environments including emergency, intensive care and paediatric settings, and sits within an articulated set of postgraduate nursing qualifications. Graduates take on advanced clinical and specialist roles in acute care. Indicative international tuition is around 34,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 113748E.

name: Master of Nutrition and Dietetics
description: The Master of Nutrition and Dietetics at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that prepares graduates for professional practice as dietitians. Students undertake advanced study of nutrition science, the pathophysiology of nutrition-related illness, health promotion and communication, alongside clinical, food service and community and public health nutrition placements. Graduates are eligible for accreditation and work across hospitals, community health, food industry and private practice. Indicative international tuition is around 42,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 002655M.

name: Master of Occupational Therapy
description: The Master of Occupational Therapy at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that prepares graduates for professional practice as occupational therapists. The program combines coursework with substantial clinical placements across public health, non-government and private settings, and is accredited by the Occupational Therapy Council of Australia and approved by the Occupational Therapy Board of Australia. Graduates are eligible to apply for registration and work across hospital, community, disability, mental health and paediatric settings. Indicative international tuition is around 41,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 090620D.

name: Master of Palliative Care
description: The Master of Palliative Care at Flinders University is a flexible program of around eighteen months full-time for health professionals who want to deepen their expertise in palliative and end-of-life care. Taught by an interdisciplinary team, it develops specialised knowledge and advanced skills to deliver compassionate, evidence-based care for people and families facing life-limiting illness, while allowing students to balance work and study. Graduates take on advanced and leadership roles in palliative care. Indicative international tuition is around 38,000 Australian dollars per year.

name: Master of Physiotherapy
description: The Master of Physiotherapy at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that prepares graduates to register and practise as physiotherapists. Physiotherapists work with people across the lifespan to develop, maintain and restore movement and functional ability. The program has a strong clinical focus, with teaching largely embedded in clinical settings across South Australia and close links to healthcare providers, and prepares students to work effectively in metropolitan, rural and remote locations. Graduates are eligible for registration and practise across hospital, community and private settings. Indicative international tuition is around 46,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 079421D.

name: Master of Professional Psychology
description: The Master of Professional Psychology at Flinders University is a one-year full-time fifth-year qualification accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council. It provides the theoretical knowledge, research training and practical skills needed to prepare for professional practice with diverse populations, and forms part of the five-plus-one pathway to general registration as a psychologist, followed by a one-year supervised internship. Graduates progress toward general psychology registration. Indicative international tuition is around 37,500 Australian dollars per year.

name: Master of Project Management - 1 year
description: The Master of Project Management at Flinders University, in its fast-tracked one-year full-time option, prepares professionals to lead strategic, high-value projects across sectors. Students develop advanced capability in governance, stakeholder engagement and complex project delivery, combining theory with real-world application. Graduates move into senior project and program management roles. Indicative international tuition is around 44,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119404C.

name: Master of Project Management - 2 years
description: The Master of Project Management at Flinders University, in its two-year full-time pathway, prepares professionals to lead strategic, high-value projects across diverse sectors. Students develop advanced capability in governance, stakeholder engagement and complex project delivery, combining theory with practical application, and strengthen leadership and analytical skills. Graduates move into senior project and program management roles that drive innovation and organisational change. Indicative international tuition is around 45,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 119404C.

name: Master of Psychology (Clinical)
description: The Master of Psychology (Clinical) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree for psychology honours graduates who want to qualify as registered psychologists. It provides theoretical knowledge, research training and supervised clinical skills across both adult and child domains, preparing students for professional work in community mental health, hospitals and health care facilities, community welfare and correctional settings. Graduates are eligible for registration as psychologists and are qualified to work across a range of mental health settings. Indicative international tuition is around 39,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 051844M.

name: Master of Public Administration
description: The Master of Public Administration at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that builds the core skills required to manage the business of government, not-for-profit and international organisations. Students study governance in a global context, digital strategy and sustainable development, and tailor the degree with electives toward their career goals. Graduates work in public sector management, policy and administration roles. Indicative international tuition is around 33,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107771A.

name: Master of Public Health
description: The Master of Public Health at Flinders University builds advanced skills to improve health outcomes, influence policy and create healthier communities locally and globally. It takes a multidisciplinary approach across epidemiology, health promotion, health systems and policy. The two-year pathway is open to graduates of any discipline, while a shorter 1.5-year pathway is available to applicants with a health-related degree or a degree plus two years of relevant work experience. Graduates work in public health units, government, non-government organisations and research. Indicative international tuition is around 35,000 Australian dollars per year.

name: Master of Public Health 1.5 years
description: This is the shorter pathway to the Master of Public Health at Flinders University, taken over around eighteen months full-time by applicants with a health-related degree or a degree plus two years of relevant work experience. Grounded in equity, inclusiveness and prevention, it builds advanced skills to improve health outcomes, influence policy and create healthier communities locally and globally. Graduates work in public health units, government, non-government organisations and research. Indicative international tuition is around 30,000 Australian dollars per year.

name: Master of Public Policy
description: The Master of Public Policy at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that prepares policy analysts and managers to work across the whole policy cycle, from analysing the problem and interpreting data to undertaking professional research and developing policy. It takes a multidisciplinary perspective on the global, national and local levels of a fast-changing policy environment. Students tailor the degree to their goals with electives from public administration, international relations or across the university. Graduates work as policy officers, analysts and managers in government, agencies and consulting. Indicative international tuition is around 33,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 053050G.

name: Master of Science (Groundwater Hydrology)
description: The Master of Science (Groundwater Hydrology) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree for scientists, engineers and environmental professionals who need groundwater expertise. It provides an industry-focused understanding of hydrological processes and the interrelationships between groundwater, surface water and vegetation, taught by a program with a strong reputation in the field. Graduates work in water resource management, environmental consulting and government. Indicative international tuition is around 38,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 047375C.

name: Master of Science Mathematics/Statistics)
description: The Master of Science (Mathematics and Statistics) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree for students with a mathematics or statistics background, or first-year university mathematics such as a maths major within a science or engineering degree. It builds on existing mathematical, statistical and research skills and adds knowledge of the wider social, economic and environmental impact of the field along with professional and ethical responsibilities. Graduates work in data science, analytics, research and modelling roles. Indicative international tuition is around 37,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 083454E.

name: Master of Screen and Media Production
Master of Social Work
description:
Two placements, 500 hours each, four days a week for roughly 18 to 20 weeks apiece - that's the structural spine of Flinders' graduate-entry social work degree, and it's worth stating plainly because the placement load is what distinguishes a professional social work qualification from an adjacent human services degree. Students attend Monday to Thursday during placement blocks, which effectively means putting paid work or other commitments on hold for those stretches.

Coursework runs alongside and before the placements, covering practice with diverse populations, work with children and families in complex situations, mental health across the life course, and trauma and resilience - areas chosen to map onto where Flinders' placement partners in South Australia actually operate, from statutory child protection to community mental health services.

At 72 units across two years full-time (or four years part-time), this is the graduate-entry pathway for people who already hold a bachelor's degree in an unrelated field and want the professional social work qualification without repeating an undergraduate degree. The professional registration outcome - eligibility for Australian Association of Social Workers membership - is the whole point of the structure being this placement-heavy.
curriculum:
Year 1, Semester 1: foundations of social work practice, human behaviour and the social environment, social policy
Year 1, Semester 2: social work with diverse populations, complexities in work with children and families
Year 2, Semester 1: first field placement (500 hours, four days/week, approx. 18-20 weeks) plus mental health through the life course
Year 2, Semester 2: second field placement (500 hours) plus trauma and resilience, integrated practice seminar
72 units total; two supervised placements are required for AASW-eligible registration
admission_requirements: Relevant bachelor's degree (or equivalent); some programs consider work experience in lieu (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Master of Speech Pathology
description: The Master of Speech Pathology at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that prepares graduates to practise as speech pathologists, providing services for people across the lifespan whose functioning is affected by communication and swallowing disorders. The coursework program develops competent, reflective and innovative practitioners through hands-on learning and clinical practice. Graduates work across health, education, disability and private practice settings. Indicative international tuition is around 46,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 054304D.

name: Master of Sustainable Development
description: The Master of Sustainable Development at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree, described by the university as South Australia's only postgraduate degree in sustainable development. Students build the knowledge, skills and tools to address sustainability challenges through applied study of real problems in areas such as human impact on the environment and pathways to a sustainable future. Graduates work in sustainability, environmental management and policy roles. Indicative international tuition is around 36,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 111240E.

name: Master of Teaching (Early Childhood)
description: The Master of Teaching (Early Childhood) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time initial teacher education degree that prepares graduates to teach children from birth to eight years. Students develop a detailed understanding of curriculum studies and theories of education, and undertake supervised teaching practice in settings such as childcare centres, kindergartens, preschools and the early primary years. Graduates enter the profession qualified to work across early childhood and early primary education. Indicative international tuition is around 33,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 063695J.

name: Master of Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL)
description: The Master of Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree that develops disciplinary knowledge in second language acquisition and methods for teaching English to speakers of other languages. It combines theory with teaching methodology to equip students for classroom practice, and can be studied on campus, online or in a mix of the two. Graduates teach English in Australia and internationally, in schools, universities and language colleges. Indicative international tuition is around 35,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 053051F.

name: Master of Virtual Production
description: The Master of Virtual Production at Flinders University is a two-year full-time degree, described by the university as one of the first of its kind in Australia. It covers virtual production, motion capture, virtual reality and visual effects, where physical and digital worlds meet through game engine technology, taught by practising specialists with international industry links in Flinders' purpose-built motion capture studio. Graduates work in screen, games and immersive media production. Indicative international tuition is around 35,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 109406F.

name: Master of Virtual Production [1 year]
description: This is the one-year full-time option of the Master of Virtual Production at Flinders University, described by the university as one of the first of its kind in Australia. It covers virtual production, motion capture, virtual reality and visual effects, taught by practising specialists with international industry links in Flinders' purpose-built motion capture studio. Graduates work in screen, games and immersive media production. Indicative international tuition is around 34,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 109406F.

name: Master of Wellbeing and Positive Mental Health in Education
Master of Wellbeing and Positive Mental Health in Education [1.5 years]
PhD (Geography and Population Studies)
description: The PhD (Geography and Population Studies) at Flinders University is a research doctorate, typically four years full-time, in which candidates pursue an advanced supervised research project on the cultural, social and political forces shaping the contemporary world, within the history, archaeology, geography and Indigenous studies discipline. Candidates produce a substantial thesis and build advanced analytical and communication skills valued across many careers. Graduates work in academic and applied research, policy and government. Indicative international tuition is around 34,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 106282D.

name: Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management
description:
The advanced diploma builds directly on Greenwich's Diploma of Hospitality Management, moving from shift-level operations into venue-level strategy: financial performance across a whole property, workforce planning, and strategic marketing and business planning for a hospitality operation rather than a single department.

Students typically arrive at this qualification either having completed Greenwich's standard hospitality diploma or with several years of unaccredited hospitality supervisory experience they want formally recognised. The strategic-planning units mean assessment shifts from the more operational, task-based work of the standard diploma toward business-planning documents and analysis.

It carries the strongest credit-transfer weighting among Greenwich's hospitality qualifications, letting graduates enter a partner university hospitality or business degree with a substantial head start, or move directly into venue or operations management roles.
curriculum:
Core units: Develop and Implement Business Plans, Manage Physical Assets, Manage Finance Within a Budget, Roster Staff, Manage Operational Plans, Lead and Manage People
Electives: Manage Ethical Business Practices, Manage Business Risk, Develop and Manage Marketing Strategies
Capstone: venue-level business plan or strategic management project
