Pathway: credit toward advanced-standing entry into a partner university hospitality or business degree
admission_requirements: Diploma of Hospitality Management or equivalent industry experience
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Advanced Diploma of Information Technology
description:
This advanced diploma runs deeper than a first-year IT unit, covering network design, systems analysis, database design and project-based development work, and it's positioned specifically for students who want maximum credit transfer into a partner university's IT or computer science degree. Greenwich markets the advanced diploma route as the fastest legitimate way to reach second- or third-year standing in an IT bachelor's.

Because the field moves fast, Greenwich updates elective offerings between intakes to track current employer demand: cloud fundamentals and cybersecurity basics have become more prominent additions to the elective pool in recent years, alongside the more constant core of networking and database work.

Graduates either move directly into junior technical support, network administration or junior developer roles, or continue into a partner university IT degree with substantial advanced standing already banked.
curriculum:
Core units: Design Database Solutions, Design and Implement a Server Infrastructure, Automate Processes for Business Requirements, Design Enterprise Wireless Local Area Networks, Manage Data in the Database
Electives: Manage Network Security, Cloud Computing Fundamentals, Develop Advanced Web Applications
Capstone: applied systems or network design project
Pathway: credit toward second- or third-year entry into a partner university IT or computer science degree
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Advanced Diploma of Leadership and Management
description:
The advanced diploma sits a level above Greenwich's standard leadership and management diploma and assumes students either already hold that diploma or bring equivalent supervisory experience: the coursework moves quickly into strategic-level tasks (leading organisational change, strategic planning, developing workplace policy) rather than repeating first-line management basics.

Because it's pitched at people already functioning in, or close to, a team-leader role, Greenwich runs a fair amount of the assessment around each student's own workplace or a detailed case organisation, so two students in the same cohort can end up producing quite different portfolios depending on the industry they're aiming at.

The advanced diploma carries the strongest credit weighting of Greenwich's business-adjacent qualifications, and students most often use it to enter directly into the second or third year of a partner university's business or management degree, or to move straight into a team leader or supervisor role without continuing to a bachelor's at all.
curriculum:
Core units: Lead Strategic Planning Processes, Develop Organisational Systems, Lead and Manage Organisational Change, Manage Strategic Financial Resources, Undertake Strategic Workforce Planning
Electives: Manage Innovation and Continuous Improvement, Manage Business Risk, Manage Business Operational Plans
Capstone: workplace-based (or case-organisation) strategic management portfolio
Pathway: credit toward second- or third-year entry into a partner university business or management degree
admission_requirements: Diploma of Leadership and Management or equivalent industry experience
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Business
description:
Greenwich College's Diploma of Business is a nationally recognised VET qualification, not a taste of a university degree: the assessment is built around workplace tasks (drafting a business plan, running a budget, writing up a risk register) rather than essays, which suits students who learn better by producing something usable than by writing about theory. Most students enrol specifically because it converts into credit toward a partner university's business degree, shaving up to a year off a bachelor's when the pathway is followed through.

Class sizes at Greenwich's Sydney CBD campus are kept small by design, and a large share of the cohort is international students building English proficiency and local business fluency alongside the qualification itself. Group projects and presentations get more classroom time here than they typically would in a standard first-year university subject, which is deliberate scaffolding rather than a lighter workload.

Graduates either step straight into junior business, admin or coordinator roles or, more commonly, use the diploma's credit points to enter the second year of a partner university's Bachelor of Business.
curriculum:
Core units: Develop and Use Emotional Intelligence, Communicate in the Workplace, Undertake Project Work, Apply Business Risk Management Processes, Plan and Manage Budgets and Financial Plans, Contribute to Organisational Development
Electives: Marketing Principles, Human Resources Fundamentals, Workplace Health and Safety Processes (elective selection varies by intake)
Assessment: workplace-style tasks (business plans, budgets, case studies) rather than exams
Pathway: credit toward second-year entry into a partner university Bachelor of Business on successful completion
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent, or Certificate IV in Business
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Community Services (Case Management)
description:
This is the more vocationally distinct qualification in Greenwich's diploma suite. It trains students directly in case management practice: needs assessment, care planning, working within legal and ethical frameworks, and coordinating services across the community sector rather than general business or management skills.

Given the sensitivity of the work, assessment leans heavily on scenario-based tasks and reflective practice, and the coursework spends real time on the legal and ethical obligations of case workers (duty of care, confidentiality, mandatory reporting contexts) rather than treating those as a single compliance module.

Students typically use this diploma either as a direct entry credential into community services, disability support or case-work roles, or as credit toward a partner university degree in social work, human services or community welfare. That latter pathway usually requires the student to complete additional units at the university end given how tightly regulated social work degrees are.
curriculum:
Core units: Undertake Case Management, Facilitate the Empowerment of People Receiving Services, Provide Loss and Grief Support, Work Legally and Ethically, Manage Legal and Ethical Compliance, Analyse Impacts of Sociological Factors, Work with Diverse People
Electives: Support Community Participation and Social Inclusion, Coordinate Complex Case Requirements
Assessment: scenario-based case studies, reflective practice tasks, placement-linked activities
Pathway: credit toward partner university community services, human services or social work degrees (subject to individual university credit assessment)
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care
Diploma of Hospitality Management
description:
Greenwich runs this diploma with a genuine operations focus: rostering, cost control, service standards, compliance with liquor and food safety regulation, rather than treating hospitality as a soft add-on to a general business diploma. Sydney's hospitality and tourism sector gives students easy access to real venues for site visits and guest speakers, which the college leans on more than a college in a smaller city could.

Assessment mixes practical skills demonstration with the more conventional written case-study work found in other diplomas, since supervising a shift and managing a budget aren't skills that can be assessed purely on paper. International students make up a large share of this cohort, and the qualification doubles as an entry credential into the hospitality workforce for students not planning to continue into a degree at all.

On successful completion, students can use the diploma for credit into a partner university hospitality or business degree, or move directly into supervisory hospitality roles: duty manager, front office supervisor, functions coordinator.
curriculum:
Core units: Manage Finances Within a Budget, Roster Staff, Monitor Work Operations, Ensure a Safe Workplace, Manage Conflict, Develop and Implement Marketing Strategies, Coordinate Marketing Activities
Electives: Manage Physical Assets, Plan and Monitor In-House Food and Beverage Service, Coordinate Cost-Effective Services
Practical component: rostering, service and compliance tasks assessed via demonstration and workplace scenarios
Pathway: credit toward partner university hospitality or business degree entry
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Leadership and Management
description:
This sits a level below Greenwich's Advanced Diploma of Leadership and Management and is aimed at students moving into a first management or team-leader role rather than those already operating at a senior level. The units cover the basics of leading a team, managing workplace relationships, and building operational plans rather than organisation-wide strategy.

It's one of Greenwich's more flexible diplomas in terms of who enrols: recent graduates aiming at their first supervisory job sit in the same classes as mid-career professionals from overseas whose existing management experience isn't formally recognised in Australia and who need a local, AQF-recognised credential to have that experience taken seriously by Australian employers.

Successful completion carries credit into a partner university business or management degree, typically at second-year entry, and graduates commonly step into team leader, supervisor or coordinator roles.
curriculum:
Core units: Lead and Manage Effective Workplace Relationships, Lead and Manage Team Effectiveness, Communicate Effectively as a Workplace Leader, Establish Networks, Develop and Use Emotional Intelligence
Electives: Manage Operational Plans, Manage Recruitment and Onboarding, Manage Workplace Information Systems
Assessment: workplace scenarios, leadership portfolio, team-based projects
Pathway: credit toward second-year entry into a partner university business or management degree
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Marketing and Communication
description:
The diploma covers both traditional marketing fundamentals (market research, campaign development, brand positioning) and the digital and social media skills that most entry-level marketing roles now expect on day one. The balance is deliberate, since a purely traditional marketing curriculum would leave graduates behind on the tools most Australian marketing teams actually use.

Assessment is built around producing a genuine campaign or communications plan, usually for a real or realistic small business brief, so the portfolio students leave with has actual work samples in it rather than just a transcript. Greenwich's Sydney CBD location also gives students reasonably direct access to the agency and media scene for guest input and, less formally, networking.

Graduates use the diploma either as a direct entry point into junior marketing, communications or social media coordinator roles, or as credit toward a partner university marketing or communications degree.
curriculum:
Core units: Develop Marketing Communication Plans, Undertake Marketing Activities, Interpret Market Trends and Developments, Develop Digital and Social Media Strategies, Coordinate Marketing Activities
Electives: Manage Marketing Campaigns, Analyse Consumer Behaviour, Write Persuasive Copy
Capstone: full campaign or communications plan produced for a real or realistic business brief
Pathway: credit toward partner university marketing or communications degree entry
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Project Management
description:
This diploma teaches project management as a set of applied tools rather than a body of theory. Students work through a project life cycle end to end (scope, schedule, budget, risk, stakeholder communication, close-out) using templates and documentation styles drawn from real workplace project files rather than textbook case studies.

It's a shorter, more focused qualification than Greenwich's general business diploma, and it attracts a slightly different student: people who already have a rough sense of which industry they want to work in (construction, IT, events, government) and want the credential and the practical toolkit specifically, rather than a broad business grounding. The compact structure also makes it one of the faster diploma options on Greenwich's timetable.

Completion carries credit into partner university business or management degrees, and graduates commonly move into project coordinator or project officer roles as a stepping stone toward full project manager positions later.
curriculum:
Core units: Manage Project Scope, Manage Project Time, Manage Project Cost, Manage Project Quality, Manage Project Human Resources, Manage Project Information and Communication, Manage Project Risk, Manage Project Stakeholder Engagement
Capstone: end-to-end project management plan produced for a simulated or real project brief
Pathway: credit toward partner university business or management degree entry
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Bachelor of Acting
description: The Bachelor of Acting at Griffith University is a practical, skill-intensive boutique program offered to a small number of high-quality performers, designed around four pillars: core craft, context, repertoire and industry engagement. Students undertake intensive training in acting, voice and speech, singing, movement and dance, develop their artistic identity through ensemble work and industry-led workshops, and perform in fully staged productions with live audiences. It is delivered at Griffith's Queensland Conservatorium, one of Australia's leading music and performing arts schools, and runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Business (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Advanced Business (Honours) at Griffith University prepares students to tackle complex organisational challenges while giving them the flexibility to specialise in a business discipline such as marketing, human resources, management, international business or entrepreneurship. Students begin with a foundation year, then customise the degree to suit their career goals, and in the final years complete a thesis to demonstrate expertise and develop advanced skills for leadership roles across the public and private sectors. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for AI research and economics. It runs four years full-time in Brisbane.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Commerce (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Advanced Commerce (Honours) at Griffith University is designed for ambitious students who want to excel in accounting, finance and economics. The degree grounds students in core commercial concepts then builds advanced analytical, technical and professional skills that employers demand. Griffith Business School is among the top one percent of business schools worldwide accredited by both AACSB and EQUIS, and holds a five-star rating for learning resources in accounting, business and management. It runs four years full-time in Brisbane.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Computer Science (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Advanced Computer Science (Honours) at Griffith University is designed for future technology leaders and problem-solvers. Students gain a deep understanding of computer science theory while mastering practical skills to build intelligent systems, algorithms and data-driven solutions. Through hands-on learning, students develop technical expertise across advanced programming, AI, data science, software engineering, high-performance and distributed computing, and machine learning. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for AI research. It runs four years full-time and is offered in Brisbane, the Gold Coast and online.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Government and International Relations (Honours)
Bachelor of Advanced International Tourism and Hotel Management (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Advanced International Tourism and Hotel Management (Honours) at Griffith University prepares students to lead and innovate across the tourism, hospitality and event sectors, with in-depth business and management skills and a focus on sustainable, responsible practice. Griffith is ranked Australia's number one university for hospitality and tourism management. Students learn to lead responsibly and manage growth with environmental and social considerations, and complete an honours research component. It runs four years full-time in Brisbane.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Political Science and International Relations (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Advanced Political Science and International Relations (Honours) at Griffith University is designed for future leaders and changemakers who want to understand and influence the political and social systems that shape the world. Students explore how political systems work and why some fail, the role of diplomacy and international relations in global conflicts, how laws are made and where power lies, and how democracy can survive authoritarian challenges. The degree includes an honours research component. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for political science. It runs four years full-time in Brisbane.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Science (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Advanced Science (Honours) at Griffith University is designed for high-achieving students ready to immerse themselves in science and research from the outset, offering a research-intensive experience that develops advanced scientific skills early. Students learn through hands-on science in modern facilities and unique natural environments, supported by smaller class sizes and approachable academics, and begin their research journey with advanced studies courses in second and third year before an honours research project. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for AI research. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Animation
description: The Bachelor of Animation at Griffith University prepares students for roles in the animation and visual effects industries in Australia and abroad, with animation at Griffith ranked second in Australia and New Zealand and in the top 10 globally. Students create their own animations from concept to final render using industry-recognised software and hardware, gain hands-on production experience through projects for real clients at Griffith's commercial studio LiveLab, and collaborate with filmmakers, game designers, artists and musicians at the Queensland College of Art and Design. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Architectural Design
description: The Bachelor of Architectural Design at Griffith University is the first step toward becoming an architect, offering a clear pathway into the Master of Architecture and the academic qualifications needed for professional accreditation. Students build design and problem-solving skills while learning to balance aesthetics, function and user needs, with a focus on sustainable design and creating resilient buildings for tropical, sub-tropical and coastal environments. The degree holds five-star ratings for learner engagement and student support. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Arts
description: The Bachelor of Arts at Griffith University gives students the freedom to explore what matters to them while building skills to create change in communities, workplaces and society. Choosing from a wide range of majors including history, creative writing and sociology, students develop a deeper understanding of people, policy and cultures. The degree is built around a connected core journey with practical experience, industry engagement and career-focused learning, and develops future-focused skills employers value such as communication, critical thinking, creativity, research and problem solving. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Aviation
description:
Griffith's Bachelor of Aviation is one of the largest and most established aviation degrees in the country, and the theory-versus-flying split is worth understanding before enrolling: the university degree covers the academic side: aerodynamics, aviation law, human factors, meteorology, navigation and flight planning, plus simulator work in virtual reality rigs, while the actual flight hours toward a Commercial Pilot Licence are completed separately through a CASA-certified flight training provider, typically after or alongside the degree rather than bundled into Griffith's own tuition.

Griffith has articulation agreements with flight schools (Airways Aviation among them) so that students who've already completed CPL and instrument rating training through an approved provider can get credit recognised against the degree, which is the more common pathway for students who start flying first and formalise the academic side afterward.

The degree is delivered across trimesters, which lets motivated students compress the theory component faster than a standard two-semester-per-year structure would allow, and graduates go on to airline, freight, charter, agricultural aviation, and Australian Defence Force pilot pathways, plus non-flying aviation management and air traffic-adjacent roles for students who don't pursue a pilot licence at all.
curriculum:
Core sequence: Introduction to Aviation, Aerodynamics, Aviation Meteorology, Aviation Law and Regulation, Air Navigation, Human Factors in Aviation
Simulator-based units: Flight Simulation and Procedures (VR-based ab initio exercises)
Later trimesters: Aviation Safety Management, Airline Operations, Aircraft Systems, capstone Aviation Industry Project
Flight training toward CPL and instrument rating completed separately through a CASA-certified provider (articulation credit available for prior flight training)
Trimester structure allows accelerated completion for students taking a full course load each term
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 70-85 for competitive entry (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Aviation Management
description: The Bachelor of Aviation Management at Griffith University prepares students for leadership and management roles across airports, airlines and aviation organisations worldwide. Designed with industry experts, it covers airport planning and operations, aviation safety, security, human factors and business data analysis, giving students a solid foundation in how the aviation sector works and how to manage its challenges. In the final year, students can undertake an industry-sponsored research project in an area of aviation management. It runs two years full-time. Griffith's Bachelor of Aviation is the separate pathway to becoming a pilot.

name: Bachelor of Biomedical Science
description: The Bachelor of Biomedical Science at Griffith University develops skills and knowledge in clinical and biological sciences and how to apply them to improve the diagnosis and treatment of disease. Students at the Brisbane South (Nathan) campus follow a science-focused curriculum. From first year, students are introduced to the fields that underpin biomedical science, and in later years explore genetics, biochemistry, cell biology, anatomy, physiology, immunology, microbiology, infectious disease, pharmacology and neuroscience, with lab-based training in modern facilities. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Biomolecular Science (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Biomolecular Science (Honours) at Griffith University is an advanced program at the crossroads of the biological, chemical, physical and computational sciences, encompassing chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, genetics, genetic engineering, genomics, proteomics, structural and systems biology, and bioinformatics. It is designed to train a new generation of biomolecular scientists to meet demand for professional, workplace-ready and research-ready graduates, with applications in medicine, health care, food, agriculture, environmental protection and biotechnology. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Business
description:
The Bachelor of Business at Griffith runs on a common first-year model: everyone does the same accounting, economics, and management fundamentals regardless of which of the nine-odd majors they eventually land in, which is standard practice at AACSB-accredited business schools but still worth knowing if you're choosing between a flexible generalist degree and a narrower Bachelor of Commerce elsewhere.

What's specific to Griffith is the split campus offering: Nathan and Gold Coast both run the degree, but the Gold Coast cohort tends to skew toward majors with a tourism and events tilt, given the campus's proximity to the industry it's studying. Business students there routinely end up doing live consulting projects for Gold Coast tourism operators as assessment pieces rather than hypothetical case studies.

Griffith Business School holds AACSB accreditation, which matters mostly for students eyeing postgraduate study or international mobility later. It signals the degree meets a recognised international quality bar rather than being purely domestically calibrated. The major choices span the usual accounting/finance/marketing/management set plus less common options like sport management and international business, reflecting Queensland's actual industry mix.
curriculum:
Year 1 (common core): Principles of Accounting, Economic Principles, Introduction to Management, Marketing Fundamentals, Business Statistics, Business Law
Year 2: major-specific units begin (choose from Accounting, Finance, Marketing, Management, International Business, Human Resource Management, Tourism Management, Sport Management)
Year 2-3: Business Ethics and Sustainability, Strategic Management
Year 3: capstone Business Strategy Project, typically involving a live client brief
Minor or second major option available for students wanting broader coverage
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 65-75 (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Child, Youth and Family Practice
Bachelor of Cinematic Arts (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Cinematic Arts (Honours) at Griffith University is a fourth year of study for students who have completed a bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as game design and production, animation or film. This research-led program offers intensive study of the theoretical, technical and creative aspects of the cinematic arts, with a strong emphasis on applied research methods. Students concentrate on a specialisation within the converging fields of animation, film and screen media, and game design, and complete an original research project. It runs one year full-time at Griffith Film School.

name: Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology
description: The Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology at Griffith University trains students to become Accredited Exercise Physiologists who design and deliver safe, effective exercise programs for clients with chronic conditions, injuries or disabilities. Students gain in-depth knowledge of the human body and how exercise impacts health, combining classroom learning with clinical training and practical placements, and study alongside students from diverse clinical backgrounds to prepare for multidisciplinary team practice. Griffith holds a five-star rating for overall experience and teaching quality in sports and leisure. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Computer Science
description: The Bachelor of Computer Science at Griffith University blends deep technical knowledge with creativity, problem-solving and innovation. The degree focuses on building intelligent systems through machine learning, algorithms and advanced AI development, with AI embedded throughout so students learn not only to use AI tools but to understand how AI systems are designed, built and optimised. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for AI research. It runs three years full-time and is offered in Brisbane, the Gold Coast and online.

name: Bachelor of Construction Management (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Construction Management (Honours) at Griffith University prepares students for careers leading construction projects in residential and commercial property. Students gain expertise in building practices, construction law and ethics, business management, economics and property development in a global context, and study advanced topics such as estimating, tendering, planning and procurement using current industry tools. The honours year includes a research project tackling current challenges in construction. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Counselling
description: The Bachelor of Counselling at Griffith University provides the theoretical knowledge and practical skills to register and practise as a professional counsellor. Students learn both counselling theory and practical skills for settings from clinics to community programs, gain hands-on experience through placements, and graduate ready for registration with the Australian Register of Counsellors and Psychotherapists. Teaching follows current healthcare and mental health practice standards. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice
description:
Griffith was one of the first universities in Australia to teach criminology as its own discipline rather than a corner of sociology or law, going back to the 1970s, and the Griffith Criminology Institute that grew out of that history is still one of the largest concentrations of criminology researchers in the country. That lineage shows up in the degree: it's taught by people who publish the studies that get cited in Four Corners segments on bikie gangs or coercive control law reform, not just people teaching from a textbook.

The degree runs across Mt Gravatt and the Gold Coast and leans hard into Queensland's own criminal justice apparatus for its case material: Queensland Police recruitment pathways, the state's youth justice reforms, and reference to Royal Commission findings turn up constantly in first and second year units. Students choosing the policing or corrections electives get guest lectures from serving officers and, in some years, supervised site visits to correctional facilities.

Because Griffith treats the field as inherently cross-disciplinary, students end up doing law, psychology, and sociology units alongside the core criminology sequence. The honours-track students in particular tend to come out with a stronger empirical research skillset (survey design, crime data analysis) than a criminology graduate from a program housed purely within a law school.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Criminology, Crime, Media and Culture, Criminal Law and Procedure, Foundations of Justice, Research Methods for Social Science
Year 2: Policing in Context, Punishment and Corrections, Youth Justice, plus two electives from Forensic Psychology, Cybercrime, or Counter-Terrorism
Year 3: Crime Prevention and Analysis, Victims and Victimology, capstone Criminal Justice Project (research report on a real policy or agency problem)
Electives across years 2-3 allow specialisation in policing, corrections, or crime analysis and investigation
Optional professional placement unit with a justice-sector agency in final year
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 65-75 (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Cyber Security
description: The Bachelor of Cyber Security at Griffith University trains students to protect critical data, systems and networks across business, government and everyday life. Through practical training, real-world simulations and industry experience, students develop a deep understanding of how cyber-attacks occur and how to stop them, and learn to identify vulnerabilities, protect AI-enabled technologies and defend against emerging AI-driven threats. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for AI research. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Dental Health Science (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Dental Health Science (Honours) at Griffith University develops a strong foundation in oral health science and clinical experience with real patients. On successful completion, students are eligible for entry to the Master of Dentistry to complete their training. Students study anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology and microbiology, develop practical dental skills and clinical techniques from first year, and learn from practising educators in dedicated dental research and teaching facilities. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Dental Hygiene
description: The Bachelor of Dental Hygiene at Griffith University trains students to become registered dental hygienists providing patient-centred oral health care, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management and education for the prevention of oral diseases in patients of all ages. Students undertake practical training in specialty clinics and learn from dental specialists in periodontology, radiology, orthodontics, oral pathology, pharmacology, special needs, and public health and health promotion. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Dental Prosthetics
description: The Bachelor of Dental Prosthetics at Griffith University trains qualified dental technicians to become independent clinicians who diagnose, design, manufacture and fit removable dentures. Through coursework and supervised clinical training, students build the skills to work directly with patients and collaborate across the wider dental team, gaining experience with the latest digital tools and technologies. Graduates of Griffith's Bachelor of Oral Health in Dental Technology or Bachelor of Dental Technology are encouraged to apply and may receive credit. It is not available to those who hold or are studying a dentistry qualification, and runs one year full-time.

name: Bachelor of Dental Technology (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Dental Technology (Honours) at Griffith University equips students with the technical and creative skill to design and manufacture custom-made dental devices such as dentures, crowns, bridges and orthodontic appliances in both conventional and digital contexts. Students learn foundational health science and prosthetic principles, then advanced dental laboratory techniques, and gain experience with industry-standard CAD/CAM technology including milling and 3D printing, working with materials such as gold, porcelain and acrylic. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Design
description: The Bachelor of Design at Griffith University addresses the global need for designers who can navigate the complexities of contemporary society creatively, ethically and sustainably. The studio-first program, registered by the Design Institute of Australia, is taught in creative studio spaces at the Queensland College of Art and Design, where students work with design industry experts on real challenges, advance their critical and strategic thinking, and learn to present ideas clearly. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Digital Marketing and Analytics
description: The Bachelor of Digital Marketing and Analytics at Griffith University prepares students to work in a world where AI, automation and data-driven decision-making are reshaping how brands connect with people. Students learn to blend creativity with analytics, understand what drives consumer behaviour, and design marketing strategies that cut through in an increasingly digital world, gaining the digital marketing and analytics skills employers demand. Griffith Business School is among the top one percent worldwide accredited by both AACSB and EQUIS. It runs three years full-time and commences in 2027.

name: Bachelor of Early Childhood and Primary Education
description: The Bachelor of Early Childhood and Primary Education at Griffith University is designed to meet the demand for high-quality teachers in early childhood centres and primary schools. Students share a foundation year with the Bachelor of Primary Education and Bachelor of Secondary Education, developing insights into major trends in education before deciding which age group they want to teach, and benefit from Griffith's strong relationships with schools through supervised professional experience. The degree is pending dual accreditation with the Queensland College of Teachers and ACECQA. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
description:
Griffith's engineering degree runs out of the Gold Coast campus and is built around a project-based studio model rather than the lecture-heavy structure older engineering schools still lean on. First-year students are put into design teams building working prototypes within the first trimester, well before they'd normally see that kind of hands-on brief elsewhere.

The Gold Coast location shapes the specialisations on offer: environmental and civil engineering streams draw on the region's coastal erosion and stormwater management challenges as live case studies, and Griffith has genuine research strength in renewable energy systems that feeds into the electrical and mechanical streams. Griffith's Engineering, Architecture and Aviation group also runs a strong Industry Affiliates Program, meaning several units are co-designed with employers like Boeing Defence Australia and Queensland's water authorities.

The honours component isn't a bolt-on year. It's integrated across the degree via a progressively weighted GPA requirement, and the final-year capstone project is assessed partly by an industry panel rather than academic staff alone, which changes how students approach the write-up and the pitch.
curriculum:
Year 1: Engineering Mathematics, Engineering Mechanics, Introduction to Programming for Engineers, first design-build studio project
Year 2: stream selection (Civil, Electrical and Electronic, Mechanical, Environmental), Materials Science, Thermodynamics or Structural Analysis depending on stream
Year 3: Systems Design, Professional Practice and Ethics, industry-linked project unit
Year 4 (honours): Capstone Engineering Project assessed with an industry panel, Engineering Management, advanced stream electives
Work-integrated learning placement encouraged though not always compulsory depending on stream
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 70-85 for competitive entry (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Environmental Science
description:
Griffith's environmental science degree benefits from being taught by staff attached to the Australian Rivers Institute, which gives the program's water quality and catchment management content a research-grade edge over a more generalist environmental degree. Students doing the freshwater ecology units are frequently working with data collected by the same academics' active field research in Moreton Bay and South-East Queensland's river systems.

Field trips aren't an occasional add-on here; they're structural. Students go out to Lamington National Park, the Gold Coast hinterland, and Moreton Bay repeatedly across the degree for sampling and survey work, and the assessment load reflects that: expect field reports and data analysis assignments built on your own collected data rather than textbook datasets.

Where the degree diverges from a straight ecology or conservation biology program is its explicit policy and management strand: units on environmental impact assessment and natural resource management sit alongside the science, aimed at producing graduates who can work inside government departments or consultancies doing EIS work, not just researchers. Griffith's location gives students a front-row seat to a genuinely contested environmental policy landscape (Reef water quality, koala habitat protection, coastal development pressure) that shows up constantly in case-based assessment.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Environmental Science, Ecology, Earth Systems, Environmental Chemistry
Year 2: Freshwater Ecology, Environmental Impact Assessment, GIS and Remote Sensing, Soil and Land Management
Year 3: Conservation Biology, Natural Resource Management, Climate Science, capstone Environmental Field Research Project
Field components embedded across all three years (Moreton Bay, Lamington National Park, regional catchments)
Elective options in marine science or environmental policy depending on career direction
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 65-75 (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Exercise Science
description: The Bachelor of Exercise Science at Griffith University develops expertise in physical, biomedical and psychological sciences and the role of exercise in health maintenance and rehabilitation. Students study anatomy, physiology, psychology, biomechanics and nutrition, learn to assess human performance, and gain experience through placements in on-campus clinics or with organisations such as Swimming Australia and the Queensland Academy of Sport. Graduates are prepared for careers in sport, health, fitness and rehabilitation, or further study such as physiotherapy. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Film and Screen Media Production
description: The Bachelor of Film and Screen Media Production at Griffith University is a hands-on, production-focused degree that develops students as content creators with access to well-equipped production facilities and strong industry connections. Students learn to collaborate in teams to bring their vision to life while building a foundation in film history, practice, critical analysis and emerging technologies such as virtual production. It runs three years full-time at Griffith Film School, with ATAR-based admission from 2027.

name: Bachelor of Forensic Science
description: The Bachelor of Forensic Science at Griffith University is Queensland's only dedicated and accredited forensic science degree, designed to give students the crime scene, laboratory and investigative skills trusted by employers. Students build strong foundations in chemistry and biology before applying them to forensic contexts, learn from academics with real case experience, and connect with industry through guest lectures and professional bodies such as the Australian and New Zealand Forensic Science Society. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Game Design and Production
description: The Bachelor of Game Design and Production at Griffith University equips students with the skills to conceptualise and create games and virtual worlds for a fast-growing industry. Students work individually and in teams on projects that meet commercial standards, collaborating with multidisciplinary creatives, learn from leading designers, and gain hands-on experience working on game design projects for real clients through Griffith's commercial studio LiveLab. It runs three years full-time at the Queensland College of Art and Design.

name: Bachelor of Government and International Relations
Bachelor of Health (Honours) in Public Health
description: The Bachelor of Health (Honours) in Public Health at Griffith University provides an opportunity to undertake advanced study and supervised research work in public health within a multidisciplinary cohort. The research skills developed provide a credential for employment in the public or private sectors and preparation for entry into a higher degree by research. The multidisciplinary context, with team-teaching and shared coursework and seminars across disciplines, reflects the importance of a multidisciplinary approach to complex health problems. It runs one year full-time.

name: Bachelor of Health Science
description: The Bachelor of Health Science at Griffith University provides an understanding of the human body and the science underpinning health practice, with high flexibility through a range of majors leading to many career paths. In first year, students build a foundation in human biology including chemistry, cell biology, anatomy, physiology, genetics, microbiology, health management, nutrition and toxicology, then in later years refine skills in analysis, evaluation and communication and select a major. The degree holds five-star ratings for skills development, student support and teaching quality. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Human Services
description: The Bachelor of Human Services at Griffith University prepares students to work with individuals, families and communities to help overcome challenges in areas such as health, housing, education, employment, disability and social connection. Students build a foundation in social justice, empowerment and inclusion, study human development, communication and counselling, ethics and case management, and gain hands-on experience through placements. Career advice and support is built into the degree. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Industrial Design
description: The Bachelor of Industrial Design at Griffith University combines creativity with engineering, teaching students to turn ideas into practical products through hands-on learning in design principles and advanced manufacturing technologies. Students design products for industries including healthcare and medical technology, automotive, fashion and aerospace, and access technologies such as 3D printing, digital modelling, electronics and mechanics, building skills in both creative design and technical manufacturing. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Information Technology
description: The Bachelor of Information Technology at Griffith University develops strong technical expertise in programming, systems, networks, cyber security, data, AI and software development, alongside a major specialisation. Students develop the core IT skills employers value while building the confidence to work with intelligent technologies used across modern organisations. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for AI research. It runs three years full-time in Brisbane.

name: Bachelor of International Tourism and Hotel Management
description: The Bachelor of International Tourism and Hotel Management at Griffith University gives students a deep understanding of the tourism industry, with a focus on sustainability and responsible leadership. Students develop core business skills in financial management, leadership, marketing and strategic management, preparing them for leadership roles, and learn how to run tourism organisations responsibly using sustainable business practices. Griffith is ranked Australia's number one university for hospitality and management. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Languages and Linguistics
description: The Bachelor of Languages and Linguistics at Griffith University lets students learn another language to boost employability, unlock opportunities in a global multilingual community, and engage across cultures as an informed global citizen. Students can specialise in one or more languages including Chinese, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Modern Greek, Spanish and Russian, with some available through cross-institutional study, and study how knowledge and value are created in the world. The degree holds five-star ratings for overall experience and student support. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Laws
description:
Griffith Law School runs its LLB out of Nathan, and the thing that distinguishes it from the more traditional Queensland law schools is how early students get put in front of actual clients. The clinical legal education component, placements through Caxton Legal Centre and similar community outfits, starts well before the final year capstone that most competitor programs treat as the only "practical" component.

The degree is Priestley 11 compliant (the national list of core subjects a law degree has to cover for admission purposes), so the compulsory spine looks similar to any Australian LLB, but Griffith's elective bench leans into areas the school has built genuine research strength in: environmental and climate law, given Queensland's Reef and mining exposure, and Indigenous legal issues, an area where Griffith's law academics have had real influence on Queensland's Path to Treaty process.

Most students combine the LLB with a second degree (Business, Arts, or Criminology and Criminal Justice are common pairings at Griffith), which stretches the combined program to five years but tends to sharpen job prospects: commercial law firms recruiting out of Griffith often specifically ask about the second degree during interviews.
curriculum:
Compulsory Priestley 11 sequence: Contracts, Torts, Criminal Law, Property Law, Equity and Trusts, Constitutional Law, Administrative Law, Evidence, Civil Procedure, Company Law, Professional Responsibility
Foundation units: Legal Research and Writing, Introduction to Law and Legal Reasoning
Clinical unit: supervised placement in a community legal centre
Electives (choose from): Environmental Law, Native Title and Indigenous Legal Issues, International Law, Intellectual Property
Capstone: Legal Practice unit combining advocacy and negotiation skills assessment
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 70-85 for competitive entry (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Marine Science
description: The Bachelor of Marine Science at Griffith University is studied at the Gold Coast campus with direct access to Moreton Bay, Gold Coast waterways and Heron Island, combining research with hands-on fieldwork in iconic marine environments. Through an interdisciplinary curriculum spanning marine biology, chemistry and physical sciences, students graduate as well-rounded marine science professionals with strong industry links and opportunities to join research projects. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for marine and ocean engineering. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science
description: The Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science at Griffith University trains students to work as medical scientists conducting diagnostic tests on blood, tissue and other bodily fluids to help diagnose diseases including diabetes and cancer, and to contribute to clinical trials and healthcare innovation. Students build knowledge in chemistry, cell biology, anatomy and physiology, then specialise in laboratory science, and in the final year undertake full-time clinical placements working on real medical cases. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Medical Science
description: The Bachelor of Medical Science at Griffith University gives high-achieving school leavers the foundational knowledge and skills for success in medical school and the healthcare sector, and offers a direct pathway into the Doctor of Medicine. Students build a foundation in chemistry, biology, anatomy, physiology, microbiology, genetics and biostatistics, then advance into immunology, infectious disease, pharmacology and biochemistry connected to clinical contexts, and develop health and science communication skills. It runs two years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Midwifery (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Midwifery (Honours) at Griffith University prepares students to work across all models of midwifery practice, developing the knowledge, empathy and clinical judgement to support women, newborns and families through pregnancy, birth and postnatal care. Students learn from experienced midwives, gain extensive experience through clinical placements, and study through a mix of online learning and on-campus intensive blocks with workshops and simulations. Griffith is ranked Australia's number one university for nursing and midwifery. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Music
description:
Griffith's Bachelor of Music is taught out of the Queensland Conservatorium at South Bank, right on the river next to QPAC, and the location isn't incidental: students get placement and performance opportunities with the Queensland Symphony Orchestra and Opera Queensland that a conservatorium without that kind of civic neighbour couldn't offer as routinely.

The Con's jazz program has a genuinely strong national reputation, built up over decades and associated with figures like James Morrison who've had long-running connections to the school, and it draws students specifically for that stream rather than classical performance, which is unusual for an Australian conservatorium where classical training still tends to dominate enrolment numbers.

Students choose a principal study early, classical performance, jazz, popular music, or composition and music technology, and the degree structure from second year onward is built almost entirely around one-on-one instrumental or vocal tuition plus ensemble work, which means the timetable looks very different to a standard university degree: far fewer large lectures, far more small-group and individual contact hours, and assessment that's mostly recital and portfolio based rather than written exams.
curriculum:
Year 1: Principal Study lessons begin (Classical, Jazz, Popular Music, or Composition/Music Technology stream), Aural and Theory Skills, Ensemble Performance, Music History Survey
Year 2: continued Principal Study, stream-specific units (e.g. Jazz Improvisation, Composition Techniques, Recording and Production for the tech stream)
Year 3: Principal Study intensifies, Performance Practice, capstone Recital or portfolio-based final project
Ensemble and small-group performance requirements run throughout all three years
Elective units available in arts management or music education for students considering non-performance careers
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent, plus audition (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Musical Theatre
description: The Bachelor of Musical Theatre at Griffith University provides intensive practical training in acting, improvisation, speech, voice, singing, dance and movement, alongside music theory, aural awareness and ensemble work. Students learn different musical theatre styles and develop into versatile, authentic performers who excel both as company members and in the individual skills of singing, dancing and acting, gaining authentic performance experience in professional-standard productions. It is delivered in partnership with the Queensland performing arts sector and runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Nursing
description:
Griffith's nursing program has historically posted some of the strongest graduate satisfaction results in the national QILT surveys among Queensland providers, and the reason cited most often by students isn't the classroom teaching. It's the volume and variety of clinical placement hours across Gold Coast University Hospital, Logan Hospital, and a spread of smaller regional and private facilities.

The degree is delivered across three campuses (Nathan, Logan, Gold Coast) and each has slightly different placement partnerships baked in, so where you enrol has some bearing on what kind of clinical exposure you get in your first placement block. Griffith also runs one of the larger simulated clinical environments in the state: a mock hospital ward setup used heavily in first and second year before students are let loose on real wards.

Because Queensland's health workforce shortage has been acute in regional and mental health nursing specifically, Griffith has built electives and placement partnerships that specifically funnel students toward those areas, and a meaningful share of each graduating cohort ends up working in exactly those under-served specialties rather than general metropolitan ward nursing.
curriculum:
Year 1: Foundations of Nursing Practice, Anatomy and Physiology, Health Assessment, first clinical placement block
Year 2: Nursing Care of Adults, Mental Health Nursing, Pharmacology, Pathophysiology, extended clinical placement
Year 3: Nursing Care of Children and Families, Complex Care Nursing, Aged Care Nursing, Professional Transition to Practice
Placement hours accumulate across all three years to meet AHPRA's registration requirements (minimum mandated clinical hours)
Final trimester: capstone clinical placement and Transition to Professional Practice unit
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent, plus health/immunisation checks and (for clinical placements) police check (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 overall, no band below 7.0 (typical registration-body bar for nursing/health programs, approximate)

name: Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics
description: The Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics at Griffith University develops the knowledge and skills to work as a dietitian and improve the health of individuals and communities. Students learn through hands-on experience in purpose-built facilities including a teaching kitchen and a nutrition clinic in the Griffith Health Centre, build a foundation in anatomy, physiology and biochemistry before advanced study in human nutrition, and complete industry placements in the final phase. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Occupational Therapy
description: The Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours) at Griffith University develops the expertise to help individuals, groups and communities participate in everyday activities, whether recovering from illness or injury, adapting to disability, or overcoming exclusion. Students study human anatomy, psychology and sociology, learn practical therapy skills including rehabilitation, assistive technology and environmental modifications, and gain practical experience through diverse placements. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Paramedicine
description: The Bachelor of Paramedicine at Griffith University equips students with the skills and knowledge to work as a paramedic in traditional and non-traditional settings, developing strong clinical decision-making, problem-solving and critical thinking alongside an understanding of the human body, paramedic practice and the care of diverse conditions and trauma. A small student intake means personalised support, and simulation facilities use the same equipment as the Queensland Ambulance Service. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Pharmacology and Toxicology
description: The Bachelor of Pharmacology and Toxicology at Griffith University gives students the scientific expertise to understand how drugs and chemicals interact with the human body. Through hands-on lab work and applied projects, students build a deep understanding of pharmacology, toxicology and drug development, gaining insight into how safer and more effective treatments reach patients, and learn from experts researching drug action, chemical toxicology and precision medicine. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Pharmacy (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Pharmacy (Honours) at Griffith University puts students on the path to a career in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or nutraceutical industries, integrating the science of pharmacy with clinical practice. Students take specialist courses in areas such as pharmacy management and pharmacology, study on the Gold Coast campus within the Gold Coast Health and Knowledge Precinct across the road from the Gold Coast University Hospital, and undertake professional practice placements including opportunities for rural and international placements. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Political Science and International Relations
description: The Bachelor of Political Science and International Relations at Griffith University provides a deep understanding of policy, politics and power in the domestic and international spheres. Students learn about political movements and institutions, law making, diplomacy and global politics, and explore how democracy thrives or fails. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for political science. It runs three years full-time in Brisbane.

name: Bachelor of Primary Education
description: The Bachelor of Primary Education at Griffith University develops the knowledge and skills to teach prep to Year 6, covering humanities and social science, language development, mathematics, science and technology, health and physical education, and the arts. Students share a foundation year with Griffith's other education degrees before deciding which age group to teach, and benefit from strong relationships with schools through supervised professional experience. The degree is pending accreditation with the Queensland College of Teachers. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Psychological Science
description:
Griffith's psychological science degree is APAC accredited, meaning it satisfies the first stage of the pathway to provisional registration as a psychologist in Australia, and the school has a particular research reputation in forensic and clinical neuroscience that colours the elective offering more than at a generalist psychology department. Units in forensic psychology and offender assessment draw directly on the same Griffith Criminology Institute connections that shape the criminology degree.

The program runs at Mt Gravatt and the Gold Coast, and both campuses run a research methods sequence that's noticeably heavier on statistics than students sometimes expect walking in. Griffith treats quantitative competency as a selling point for graduates heading into either honours-track clinical psychology or non-clinical fields like market research and organisational consulting.

Because the registration pathway in Australia now requires an accredited fourth (honours) year before provisional registration, most students treat the three-year bachelor as a stepping stone rather than a terminal qualification, and Griffith's honours intake is competitive. GPA cutoffs mean a meaningful share of each cohort ends up pursuing psychology-adjacent careers (HR, research assistant roles, allied health support work) rather than continuing straight through to registration.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Psychology, Biological Psychology, Social Psychology, Research Methods and Statistics I
Year 2: Cognitive Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Abnormal Psychology, Research Methods and Statistics II
Year 3: Personality Psychology, Psychological Assessment, capstone Research Project, electives in Forensic Psychology or Health Psychology
Honours (competitive entry, separate fourth year): independent empirical thesis plus advanced coursework, required for provisional psychologist registration
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 (Australian Senior Secondary Certificate) or equivalent, ATAR approx. 65-75 (approximate, typical bar)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, no band below 6.0 (approximate, typical bar)

name: Bachelor of Psychology (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Psychology (Honours) at Griffith University gives students a thorough grounding in clinical, developmental, biological, cognitive, social and organisational psychology and research, working toward a career as a psychologist or in related health fields. Students learn to help people with personal, health, vocational and social difficulties, apply theory to topics such as motivation, stress and group behaviour, and learn to conduct and interpret psychological tests. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Public Health
description: The Bachelor of Public Health at Griffith University provides the knowledge and skills to promote health, prevent disease and create healthier environments. Students learn how social, environmental and economic factors influence health and how to design programs and policies that make a lasting difference, building understanding of major health issues including chronic disease, sexual health, nutrition and physical inactivity. Griffith is ranked first in Australia and second globally on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Quantum Electronic Engineering (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Quantum Electronic Engineering (Honours) at Griffith University is Queensland's first undergraduate quantum electronic engineering degree, designed for the fast-growing quantum technology industry. Students blend electrical engineering fundamentals with advanced quantum physics, gain skills to help solve complex problems in science and technology including using quantum computing to reduce energy needs, and benefit from industry collaborations including Griffith's partnership with PsiQuantum. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Science
description: The Bachelor of Science at Griffith University helps students think critically, solve complex problems and make discoveries, with a wide choice of majors and electives spanning the building blocks of life, protecting ecosystems, exploring the universe and developing new technologies, and the freedom to switch or combine majors. Campuses serve as living laboratories with access to bushland, waterways and marine ecosystems, and sustainability is embedded throughout. Griffith is ranked Queensland's number one university for AI research. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Secondary Education
description: The Bachelor of Secondary Education at Griffith University develops the knowledge and skills to teach students in Year 7 to 12 in chosen disciplinary areas. Students share a foundation year with Griffith's other education degrees before deciding which age group to teach, benefit from strong relationships with schools, and undertake 80 days of supervised professional experience with support from a dedicated placement officer. The degree is pending accreditation with the Queensland College of Teachers. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Social Work
description: The Bachelor of Social Work at Griffith University equips students to work with individuals, families and communities, helping people navigate complex challenges and advocating for human rights and social justice. With a foundation in ethics, human behaviour, social policy and programs, graduates are prepared to lead positive change across sectors such as mental health, child protection, aged care, disability services, homelessness and First Nations support, learning from teaching staff with deep industry expertise. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Software Engineering (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Software Engineering (Honours) at Griffith University teaches students to design and implement the software systems society depends on, beginning with a foundation in computer systems, engineering principles, mathematics and information systems. As one of the first universities in Australia to offer a software engineering degree, Griffith emphasises industry-relevant practical skills, including developing software for real clients, and in the final year students spend over half their time on work-integrated learning through industry projects. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Sport Development
description: The Bachelor of Sport Development at Griffith University builds a foundation in sport science, management, marketing, health promotion, exercise programming and coaching, with a specialist focus on community development through sport, learning to design pathways that attract, keep and support participants at all levels. Students gain skills to create and manage recreational programs and elite athlete pathways, and explore sport through physiology, biomechanics, sport psychology, sociology, policy and coaching. Griffith holds a five-star rating for teaching quality in sports and leisure. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Urban and Environmental Planning
Bachelor of Urban Planning (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Urban Planning (Honours) at Griffith University teaches students to plan and design cities that respond to population growth, housing needs, climate resilience and sustainable transport. Students develop technical, analytical and creative skills to understand the social, economic and environmental dynamics shaping urban growth, explore environmental planning, regional development, urban design and transport systems underpinned by planning policy, and gain hands-on experience through design studios, real projects and site visits. It runs four years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Visual Arts
description: The Bachelor of Visual Arts at Griffith University equips students with the historical, theoretical and practical knowledge to begin a career in the visual arts in Australia or internationally. First year covers introductory courses in painting, sculpture, performance and installation, photography, drawing and contemporary Australian Indigenous art. In second year students select a major and tailor their studies with electives such as public art, study tours and gallery internships, and by third year deepen their major, produce a major cross-disciplinary project, and exhibit their work. It runs three years full-time.

name: Doctor of Clinical Dentistry
description: Griffith's Doctor of Clinical Dentistry is a 240-credit-point degree, three years full-time, taught at the Gold Coast, for qualified dentists specialising in endodontics or periodontics. It combines rigorous clinical practice with academic coursework and research to train specialists for advanced patient care: the endodontics major covers diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the tooth pulp and surrounding tissues, and the periodontics major covers prevention, diagnosis and treatment of gum and supporting-structure disease. Entry is a bachelor degree in dentistry, current professional registration, relevant work experience and an interview, and IELTS 7.0. The degree is accredited by the Australian Dental Council. Graduates practise as registered dental specialists. Indicative international tuition is around A$77,000 per year.

name: Doctor of Education
description: The Doctor of Education at Griffith University is designed for experienced educators and professionals and combines advanced research with practical application, preparing graduates to influence practice, policy and innovation across educational settings including schools, higher education, government and community organisations. Guided by experienced supervisors, students plan and undertake a significant research project addressing contemporary educational issues, building advanced skills in problem-solving, research design and critical inquiry. It runs three years full-time.

name: Doctor of Medicine
description: Griffith's Doctor of Medicine is a 320-credit-point graduate-entry medical degree, four years full-time, with the international offering based at the Gold Coast. It uses team-based learning, clinical skills sessions and immersive placements, including a General Practice Longitudinal Program and community and in-hospital experience. Entry is a bachelor degree in any discipline with a grade point average of at least 5.0 plus the GAMSAT, with a minimum of 50 in each section, or the MCAT with 123 in each section, and IELTS 7.0. The degree is accredited by the Australian Medical Council. Graduates are eligible for limited registration and gain full registration after a two-year internship, and work in clinical practice, primary and rural care, medical administration, research and education. Indicative international tuition is around A$84,500 per year.

name: Doctor of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology
description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology at Griffith University integrates traditional PhD research training, through the preparation of a thesis, with coursework and internship training in the theory and techniques of clinical psychology. Graduates are prepared for specialist careers in clinical research settings, including universities, hospitals, research foundations and government bodies. The program is designed to meet the requirements for full registration with the Psychology Board of Australia and entry to the registrar program for area of practice endorsement in clinical psychology. Students must hold and maintain provisional or full registration as a psychologist. It runs four years full-time.

name: Doctor of Visual Arts
description: The Doctor of Visual Arts at Griffith University is a professional development degree with an integrated program of independent research and coursework that helps practising artists extend their studio research and practice and make original conceptual advances in their discipline. Students develop the expertise to provide leadership in their field, along with research skills and the ability to articulate a theoretical position within a visual arts discourse. It runs three to four years full-time at the Queensland College of Art and Design.

name: Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management
description: The Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management at Griffith University is designed for aspiring and working aviation professionals and strengthens management capability, commercial insight and operational knowledge in one of the world's most highly regulated sectors. Students develop foundational knowledge in aviation management, airport operations and industry governance, and practical skills in aviation marketing, planning and strategic decision-making, along with the use of safety science to improve safety performance in safety-critical environments. Teaching draws on industry-informed academics and guest lecturers with aviation experience. The program can be completed in six months of full-time study and provides a pathway into further postgraduate aviation study.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business
description: The Graduate Certificate in Business at Griffith University gives students a strong grounding in core business functions and the critical thinking needed to navigate complex commercial, community and government enterprises. Students gain practical insight into the challenges businesses face in a global environment, develop problem-solving and leadership skills for managing organisations, and build professional networks through connections with peers, industry professionals and lecturers. The certificate provides the foundation needed to progress into the Master of Business. It is offered in Brisbane and online.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business Administration
description: The Graduate Certificate in Business Administration at Griffith University is designed for experienced managers without an undergraduate degree, building capability across essential areas of business while preparing students to progress into the Master of Business Administration. The program is shaped by three values: responsible leadership, sustainable business practice and a global outlook. Students strengthen decision-making skills, expand their understanding of business strategy and economics, and build core skills in accounting, marketing and economics, taught through the lens of sustainable business practice and social responsibility. It can be completed in six months of full-time study.

name: Graduate Certificate in Clinical Leadership
description: The Graduate Certificate in Clinical Leadership at Griffith University covers contemporary issues and practices in healthcare leadership, quality and safety management, and implementation science. By developing management skills and an understanding of how health service organisations function, the program builds the confidence to lead transformational change in complex healthcare settings. It is designed for clinicians, health management professionals, and people working in corporate or administrative roles within health, aged and social care organisations, and provides a pathway into further postgraduate study in health service management at Griffith.

name: Graduate Certificate in Commerce
description: The Graduate Certificate in Commerce at Griffith University is designed for graduates who do not hold a commerce undergraduate degree, and for people with significant industry experience who want to change career direction or obtain a finance or professional accounting qualification. It provides a pathway into Griffith's Master of Finance or Master of Professional Accounting. Students gain technical competencies and analytical skills and learn to apply relevant theory and quantitative techniques to financial scenarios, with the program built around case studies, active learning and the integration of data analysis. It is offered in Brisbane.

name: Graduate Certificate in Design
description: The Graduate Certificate in Design at Griffith University helps designers deepen their creative practice and develop the technology, culture and business understanding needed to lead in the design industry. Students explore emerging design practice, strategy and innovation, develop expertise in experience design, visual language and advanced technologies, and build skills in visual communication, prototyping and spatial design while engaging with real design challenges and socially responsive practice. It can be completed in as little as six months of full-time study and is offered at the Queensland College of Art and Design.

name: Graduate Certificate in Financial Crime Investigation and Compliance
