Worth flagging up front: this course is being renamed Bachelor of Graphic Design from Semester 1 2026, so the current program on record reflects the last cohorts under the Communication Design name before the structural refresh. The content itself has always centred on studio learning taught by working designers rather than career academics - RMIT is explicit that all lecturers have design industry backgrounds, which shows up in how briefs get set and critiqued.

Course content spans corporate and brand identity, UX, digital convergence, print and digital publication design, packaging, and what RMIT calls "intercultural design" - working across cultural and linguistic contexts rather than assuming a single default audience. Assessment leans heavily on physical and digital artefacts - actual books, logos, packaging objects - reviewed by both academic staff and industry clients, so the critique culture mirrors what a junior designer would face in a studio job rather than a purely academic marking rubric.

Graduates go into graphic design, branding, advertising and illustration roles across consultancies as well as in-house design teams inside corporate, government and NGO settings.
curriculum:
Year 1: Design Studio - Foundations, Visual Thinking, Typography Fundamentals, Image Making
Year 2: Design Studio - Identity and Brand, User Experience Design, Digital Publication Design, Packaging Design
Year 3: Design Studio - Strategic Design, Intercultural Design, industry-client studio project, capstone portfolio
Note: course renamed Bachelor of Graphic Design from Semester 1 2026 with an updated structure
admission_requirements: ATAR plus folio/selection task submission
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0

name: Bachelor of Digital Design
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Digital Design brings creativity and technology together to design the overall experience of the technological systems people engage with every day. Students work across user interfaces and digital services, data visualisation and motion graphics, sound design and music, and 3D and immersive simulations and environments. Graduates work as digital and interaction designers, UX and UI designers, motion and 3D designers, and sound designers across technology, media and creative industries.

name: Bachelor of Education (Primary and Early Childhood Education)
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Education blends the latest educational theories with practical, hands-on experience, preparing students to teach with a choice of specialisation, including specialist primary teaching, and building globally transferable skills and knowledge. The degree includes professional placements in schools and leads to teacher registration. Graduates work as primary and early childhood teachers, with pathways into curriculum, wellbeing and leadership roles.

name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) (Civil Engineering)
description:
This is a four-year honours degree (eight years part-time) run out of RMIT's Melbourne City campus, and unlike a lot of civil engineering programs that treat sustainability as one unit among many, RMIT built environmental sustainability into the degree's core framing from the start - students are explicitly being trained to plan and manage infrastructure with that lens built in, not bolted on later.

Specialisation choices span civil infrastructure, geotechnical engineering, structures, transport and water resources, selected via electives rather than a hard major declaration, which keeps students' options open until they've actually experienced enough of each area to know what they prefer. Work-integrated learning is a real feature rather than a token requirement: students can take part in the Engineers Without Borders Challenge, sustainable design-and-build projects, industry capstones, and placements both in Australia and overseas, giving genuine variety in how the "real-world experience" requirement gets satisfied.

RMIT also foregrounds communication, teamwork and leadership skills throughout the degree and has an active push on diversity in engineering enrolment, which shows up in how project teams get formed and assessed rather than just in marketing copy.
curriculum:
Years 1-2: Engineering Mathematics, Mechanics of Solids, Fluid Mechanics, Surveying and Geospatial Science, Materials Engineering, Engineering Sustainability, Introduction to Structures
Years 3-4: electives toward chosen specialisation (Civil Infrastructure, Geotechnical, Structures, Transport, or Water Resources), Project Management, Professional Practice
Final year: Work Integrated Learning (industry placement, Engineers Without Borders Challenge, or sustainable design-and-build project), Honours capstone thesis/project
admission_requirements: ATAR ~80+ with Units 3/4 Maths Methods recommended
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0

name: Bachelor of Environmental Science
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Environmental Science develops understanding of the Earth's five systems and the ability to protect and advocate for the environment. Addressing challenges such as climate change, habitat loss, contamination and pollution, and food and water security, the degree combines knowledge and skills in chemistry, biology, statistics, research and earth sciences for an interdisciplinary approach. Graduates work in environmental consulting and assessment, conservation and land management, pollution and contamination science, and government agencies.

name: Bachelor of Fashion (Design)
description:
The fashion design degree at RMIT runs 13 core courses across three years, moving from conceptual, almost sculptural ideas about fashion in first year through to a fully resolved design project launch in the final semester. First-year units like Introduction to Fashion Design Practice deliberately don't ask students to make wearable, sellable clothes yet - the point is learning to explore and document ideas before technical constraints narrow things down.

By second year the brief tightens: students work with conventional fashion materials and construction methods and start producing genuinely transformative design work, and third year turns into presentation and industry-facing practice, culminating in a project launch that functions like a mini fashion show crossed with a thesis defence. RMIT pairs students with industry and external partners throughout, with sustainability and ethical production treated as a design constraint from day one rather than an add-on elective late in the course - which matters given how much scrutiny the fashion industry gets on exactly that front.

Graduates leave with an actual portfolio of practice and research, and RMIT produces a digital publication each year showcasing graduating cohorts to an international audience of industry scouts and press.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Fashion Design Practice, Fashion Expressions, Fashion Materials Studies, Design Drawing for Fashion
Year 2: Transform Fashion Design Materials, Fashion Communication Design, Pattern Making and Construction, Fashion Industry Contexts
Year 3: Fashion Presentation Design, Fashion Design Project Launch, professional practice and industry collaboration unit, capstone portfolio
admission_requirements: ATAR plus a selection task/portfolio submission (competitive entry)
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0

name: Bachelor of Fashion and Textiles (Sustainable Innovation)
Bachelor of Fashion Enterprise
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Fashion Enterprise examines the business of fashion across product, consumer, retail and global markets, blending creative thinking with the commercial capability to develop, source, communicate and sell products in a changing global industry. Shaped by leading academics and industry practitioners, students work on live briefs with industry partners and can undertake an internship. Graduates work in fashion buying and merchandising, brand and marketing, product development and retail management.

name: Bachelor of Fashion Enterprise and Technology (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Fashion Enterprise and Technology (Honours) at RMIT University provides advanced research skills in fashion enterprise and technology, immersing students in research-led projects. Students gain critical analytical, technical and digital skills to generate innovative and sustainable solutions to complex industry problems, and explore specialist areas in fashion enterprise, technology and textiles, customising their studies to their interests and career goals while developing sound judgement, ethical practice and sustainability principles in a global context. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and 19th in the world for art and design in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026.

name: Bachelor of Fashion Sustainability
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Fashion Sustainability has students work across digital prototyping, material innovation, circular design and sustainability strategy to create change in a sector that is ready for it. Students combine capabilities in technology and sustainability with an understanding of how fashion systems operate, developing forward-looking solutions for how clothes are made, consumed and experienced. Graduates work in sustainable fashion design and strategy, materials and supply chain innovation, and circular economy roles.

name: Bachelor of Fine Arts
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Fine Arts develops students' art practice at a world-leading contemporary art school through intensive studio workshops and personal mentoring from high-profile contemporary artists. Students take creative risks, experiment with materiality and form, and explore art's role in personal and political action, entering through one of four majors and focusing further in studio specialisations. Graduates work as practising artists, and in curatorial, education, arts administration and creative industry roles.

name: Bachelor of Food Technology and Nutrition
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Food Technology and Nutrition provides foundational knowledge of the science of manufacturing food and making it safe and nutritious, with advanced skills in manufacturing and packaging, quality assurance, entrepreneurship, community nutrition and education. Students learn to develop novel, healthy and functional food products that meet consumer demand and comply with safety and health guidelines, with the opportunity to major in an area. Graduates work as food technologists and scientists in product development, quality and safety, and processing.

name: Bachelor of Games
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Games develops future-ready skills across game design, game art and game development in one of Australia's most established and influential game design programs, recognised for its strong connections to the games sector and as one of Australia's most gender-balanced game degrees. Students develop their game design practice through project-based work with industry links. Graduates work in games design, art, production and development, and in the broader interactive media and software industries.

name: Bachelor of Graphic Design
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Graphic Design gives students the fundamentals to become an effective integrated designer, working as part of a creative community to shape how people understand, navigate and engage with the world. Students learn to use design as a strategic tool and build creative thinking, research and technical capabilities. Graduates work as graphic and communication designers, brand and visual identity designers, and in studio, agency and in-house design roles.

name: Bachelor of Health and Biomedical Sciences (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Health and Biomedical Sciences (Honours) at RMIT University equips students with a transferable skillset for careers in academic and applied research, diagnostic services, industry, medical marketing, scientific communication and other STEM fields. It is a supervisor-guided independent research project with complementary workshops in research methods and scientific communication appropriate to the chosen discipline, developing advanced problem-solving skills, science communication skills, an aptitude for independent research and research techniques, and advanced disciplinary knowledge. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Industrial Design (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Industrial Design (Honours) at RMIT University explores the trans-disciplinary nature of contemporary industrial design through hands-on learning in practice-based design studios, co-creating solutions with a human-centred approach to product, service and experience design. Working on real-world problems in industry and community contexts, students complete a year-long honours design research project and choose from four majors. RMIT has offered industrial design for more than 75 years, and is ranked number one in Australia and 19th in the world for art and design in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026.

name: Bachelor of Information Technology
description: RMIT University Bachelor of Information Technology is a three-year, 288 credit point degree with three majors (cyber security, enterprise system development, digital innovation) and 15 minors covering cloud computing, programming, data analysis, data science, artificial intelligence, bioinformatics and business information systems. Common first-year units introduce the field before students specialise, and in third year they can take a programming capstone that simulates an industry software-engineering project under a professional project manager. Work-integrated learning is embedded throughout. Entry is competitive and requires the Victorian Certificate of Education or equivalent with the English and mathematics study-score prerequisites; completing the Associate Degree in Information Technology guarantees entry with four semesters of credit. Indicative international tuition is around A$46,100 per year. Graduates work in web and mobile computing, cyber security, cloud computing, data management, software development, software analysis, artificial intelligence and systems administration.

name: Bachelor of Interior Design (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Interior Design (Honours) at RMIT University is an ideas-led design degree that explores the potential and future of interior design as a practice, focused on the dynamic relations between people and the surrounding environment. Recognising that interiors are increasingly transformed by contemporary technologies and social and cultural forces, the degree challenges students' assumptions about interior design and teaches them to think and operate like a designer, learning from distinguished practitioners. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and in the top 15 globally for architecture and built environment in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026.

name: Bachelor of International Studies
description: The RMIT Bachelor of International Studies builds a strong understanding of intercultural, social and political issues and how to address them. Students select one of three majors complemented by a language minor and a disciplinary minor or elective courses, exploring international systems and global processes, learning to negotiate cross-culturally, and studying strategic and ethical leadership. Graduates work in foreign affairs and trade, international development, non-government organisations, global business and research.

name: Bachelor of Journalism
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Journalism combines critical thinking with hands-on industry experience, preparing students to report across digital, radio, television and emerging news media platforms, including live radio and television productions. Students produce real-world journalism, collaborate with industry and community partners, and build a professional portfolio of published work. Graduates work as journalists, reporters, editors and producers across print, broadcast, online and multimedia news.

name: Bachelor of Laboratory Medicine (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Laboratory Medicine (Honours) at RMIT University prepares students to work in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases, working alongside doctors, pathologists and scientists. Students gain fundamental knowledge of human anatomy and physiology, develop communication and professional skills, and are introduced to factors that impact the health of individuals and communities, particularly First Nations peoples. They build skills in molecular diagnostics and the application of biochemical and molecular biology techniques to the study of human diseases including infectious diseases, inherited conditions and cancer, and learn clinical immunology and pathology. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Landscape Architectural Design
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Landscape Architectural Design has students work with parks, seasons, coastlines and communities to address global issues including climate change, reconciliation, biodiversity loss, environmental degradation and the creation of meaningful public space. Students explore how landscape architecture interacts with natural ecosystems, built environments, and cultural and social frameworks, developing conceptual thinking skills. Graduates continue to a professionally accredited master's and work in landscape architecture, urban design and public space design.

name: Bachelor of Laws
description:
RMIT's LLB is three years, which is notably compressed against the more common four-year law degree structure - it front-loads core subjects (contracts, torts, criminal law, constitutional law) into the early semesters and opens up elective room as students progress, with final-year core units covering evidence, and equity and trusts specifically.

It's fully accredited by the Victorian Legal Admissions Board, meaning it satisfies the academic requirement for legal practice admission in Victoria - graduates still need to complete Practical Legal Training afterward, but the degree itself isn't a partial or non-accredited qualification some cheaper alternatives turn out to be. Work-Integrated Learning subjects are built into the structure so students get supervised exposure to actual legal work - community legal centres, clinics, or placements - before they graduate, rather than facing their first real client interaction during PLT.

The three-year length combined with full VLAB accreditation is genuinely the degree's main selling point against competitors: most Victorian law schools require four years to cover the same accredited content.
curriculum:
Year 1: Contract Law, Criminal Law, Torts, Legal Research and Writing, Constitutional Law
Year 2: Property Law, Administrative Law, Corporations Law, electives begin
Year 3: Evidence, Equity and Trusts, Work Integrated Learning placement, capstone electives (e.g. Alternative Dispute Resolution, International Law)
Note: graduates require completion of Practical Legal Training (PLT) for admission to legal practice
admission_requirements: ATAR ~85+ (or equivalent Year 12); competitive entry
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0

name: Bachelor of Legal and Dispute Studies
Bachelor of Media
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Media produces critically informed, multi-skilled communicators able to deliver innovative content across film, television, radio, and social and mobile media. The degree integrates practical production, conceptual analysis, creative practice and critical reflection. Graduates work in media production, content creation, digital and social media, communications and campaign roles. Students learn in RMIT's media production facilities and undertake hands-on projects with a global focus, with opportunities for international research projects.

name: Bachelor of Media and Communication (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Media and Communication (Honours) at RMIT University combines a laboratory and studio model of study with well-equipped resources to help students demonstrate their ability and establish their reputation and future career. Students study the big issues in contemporary media and communication, expand their abilities, and investigate their specialisation using sophisticated research and project skills, demonstrating advanced conceptual abilities through project outcomes examined by industry and academic leaders. RMIT is ranked fifth in Australia and in the top 100 in the world for media and communication in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026.

name: Bachelor of Medical Radiation (Radiation Therapy)
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Medical Radiation prepares allied health professionals who use radiation for diagnostic examinations, radiation therapy treatment, functional imaging and supportive care. Students enrol directly into one of three specialised streams: diagnostic radiography, radiation therapy, or nuclear medicine, each with different roles and responsibilities, and become highly skilled, patient-centred practitioners. Graduates register and practise as medical radiation practitioners in hospitals, cancer centres and imaging services.

name: Bachelor of Music Industry
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Music Industry prepares students to work across the creation, production, distribution and promotion of music, from local gigs to global platforms. Studying in the heart of Melbourne, Australia's music capital, students explore contemporary music trends and issues through practical, project-based work and academic study. Graduates work as artists and producers, music managers and promoters, and in labels, live music, publishing and music technology.

name: Bachelor of Nursing
description:
RMIT's nursing degree is almost entirely core subjects - anatomy, physiology, mental health, community health - with just one elective slot across three years, and clinical placement hours dominate the structure: five separate placements (PEP 1 through PEP 5) totalling at least 800 hours, climbing from 120 hours in first year to 200 hours in the final semester of third year. That 800-hour minimum is the AHPRA registration threshold, so it's not a target RMIT chose arbitrarily - it's the floor for graduates to register as Registered Nurses at all.

Placements happen across major metropolitan and rural hospitals as well as community-sector settings, giving students exposure to acute care and mental health contexts specifically, since those are prearranged placement types built into the structure. Before placement, students work through RMIT's simulated learning facilities - high-fidelity mannequins and simulated wards - so the first time a student manages a real deteriorating patient isn't literally the first time they've done it at all.

Clinical supervision comes directly from healthcare agency staff rather than solely university academics, which keeps the assessment grounded in what hospitals actually expect from a new graduate, not just what a lecture theatre covered.
curriculum:
Year 1: Anatomy and Physiology, Foundations of Nursing Practice, Health Assessment, PEP 1 clinical placement (120 hours, semester 2)
Year 2: Mental Health Nursing, Community and Primary Health Care, Pharmacology for Nursing, PEP 2 (160 hours) and PEP 3 (160 hours, semester 2)
Year 3: Acute and Complex Care Nursing, Leadership in Nursing Practice, elective, PEP 4 (160 hours) and PEP 5 (200 hours, semester 2)
Total clinical placement requirement: minimum 800 hours for AHPRA registration eligibility
admission_requirements: ATAR ~65+ (or equivalent Year 12), plus health/immunisation and police checks
english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 overall, no band below 7.0 (nursing registration requirement)

name: Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours) at RMIT University develops the knowledge, practical skills and confidence to become a contemporary occupational therapist. Students learn to see beyond a diagnosis or disability and understand how people, their environments and the activities that matter most come together to shape everyday life, working in partnership with people to enable participation, health and wellbeing. Through authentic real-world learning, human-centred design, technology and innovation, and work alongside communities and industry partners, students build professional reasoning and practical skills to create evidence-informed solutions across health, disability and education. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Pharmaceutical Science
description: The Bachelor of Pharmaceutical Sciences (Honours) at RMIT University provides industry-based participatory learning, giving students experience, skills and knowledge obtained from within the pharmaceutical science industry. Students participate in live projects and contribute in a real-world setting, and industry professionals contribute to the ongoing development of the curriculum to keep it relevant to graduate employers. RMIT partners with more than 30 organisations each year to provide the industry-based placement, and on completion graduates are eligible to join a number of professional societies. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Pharmaceutical Sciences (Honours)
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Pharmaceutical Sciences (Honours) teaches students about the human body, the action of drugs, and how the pharmaceutical industry can deliver more reliable, accessible and effective treatments. Alongside pharmacology and physiology, students study the development of new drugs, the clinical use of medications, and the legal and regulatory aspects of the industry. Graduates work in pharmaceutical and biotechnology research and development, drug formulation and analysis, regulatory affairs, and clinical trials.

name: Bachelor of Pharmacy (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Pharmacy (Honours) at RMIT University is a selective-entry, research-oriented honours degree for capable and highly motivated students who want hands-on involvement in research projects. It prepares students for the compulsory one-year internship required for Australia-wide registration as a pharmacist, after which graduates are registered to practise in any area of pharmacy in Australia, including community or hospital pharmacy. The degree also provides a foundation for further study and other career opportunities. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Photography
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Photography brings together technical expertise, critical engagement, professional practice and ethical judgement. Students produce work that responds to critical discourses in local and global contexts, explore emerging technologies, and analyse and integrate their relevance to their own image-making, building from foundational skills. Graduates work as professional photographers and image-makers across commercial, editorial, documentary and art photography, and in visual media and curatorial roles.

name: Bachelor of Professional Communication
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Professional Communication lets students customise a career in advertising, digital communication and public relations, choosing a double major or specialising in one major with three minors from a broad range of multidisciplinary areas. The degree integrates creative production, conceptual analysis and critical reflection with professional industry knowledge. Graduates work in advertising, public relations, digital and strategic communication, and content and campaign roles.

name: Bachelor of Project Management (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Project Management (Honours) at RMIT University builds the skills to initiate, plan and execute complex projects across a range of industries. The degree provides theoretical knowledge and practical know-how to take projects from inception to completion, with tools to manage projects across a range of scales and complexities. Students can take a minor to enhance employability in a specific project management field, and the course is fully accredited. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and in the top 15 globally for architecture and built environment in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026, and connects students to more than 250 industry partners.

name: Bachelor of Property Development, Investment and Valuation (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Property Development, Investment and Valuation (Honours) at RMIT University prepares students for a role as a property professional, providing the education requirements for a career in one of Australia's largest employment sectors. The reputable, fully industry-accredited degree focuses on current technical skills while developing critical thinking, professional writing, research and analytical abilities. Students gain the ability to understand the factors around property ownership, management, investment, valuation and development, learning to understand property markets, analyse data, build value, manage assets and create property developments. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Psychology
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Psychology is the study of the science of human behaviour and the mental states that drive it. Alongside the principles of personality, psychopathology and psychotherapy, students explore social, developmental, biological and cognitive psychology and research methods. Completing the accredited sequence is the first stage toward registration as a psychologist. Graduates also work in research, human resources, health and community services, and policy.

name: Bachelor of Science (Dean's Scholar, Food Science) (Honours)
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Science offers flexibility to pursue a range of science specialisations while gaining practical real-world experience. It begins with introductory subjects across the physical, life, data and mathematical sciences, then develops critical thinking and problem-solving skills to be competitive across science-led disciplines, with options such as a Dean's Scholar or Food Science stream and a science and teaching package. Graduates work in laboratory and field science, data and research roles, science communication, and further study.

name: Bachelor of Social Science (Psychology)
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Social Science is a community-oriented, person-centred and hands-on degree exploring how society shapes people's lives and how students can be part of creating change. Students choose a specialisation in mental health and wellbeing, youth work or psychology, studying communication and practice skills with individuals, groups and families, ethics, mental health, youth work and First Nations perspectives. Graduates work in community services, youth work, mental health support, and social research and policy.

name: Bachelor of Social Work (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Social Work (Honours) at RMIT University prepares graduates to promote the wellbeing of individuals, families and communities, applying interdisciplinary knowledge about Australian society, social problems and human needs to foster social change. RMIT has taught social work for more than 40 years, and courses reflect contemporary ideas about the profession. In the honours year, students pursue a topic in depth through a traditional thesis or capstone project, studying subjects including social work, social science and research, and undertake 140 days of field education work placement.

name: Bachelor of Software Engineering
description: The Bachelor of Software Engineering at RMIT University equips students with a solid foundation in computer science and mathematics and deep expertise in software architecture, processes, methodologies and quality frameworks. The four-year degree comprises two years of study, a one-year industry placement, then a final year of study, with the placement providing an opportunity to develop professional and technical skills and build a professional network. Students work within complex software development environments covering operating systems, communications, web software, databases and applications, focusing on the software development life cycle. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Space Science
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Space Science develops critical skills in space science and technology, connecting the upstream (build and launch) and downstream (application of space-related products and services) industries. Described as unlike any other degree in Australia, RMIT leads in space science and engineering research and provides a unique mix of physics, geospatial science, mathematics, statistics and specialised space studies. Graduates work in the space and satellite industry, Earth observation and geospatial services, research, and defence.

name: Bachelor of Surveying (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Surveying (Honours) at RMIT University prepares students for an in-demand career as a surveyor, with expertise in the measurement, processing, interpretation and presentation of information about the size, shape, nature and location of features of the physical environment. It is the only four-year surveying degree in Victoria, and more than 90 percent of graduates are employed within three months. The hands-on degree provides a strong link between theory and practice across surveying specialisations including engineering and topographic surveying, with an extensive range of industry-based practical learning experiences. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Sustainability and Environment
description: The RMIT Bachelor of Sustainability and Environment explores biodiversity, climate action and sustainable policy to help drive solutions to urgent environmental and social challenges. Students develop a deep understanding of climate change, environmental management, Indigenous perspectives, place-based analysis, and pathways to social and ecological justice, with an emphasis on the social elements of environmental issues and skills in communication and critical thinking. Graduates work in sustainability, environmental policy and management, community engagement and advocacy roles.

name: Bachelor of Urban and Regional Planning (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Urban and Regional Planning (Honours) at RMIT University was the first degree of its kind in Victoria and is designed to enable students to understand, analyse, manage and shape the strategies that inform the future of cities for improved liveability, climate resilience and equitable, sustainable places. Through core subjects, integrated minors, a work placement and a capstone experience, students focus on sustainability and its place in urban planning policy, preparing for a career as a policy and planning leader. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and in the top 15 globally for architecture and built environment in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026.

name: Bachelor of Youth Work and Youth Studies
Bachelor or Business Innovation and Enterprise
Diploma of Accounting
description: The Diploma of Accounting at RMIT University builds on small business accounting and bookkeeping knowledge from previous study or work and introduces a range of corporate accounting specialisations to broaden career prospects. Students develop foundational skills in financial management, management accounting, corporate financial accounting, preparing individual tax returns, budgeting, accounting systems and internal controls, and advanced spreadsheeting, along with core employment skills such as effective communication, building professional relationships and ethical decision-making. Study options include full-time and part-time blended delivery in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Apparel, Fashion and Textiles
description: The Diploma of Apparel, Fashion and Textiles at RMIT University is a practical, studio-based course with access to well-equipped facilities and industry-connected instructors. Students learn to create designs for knitted, woven and printed fabrics or textile products across fashion, interiors, homewares, craft and other commercial applications, developing their creative practice through drawing, painting and illustration, studio classes in print, knit and weave, design and concept development, experimental textile samples, and computer-aided design. With a focus on industry standards, students develop a collection of textiles to technical and market specifications and explore sustainable concepts and innovations. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Building and Construction (Building)
description: The Diploma of Building and Construction (Building) at RMIT University covers the planning, coordination and control of a project from inception to delivery. Students examine the principles, techniques and regulations of the building and construction industry for medium-rise and wide-span buildings up to 25 metres high, through a practical curriculum that incorporates hands-on work and project-based learning. Site excursions to residential and commercial construction projects give students hands-on field experience, and classes are available day or evening. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Business
description: The Diploma of Business at RMIT University builds on existing knowledge and is tailored to contemporary work environments, covering personal and team effectiveness, communication with customers, business continuity for sustainability and risk, and business success through planning. Students undertake work-related projects to develop practical skills and apply knowledge, and can take advantage of RMIT's partnerships with the Essendon Football Club and Cricket Victoria. With up to three annual intakes, the diploma offers a fast start. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Commerce
description: The RMIT Diploma of Commerce explores key business subject areas including accounting, management, information systems, business law and marketing. Students connect with high-profile brands and gain real-world work experience through industry placements, client projects, guest speakers and events, led by industry-experienced teaching staff, and use facilities such as the RMIT Trading Facility with a live market data feed. It provides a pathway into RMIT business degrees, and graduates use it to enter business support and administration roles.

name: Diploma of Conservation and Ecosystem Management
description: The Diploma of Conservation and Ecosystem Management at RMIT University introduces the skills used by land managers, park rangers, site assessors, water quality assessors and conservation staff. Students learn to survey animals and plants, monitor waterways, assess and restore natural sites, and undertake cultural studies relating to land management, with field trips around Melbourne and overnight excursions to locations such as Heywood and Barmah Forest. Students learn about cultural heritage and Indigenous land management with direct input from Aboriginal Elders and community organisations, and the course is developed with industry stakeholders including Melbourne Water and Parks Victoria.

name: Diploma of Fashion Styling
description: The Diploma of Fashion Styling at RMIT University is the only nationally accredited fashion styling diploma in Australia. Through hands-on experience and industry-focused training, students respond to real and simulated briefs across personal styling and image consultancy, editorial shoots, social media content, and styling for television or film, learning to craft innovative styling solutions for individuals and businesses. Study takes place at RMIT's Centre for Fashion in Melbourne, in well-equipped studios guided by working professionals, and the course explores eco-styling and ethical fashion practices.

name: Diploma of Graphic Design
description: The Diploma of Graphic Design at RMIT University develops creative and critical thinking for design, exploring the design process and a range of production methods using industry-standard software. Students learn to generate branding solutions for products, services and businesses, produce design content for print, digital and online media, and work to a brief, conducting market research and presenting design solutions to clients. The diploma has a strong technical focus on digital design, print production and typography, and covers illustration, digital design and typography among other forms of visual and graphic design. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Information Technology
description: The Diploma of Information Technology at RMIT University, based in Melbourne, is guided by experienced teachers with extensive industry experience and helps students develop a project portfolio to launch a career in IT. Students learn to create web-based solutions for clients, develop mobile applications, and apply project management skills to an IT project, and to install, operate and troubleshoot medium enterprise routers and switches, design user experience solutions, build dynamic websites, design and integrate databases, and build and test network servers. Students also build professional skills including cyber security awareness and managing client issues.

name: Diploma of Interior Design
description: The Diploma of Interior Design at RMIT University gives students the creative skills to build a career in interior design, working on homes, offices, hotels and commercial environments. This practical, industry-relevant course covers 2D and 3D design skills and the decorative aspect of design, including colour, materials and finishes, interior construction techniques, soft furnishings, and fabrics and furniture. Through research and practical tasks across historical and contemporary styles, students develop high-level documentation and technical skills to respond to professional briefs for residential and commercial clients. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Laboratory Technology
description: The Diploma of Laboratory Technology at RMIT University builds on a foundation of scientific knowledge to develop a deeper understanding of scientific principles and a wider range of laboratory skills. As a laboratory technician, graduates can conduct tests for pathologists, biochemists, clinical chemists, pharmacologists, veterinarians and microbiologists, providing technical support to scientists in research, production and testing roles. Under supervision, students examine changes in cells and tissues, perform chemical analyses of blood and other body fluids, and assist with research. Graduates can work in hospitals, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, pathology laboratories and government departments.

name: Diploma of Nursing
description: The Diploma of Nursing at RMIT University helps students build knowledge and skills in a practical learning environment, through on-campus simulation laboratories and industry placements, graduating ready to work as an enrolled nurse. In this nationally accredited diploma, students gain the skills to provide acute, curative and rehabilitative care under the direction of a registered nurse, working with patients of all ages across aged care, community, acute care and mental health, and learn to administer intravenous medications and apply medical and surgical nursing skills. Topics include anatomy and physiology, wound management, infection control and medication administration.

name: Diploma of Photography and Digital Imaging
description: The Diploma of Photography and Digital Imaging at RMIT University is a practical, industry-led course that helps students develop their artistic practice and hone their photography skills across commercial, advertising, documentary, editorial, institutional and fine art photography. Students learn to interpret assignment briefs, consult with clients to refine objectives, select appropriate tools including cameras, recording media, lighting and post-capture processing, work from a studio or on location, and use aesthetic, conceptual, compositional and technical skills along with traditional and contemporary technologies. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Screen and Media
description: The Diploma of Screen and Media at RMIT University prepares students to work in television, broadcast, production and live streaming, with skills across studio, location and hybrid production methods. This one-year, intensely practical course includes Work Integrated Learning across major industry broadcasters and organisations in news, drama, sport, light entertainment and events. Students work on live broadcast and streaming productions across all technical areas including producing, production management, directing, camera, lighting, audio, graphics and post-production, learning in RMIT's Media Precinct on industry-grade equipment including broadcast studios.

name: Diploma of Visual Arts
description: The Diploma of Visual Arts at RMIT University is taught by practising artists in real studio environments, with staff who are art practitioners with national and international reputations who can connect students to industry and galleries. The diploma offers practical and theoretical subjects developed with the arts industry and is designed to prepare students for a career in the visual arts or related creative fields. A major focus is the production of a professional folio of work that reflects the student's personal creativity, with a sequential development of skills, and a strong focus on exhibition practice. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Executive Master of Business Administration
description: RMIT's Executive Master of Business Administration is a postgraduate program for experienced professionals aspiring to senior leadership, switching industries or launching a venture. It builds strategic knowledge and leadership skills to lead innovation and transformation in a disrupted world, with flexible study and a choice of six specialisations. Graduates move into senior executive and general management roles across the private, public and not-for-profit sectors.

name: Graduate Certificate in Animation, Games and Interactivity
description: The Graduate Certificate in Animation, Games and Interactivity at RMIT University helps students develop their media capability through studio practice. Students have access to industry-standard technologies, animation and games design studios and a dedicated postgraduate study space, developing a directorial vision of narrative, visual and interactive media along with high-level conceptual and practical skills. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and 19th in the world for art and design in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026, and students attend industry events and work with experts from organisations such as ACMI X and the Melbourne International Animation Festival.

name: Graduate Certificate in Art in Public Space
Graduate Certificate in Business Administration
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Business Administration teaches students to approach and solve real problems in a global business context, acquiring the contemporary business knowledge and skills to manage and lead organisations. It is a direct pathway into the Master of Business Administration. Graduates use it to move into or advance toward management roles across industries and sectors. Studying alongside like-minded professionals, students build their networks while they learn.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business Information Technology
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Business Information Technology develops a strong foundation in creating successful business information systems solutions. Building on existing technical and leadership skills, it expands students' capabilities to become ethically and socially responsible professionals, with an emphasis on industry best practice and innovative professional practice. Graduates work as business analysts, systems analysts, IT consultants and information systems specialists.

name: Graduate Certificate in Creative and Cultural Production
description: The Graduate Certificate in Creative and Cultural Production at RMIT University introduces students to contemporary issues in the field and builds local and global capabilities, including intercultural ways of working with a focus on diversity, access, equity and inclusion, interdisciplinary approaches to cultural production, engagement methods for new and emerging public spaces including the digital realm, and the application of environmental, cultural, social and economic sustainability. Creative and cultural production is a rapidly expanding field spanning curation, arts management, public and event programming, cultural tourism, urban development, and socially engaged art and community partnerships. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Digital Economy
description: The Graduate Certificate in Digital Economy at RMIT University prepares graduates with the knowledge and skills to lead in the transition to the digital economy, now a worldwide economic imperative. Blockchain is treated as a transformative technology at the centre of the new digital economy, with wide-ranging applications across commerce, government and social enterprises. The program equips students to identify, understand and communicate the value proposition and the economic, financial and accounting implications of these technologies, in a field that has seen strong year-on-year job growth. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Dispute Resolution
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Dispute Resolution builds the knowledge and practical skills to become an accredited mediator. Students explore current and emerging global, national and local dispute resolution practices and the concepts, theories and processes that underpin them, gaining the skills to mediate, negotiate and manage disputes across diverse fields and professional settings. Graduates work in mediation, conflict resolution, human resources, community services and the justice sector.

name: Graduate Certificate in Energy Efficient and Sustainable Building
description: The Graduate Certificate in Energy Efficient and Sustainable Building at RMIT University provides a multidisciplinary introduction to the science, design and management of sustainable buildings. It is designed for current architects, engineers, project managers and other design professionals seeking further professional development in the built environment, building the ability to respond to current and emerging issues, trends and organisational needs, with industry site visits and expert guest speakers. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and in the top 15 globally for architecture and built environment in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Fashion (Entrepreneurship)
description: The Graduate Certificate in Fashion (Entrepreneurship) at RMIT University introduces the key skills and knowledge needed to develop a fashion enterprise or build a career in the global fashion industry. It builds students' ability as entrepreneurial thinkers and leaders, learning from professionally experienced educators with strong relationships in the fashion sector, and includes study visits and industry-partnered projects. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and 19th in the world for art and design in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026. It is taught at RMIT's Centre for Fashion in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Finance
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Finance teaches the principles of finance, econometrics and the analysis of financial markets, integrating work and learning. Studying in the heart of Melbourne, students strengthen their analytical and problem-solving abilities and use financial databases and software in the RMIT Trading Facility. Graduates work in banking, corporate finance, investment analysis and financial advice. The program develops both specialised finance skills and generic capabilities tied to lifelong learning.

name: Graduate Certificate in Human Resource Management
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Human Resource Management focuses on managing people across borders and in different legal and cultural contexts. Students develop a critical awareness of the legal, ethical, social, economic and environmental challenges shaping HR strategy, and understand how HR practices apply in small and medium enterprises, start-ups, public and not-for-profit organisations and multinationals. Graduates work in human resources, people and culture, and employment relations roles.

name: Graduate Certificate in International Business
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in International Business builds practical knowledge and in-demand skills for a global career in private, public or not-for-profit organisations, covering cross-cultural management, international business and leadership. Students gain a thorough understanding of contemporary international business theory and the skills to make ethical and sustainable business decisions. Graduates work in international trade, global operations, business development and management roles.

name: Graduate Certificate in Justice and Criminology
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Justice and Criminology has a strong vocational focus, providing advanced skills and knowledge to perform effectively as a justice professional. Its design, development and delivery involve the justice sector, and students undertake internships, field projects and simulated activities based on real workplace scenarios. Graduates work in policy and research, corrections, community justice, crime prevention and government agencies.

name: Graduate Certificate in Marketing
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Marketing develops an understanding of the role of marketing within an organisation and in relation to management, and how to develop marketing strategies and tactics across sectors. Teaching uses lectures, seminars, workshops and group discussions, with online and digital resources. Employment for advertising and marketing professionals is projected to grow strongly. Graduates work in marketing, brand, digital and communications roles.

name: Graduate Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety builds skills in risk identification and management to create safer workplaces and communities. Students develop a deep understanding of best practice in implementing and evaluating risk management interventions across workplace and community environments, and connect with industry throughout their studies. Graduates work in occupational health and safety, occupational hygiene, compliance, construction safety and ergonomics.

name: Graduate Certificate in People Analytics
description: The Graduate Certificate in People Analytics at RMIT University develops skills in analysing complex data on people, processes, performance and markets to support organisational decision-making, a field expanded by big data and AI. Students learn to move beyond historical HR metrics and benchmarking by generating new insights from existing data using descriptive, visual, predictive and narrative analytical techniques, drawing on current theory to plan, attract, develop, retain and reward a workforce based on evidence about work, workers, industry and context. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Professional Accounting
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Professional Accounting is aimed at graduates of non-accounting disciplines, building strong foundational skills in financial decision-making and reporting, and business and corporations law. It also covers the social, environmental, cultural and ethical issues affecting contemporary business. It is a pathway toward the Master of Professional Accounting. Graduates use it to move into accounting and finance roles.

name: Graduate Certificate in Project Management
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Project Management is designed for professionals working or looking to work in project management, equipping them with management and leadership skills. It emphasises the practical application of theory, engaging students with project management theory and best practice and the use of real-world case work. Graduates work as project coordinators and managers across engineering, IT, construction, events and government.

name: Graduate Certificate in Property
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Property develops specialised knowledge for a dynamic and complex sector, with learning experiences to acquire and apply management theories and property concepts across the property sectors, including valuation. Lessons are designed to meet the current and future needs of the industry. Graduates work in property management, valuation, development and analysis, or continue to further study.

name: Graduate Certificate in Supply Chain and Logistics Management
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Supply Chain and Logistics Management expands knowledge in strategic logistics management through industry-based learning. Students enhance their skills in implementing efficient, effective and ethical strategies across the logistics lifecycle, and study the measurement of logistics performance and operations management, applying these approaches across the private and public sectors globally. Graduates work in supply chain, procurement, logistics and operations roles.

name: Graduate Certificate in Translating and Interpreting
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Translating and Interpreting teaches advanced concepts of translating and interpreting to support communication across cultures and languages. Students build the skills to navigate complex issues, communicate effectively from one language to another, and analyse a range of approaches to translating and interpreting in professional practice. Graduates work as translators and interpreters across government, health, legal, community and business settings.

name: Graduate Certificate of Commerce
description: The RMIT Graduate Certificate in Commerce lets students design their own course of study around their personal and career aspirations, choosing majors, minors and electives to build a knowledge base. The degree was developed in consultation with high-profile industry executives and provides a pathway to further study at master's level. Graduates use it to move into or advance in commerce, finance and business roles.

name: Graduate Certificate of Design Innovation and Technology
description: The Graduate Certificate of Design Innovation and Technology at RMIT University provides a development pathway for graduates from both design and non-design backgrounds. Students broaden their professional practice by engaging in research-driven collaborative design projects, developing specialist knowledge in emerging technology and working on industry-partnered projects that explore the future of design practice. Students work with practice-based academic researchers and professional designers, collaborate on international projects, and develop design skills that integrate the needs of people with the potential of technology. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Art in Public Space
Graduate Diploma in Blockchain Enabled Business
Graduate Diploma in Business Information Technology
Graduate Diploma in Early Childhood Education
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Early Childhood Education is a one-year intensive program that equips students with the knowledge, skills and practical experience to foster the development of children from birth to age five. It blends global and Indigenous perspectives with research-informed teaching methods and a teaching approach that respects diversity in age, gender, ethnicity and ability, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander narratives. Graduates work as early childhood teachers in preschools, kindergartens and early learning centres.

name: Graduate Diploma in Energy Efficient and Sustainable Building
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Energy Efficient and Sustainable Building develops a strong understanding of sustainable practice in the global building industry, covering resources and efficiencies in building materials, water and energy. Industry involvement in the course design ensures relevant, in-demand skills, and students apply theoretical knowledge to practice to respond to emerging issues and trends. Graduates work in sustainable building design, assessment and consulting, and facilities and energy management.

name: Graduate Diploma in Journalism
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Journalism is a one-year program that enhances an undergraduate qualification with focused study in journalism, setting students up for a career as a journalist. Students explore all forms of contemporary journalism in its legal, ethical and social context, present and produce live radio and television news, and create text and data reports for RMIT's publication, with an overseas work placement opportunity. Graduates work as journalists, reporters and producers across print, broadcast, online and data journalism.

name: Graduate Diploma in Justice and Criminology
Graduate Diploma in Media
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma of Media teaches how each segment of media functions and builds the knowledge to make content and campaigns succeed in an agile, ever-changing environment. Calling on extensive industry links, students undertake a collaborative media project to develop an original production with input from peers, teachers and practitioners, and can undertake an industry placement. Graduates work in media production, content strategy, communications and campaign roles.

name: Graduate Diploma in Mental Health Nursing
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Mental Health Nursing is designed for registered nurses with foundational mental health experience who want to advance their knowledge and skills for specialised practice. Structured learning integrates academic study with practice-based application, developing advanced practical skills, critical thinking and professional judgement for a range of mental health presentations and contexts. Graduates work as mental health nurses in inpatient, community, forensic and specialist mental health services.

name: Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety introduces the technical and social aspects of workplace safety, a multidisciplinary field with applications across most industries. It focuses on the science and technology of risk management through hazard assessment and evaluation and the development of specific control mechanisms, teaching students to apply a risk management model to workplace hazards. Graduates work as occupational health and safety professionals, advisers and managers.

name: Graduate Diploma in Project Management
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Project Management is designed for professionals working or looking to work in project management, and is particularly relevant for those taking the next step in their career. It introduces practical tools to mitigate risk, design strong projects and lead successful teams, with the opportunity to specialise in engineering, information technology or general project management. Graduates work as project and program managers across multiple industries.

name: Graduate Diploma in Property
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Property develops specialised theoretical knowledge and technical skills in property, with a flexible structure combining face-to-face and online delivery to suit working professionals. It focuses on corporate real estate, development and management, teaching students to evaluate problems and determine property value and return for diverse asset classes and projects, taught by practising industry professionals. Graduates work in property development, valuation, asset and portfolio management.

name: Graduate Diploma in Translating and Interpreting
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma in Translating and Interpreting is designed for people with advanced bilingual skills who want to build a career providing a link between people of different cultures and languages. Students learn theoretical approaches, specialised industry knowledge and ethical issues in the field, and how to use communication media to support translating and interpreting work. Graduates work as translators and interpreters across government, health, legal, community and business settings.

name: Graduate Diploma in Urban Planning and Environment
Graduate Diploma of Advertising
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma of Advertising is a globally focused program that prepares students to manage advertising and persuasive communication challenges, with the skills to develop, evaluate and execute creative campaigns that resonate across borders. Students learn from industry professionals through guest lectures and coursework aligned with the latest industry developments, and can tailor their studies to their interests. Graduates work in advertising, brand and campaign strategy, and creative and communications roles.

name: Graduate Diploma of Animation, Games and Interactivity
Graduate Diploma of Communication
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma of Communication is designed for new graduates building on their communications knowledge and for established professionals seeking career progression, allowing study across a range of specialist areas. As a core element, students can complete an industry internship, immersing themselves in professional practice and building a professional network. Graduates work in corporate and strategic communication, public relations, media and content roles.

name: Graduate Diploma of Design Innovation and Technology
Graduate Diploma of Fashion (Entrepreneurship)
description: The Graduate Diploma of Fashion (Entrepreneurship) at RMIT University extends students' skills as creative and business-minded thinkers, developing the ability to recognise opportunities, understand risk, be resourceful and understand their capacity within the fashion industry. Students take advantage of professional links with organisations including the Australian Fashion Council, and the curriculum is kept current by an industry advisory group of high-profile representatives. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and 19th in the world for art and design in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026. It is taught in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma of Writing and Publishing
description: The RMIT Graduate Diploma of Writing and Publishing provides an introduction for experienced writers and novices alike to a varied and changing industry, with the opportunity to focus on personal interests. This industry-renowned course immerses students in professional practice from day one, taught by current industry practitioners and guest lecturers. Graduates work in writing, editing, publishing and content roles across books, media and communications.

name: Juris Doctor
description: RMIT University's Juris Doctor is a three-year graduate law degree for people who hold a bachelor degree in any field. It teaches the compulsory areas of legal knowledge required for admission to practice, plus electives, with an emphasis on practical legal skills and clinics. Completing the degree meets the academic requirements for admission to legal practice in Victoria; to be admitted a graduate must then complete practical legal training through a licensed provider for six months, or supervised practice for twelve months. Graduates work as solicitors and barristers, in government and in-house legal teams, and in policy, compliance and dispute resolution. Indicative international tuition is around A$48,000 per year for 2026.

name: Master of Advertising
description: The RMIT Master of Advertising is a two-year degree (four years part-time) from a school ranked first in Australia and among the top globally for advertising. Students develop advanced knowledge and transferable skills across creative leadership, strategy planning and campaign development, building a global and local outlook on marketing and communication in a constantly evolving industry. Graduates work as advertising and communication leaders, strategists, creative directors and campaign managers in agencies and in-house teams.

name: Master of Analytics
description: The RMIT Master of Analytics builds on skills in computer science, engineering and business to make students specialists in analytics. Students learn to use data to make informed decisions that contribute to organisational success, with a strong core of statistics and operations research and a diverse range of electives, plus hands-on experience through projects, internships and guest lectures. Graduates work as data scientists and analysts, operations analysts, and business intelligence and modelling specialists.

name: Master of Animation, Games and Interactivity
description: The RMIT Master of Animation, Games and Interactivity develops a directorial vision through the concepts and techniques of narrative, visual and interactive media in a studio setting. It builds on more than 20 years of RMIT postgraduate teaching and research, focusing on advanced theoretical and practical aspects of professional production in animation, games and interactive media through studio projects. Graduates work as directors, designers, technical artists and producers across animation, games and interactive media.

name: Master of Applied Science (Health & Medical Physics)
Master of Architecture
description: The RMIT Master of Architecture is an internationally renowned degree that leads to professional accreditation as an architect. Students develop the core skills of architectural design to an advanced level, deepen their understanding of design-based research, and build critical awareness of their own work through a wide variety of learning experiences. RMIT Architecture and its graduates are acknowledged by the national and international profession. Graduates complete registration requirements to practise as architects, and also work in urban design, project management and the wider built environment.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence
description: The RMIT Master of Artificial Intelligence teaches students to design and implement AI systems and applications in high-tech facilities including a dedicated Artificial Intelligence Lab, with a choice of project or research stream. RMIT is rated above world standard for its research in AI and image processing, and the course is among the most specialised in the country focused on AI theory and applications. Graduates work as AI and machine learning engineers, data scientists and AI specialists across industry and research.

name: Master of Arts (Arts Management)
description: The Master of Arts (Arts Management) at RMIT University helps students pursuing or already working in arts management gain capabilities that broaden their professional opportunities as an artist or manager, from managing festivals, events and museums to advising in the community, education and government sectors. Learning from industry practitioners and professional educators within a flexible framework, students graduate as highly skilled, reflective and ethical practitioners aware of the changing nature of the industry, with many opportunities to develop industry networks. RMIT is ranked number one in Australia and 19th in the world for art and design in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026.

name: Master of Biotechnology
description: The RMIT Master of Biotechnology gives students in-depth knowledge of gene and protein technologies, bioinformatics, and microbiology and food science disciplines, combining classroom study with a strong component of hands-on laboratory practicals. Students can complete a semester of industry placement or a research project with a minor thesis, and analyse real-world data. Graduates work in biotechnology and pharmaceutical research and development, laboratory science, food and agtech, and regulatory roles.

name: Master of Business Administration
description:
RMIT's MBA runs across three study periods a year rather than the usual two semesters - full-time students take four courses per period and can finish in 1.5 years, which is fast for an MBA with this level of accreditation. The full program is 16 courses (192 credit points), but anyone who already holds a business-related bachelor's completed within the last decade only needs 12 - a meaningful discount for people who did a business or commerce undergrad and are coming back for the MBA credential rather than a career pivot.

The genuinely distinctive feature is the international study tour option: intensive units delivered in Vietnam or France that count as a 12-credit-point elective, combining an actual overseas trip with coursework rather than treating international exposure as a marketing photo. Electives can otherwise be pulled from other RMIT postgraduate programs, so students can lean the degree toward tech, health, or design management depending on where they're headed.

Teaching mixes lectures, studio-style workshops, and syndicate (small-group) work, reflecting an emphasis on group project delivery that mirrors how most MBA-holders actually operate once employed - in cross-functional teams, not solo.
curriculum:
Study Period 1 (of 3 per year, full load 4 courses/period): core courses in Accounting for Managers, Marketing Management, Organisational Behaviour, Economics for Managers
Study Period 2: Strategic Management, Financial Management, Operations Management, Business Analytics
Study Period 3 / later periods: electives (including optional international study tour to Vietnam or France), Leadership, capstone Business Strategy Project
Advanced-standing entrants (recent business bachelor's): 12-course pathway skipping select foundation courses
admission_requirements: Bachelor's degree plus at least 2-3 years professional work experience
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0

name: Master of Business Analytics and AI Strategy
description: The RMIT Master of Business Analytics and AI Strategy is designed for professionals who want to lead data-driven transformation, combining technical knowledge with advanced communication and leadership skills to influence decision-making at all levels of an organisation. Core subjects cover business analytics, visualisation, data architecture, ethics and governance, and digital strategy. Graduates work in analytics leadership, data strategy, digital transformation and consulting roles.

name: Master of Business Information Technology
description: The RMIT Master of Business Information Technology produces ethically and socially responsible professionals ready to innovate and lead in the changing business IT environment. It prepares students for roles such as business analyst, project manager or IT consultant, acting as a bridge between information technology and the business to deliver solutions for stakeholders, with mentoring and employer engagement opportunities. Graduates work as business analysts, IT consultants, project managers and information systems leaders.

name: Master of Clinical Osteopathy
description: The RMIT Master of Clinical Osteopathy is a two-year sequenced program aligned with the Australian Osteopathic Accreditation Council education standards, integrating theory and clinical sciences with clinical skills and application. Students learn to take a thorough patient history, assess function, make a diagnosis, and provide treatment and management, including hands-on diagnostic and treatment methods. Graduates are eligible to register and practise as osteopaths in private practice and multidisciplinary healthcare.

name: Master of Clinical Psychology
description: The RMIT Master of Clinical Psychology trains students across the theoretical and applied topics of clinical psychology, including psychological principles and models, the design and implementation of psychological interventions, psychological assessment and measurement, applied research and evaluation, and the ethical, legal and professional aspects of practice. Students gain practical experience through clinical placements and supervised work in RMIT's Health Sciences clinics. Graduates work toward registration and endorsement as clinical psychologists.

name: Master of Commerce
description: The RMIT Master of Commerce broadens business knowledge and develops a range of advanced business skills relevant to the needs of industry now and in the future, aimed at high-level managerial and consulting roles. Students network with like-minded professionals and access industry events and connections. Graduates work in management, consulting, finance and commerce roles across industries and internationally. The program is delivered flexibly and can be combined with industry engagement opportunities.

name: Master of Communication
description: RMIT University's Master of Communication is a two-year degree that combines communication theory with hands-on practice in strategic communication, public relations and digital media. Elective choices let students concentrate in areas such as marketing communication, journalism and crisis communication, and projects are modelled on real industry briefs. It suits both communication graduates extending their skills and people moving into the field from another discipline. Graduates work in corporate and agency communication, public relations, content and social media strategy, internal communication and campaign management. Indicative international tuition is in the range of A$35,000 to A$45,000 per year; confirm the current figure with RMIT.

name: Master of Communication Design
description: The RMIT Master of Communication Design develops strategic design thinking and leadership, pushing students to think critically to find design solutions to communication challenges. It suits design professionals looking to start their own studio or move into management, building skills in entrepreneurship, strategic design thinking and global best practice, plus advanced study in typography and other specialisations. Graduates work as senior communication and brand designers, design directors, and design strategists and studio leaders.

name: Master of Cyber Security
description: RMIT University Master of Cyber Security is open to graduates from any discipline: entry needs an Australian bachelor degree with a GPA of at least 2.0 out of 4.0, or at least five years of relevant work experience in areas such as information security, programming, software engineering, systems or business analysis, architecture, ICT management or information systems. There are no prerequisite subjects. A research option lets students take on a real cyber security problem through a minor thesis covering research, design, implementation and evaluation of a solution. Credit and recognition of prior learning, including professional-body accreditation, can shorten the degree. Indicative international tuition is around A$46,100 per year. Graduates are prepared for a range of roles as ICT security specialists, a field Jobs and Skills Australia projects to keep growing.

name: Master of Data Science
description:
