Students choose electives applying sustainable design theories and methods to architecture, urban planning, building performance or project management.
The course develops the technical, collaborative and cultural competencies needed to drive world-leading environmental outcomes in interdisciplinary teams. Graduates move into roles such as environmentally sustainable design consultant, sustainable design advisor and construction management specialist.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in Building Performance and Sustainable Design requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate with an average mark of at least 70. Graduate Diploma students may apply to upgrade to the Masters at the completion of their program.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Art Curating
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Art Curating at the University of Sydney, taught partly at Sydney College of the Arts, combines core academic skills, historical knowledge and community-engaged experience across the cultural, theoretical, social, political and economic issues underlying the gallery and museum system. Students gain access to gallery spaces, art studios and the Schaeffer Library, Australia's finest dedicated modern and contemporary art library, alongside collaboration with institutions including the Art Gallery of New South Wales.
Graduates gain a strong foundation in the history of art museums and their cultural impact, and an understanding of the changing role of curators in society.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in Art Curating requires: a bachelor's degree with a major in Anthropology, Archaeology, Art History, Cultural Geography, Cultural Studies, Education, English, Gender Studies, History, Indigenous Studies or related field and a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the Graduate Certificate in Art Curating with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Bioethics
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Bioethics at the University of Sydney examines the ethical challenges that arise in health care, public health and the life sciences, including issues in genetic engineering, migrant and prisoner health, animal experimentation and clinical medicine. Students complete 36 credit points across core units and units from the program's unit of study table, typically over two semesters of full-time study, directed by Sydney Health Ethics faculty.
Students come from backgrounds including philosophy, humanities, social science, law, science, medicine and allied health, with no medical background required. Sydney is ranked first in Australia and tenth globally for public health, and graduates move into roles across medicine, nursing, pharmacy, health law and health policy.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in Bioethics requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney or equivalent qualification in the field of science, medicine, nursing, allied health sciences, philosophy/ethics, sociology, anthropology, history, law or other relevant field; or completion of the requirements of an embedded graduate certificate or equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.5 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 64 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Biomedical Sciences (Infection and Immunity)
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Biomedical Sciences (Infection and Immunity) at the University of Sydney trains graduates in clinical laboratory techniques used in infectious disease research and the biomedical industry. Students complete 36 credit points, including core units in clinical laboratory science and immunology principles, plus stream selective units in virology, bacteriology, clinical immunology and immunotherapy.
The course suits recent science and health graduates as well as established scientists or clinicians. Sydney is ranked in the top 20 universities globally and second in Australia for medicine, and graduates gain the research and laboratory skills used in infectious disease containment, diagnosis and treatment.
admission_requirements: Admission to this course requires: A bachelor’s degree or higher award in science, medical or veterinary science, biomedical science, health science or a health-related discipline from the University of Sydney, or qualifications deemed by the Faculty to be equivalent; Or completion of embedded Graduate Certificate.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.5 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 64 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Brain and Mind Sciences
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Brain and Mind Sciences at the University of Sydney prepares science, medical, nursing, psychiatry and psychology professionals to meet the needs of people with disorders of the brain and mind. Students complete 36 credit points, including core units linking basic neuroscience to clinical applications and 24 credit points of elective units offering specialised training with current research methodologies.
The course is delivered through the Brain and Mind Centre. Sydney is ranked second in Australia and 25th in the world for medicine, and graduates move into science, research management and industry roles across biotech, pharmaceutical and government organisations.
admission_requirements: A successful applicant for admission to the Graduate Diploma in Brain and Mind Sciences will: have completed the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate in this discipline from the University of Sydney, or equivalent qualification; or hold a bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline from the University of Sydney or equivalent qualification; and satisfactorily perform at an interview where required
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Building Performance and Sustainable Design
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Building Performance and Sustainable Design at the University of Sydney develops breadth and depth of disciplinary skills and knowledge for a career as an environmentally sustainable design consultant or in other sustainability and building science-focused roles. Students choose electives applying sustainable design theories and methods to architecture, urban planning, building performance or project management.
The course develops technical, collaborative and cultural competencies to drive world-leading environmental outcomes in interdisciplinary teams and projects. Graduates move into environmentally sustainable design consulting, property development, construction management and urban planning roles.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in Building Performance and Sustainable Design requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate with an average mark of at least 70. Graduate Diploma students may apply to upgrade to the Masters at the completion of their program.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Business Law
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Business Law at the University of Sydney Law School gives lawyers and non-lawyers specialist legal expertise in commercial, corporate and taxation law. Students complete four units of study chosen from more than 70 electives, one of the largest collections in the Law School's postgraduate program, with students who lack a law degree also completing a foundational legal reasoning unit.
The course suits professionals in business, finance and corporate roles who want advanced training in legal regulation, whether to up-skill in their existing role or move into business regulation and policy.
admission_requirements: Admission to the course requires a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney; or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Cancer and Haematology Nursing
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Cancer and Haematology Nursing is a specialisation stream within the University of Sydney's Master of Nursing, for registered nurses and graduate-entry students who want advanced practice in cancer and blood disorder care. Study builds on the Master of Nursing's core units in anatomy, pathophysiology, pharmacology and person-centred clinical practice, with unit selections focused on oncology and haematology nursing.
The course is accredited by the Australian Nursing and Midwifery Accreditation Council. Graduates work in cancer centres, haematology wards and community oncology services across Australia's public and private health systems.
admission_requirements: You must have: a previous Australian level bachelor degree (or equivalent) in any discipline other than nursing, AND this qualification has been completed within 10 years prior to applying Overseas nursing qualifications are acceptable. See our Master of Nursing Admissions Guide (pdf, 1.00MB) for more information.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 7.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Clinical Dentistry (Surgical Dentistry)
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Clinical Dentistry (Surgical Dentistry) at the University of Sydney develops the clinical techniques qualified dentists need for oral surgery in general practice. Students complete 48 credit points and a research project in oral surgery each semester, covering oral medicine, oral pathology and dental implants under the direction of specialist clinical staff.
The course is designed for local and international dentists who want to build surgical dentistry skills and a basis for further specialist training toward registration with the Australian Dental Board, or a career in research and clinical academia. Sydney's dental school has trained practitioners for more than a century.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 7.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Clinical Epidemiology
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Clinical Epidemiology at the University of Sydney extends the graduate certificate to 36 credit points, giving clinicians and clinical researchers a fuller grounding in research design, biostatistics and evidence-based practice. The course is delivered fully online with optional face-to-face components and can be studied full-time or part-time.
Students receive structured training across the clinical research pathway, from concept and design through statistical analysis to translating findings into policy and guidelines. It suits health professionals and clinical researchers and credits toward the University of Sydney's Master of Medicine (Clinical Epidemiology).
admission_requirements: Admission to the course requires: a medical degree from the University of Sydney or an equivalent qualification; or a bachelors degree in a health-related discipline with first or second class honours from the University of Sydney or equivalent qualification; or a pass bachelors degree in a health-related discipline from the University of Sydney or equivalent qualification. Applicants must have completed work equivalent to a first or second class honours bachelors degree or pass a preliminary examination(s) as prescribed by the Faculty; or completion of the first 4 years of an undergraduate medical degree that is accredited by the Australian Medical Council, and a letter of recommendation from the head of clinical school/medical program supporting concurrent enrolment while completing degree requirements. All students entering the program are expected to have some clinical experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Coaching Psychology
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Coaching Psychology at the University of Sydney is an entry point into the University's Master of Science in Coaching Psychology, an applied positive psychology program sitting at the intersection of counselling, clinical and organisational psychology. Students build the theoretical and applied skills to coach in settings including executive, management and personal coaching, using a client-centred approach to help individuals and organisations achieve their goals.
The University of Sydney's coaching psychology program is the world's first and longest-running of its kind. Graduates move into human resource development, private practice, organisational consultancy and executive coaching roles.
admission_requirements: Admission to this degree requires: An undergraduate degree with Honours in Psychology or a postgraduate degree in a cognate discipline from the University of Sydney or equivalent institution; and a minimum of three years relevant employment experience* *Relevant work experience may include counselling, experience in organisational learning and development, management experience, employment in applied psychology settings, professional coaching or other areas directly related to coaching.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 105; PTE Academic 78 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Commerce
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Commerce at the University of Sydney Business School is a one-year qualification for graduates from another discipline, or applicants with relevant qualifications and work experience, who want a global, adaptable business skillset before progressing to a master's. Students complete core, foundational, selective and elective units chosen from disciplines including accounting, business information systems, business analytics, economics, finance, global logistics and marketing.
The course develops advanced skills for high-level positions in industry, commerce and government, with career paths spanning accounting, marketing and a broad range of other business specialisations.
admission_requirements: To be considered for admission, an applicant is required to have: an Australian bachelor's degree or higher with a minimum 60 percent average or equivalent qualification, or the University of Sydney Graduate Certificate in Commerce with a credit average (65 percent).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Communication Disorders
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Communication Disorders sits within the University of Sydney's speech pathology program, preparing graduate-entry students to assess and treat communication and swallowing difficulties across the lifespan. Coursework covers speech pathology theory and practice, and students from any prior discipline can enter the program.
Graduates work with children and adults experiencing difficulties with speaking, understanding language, reading, writing, voice, stuttering or swallowing, across hospitals, private practice, schools and early childhood services. The University of Sydney is ranked 25th in the world for life sciences and medicine.
admission_requirements: To be eligible to apply you will need to fulfil the following criteria: An Australian bachelor's degree, master's or PhD from an Australian institution or equivalent. A minimum average mark of 60 out of 100 or equivalent (GPA of 4.5 out of 7). This does not guarantee an offer as the places are limited and offers are made based on academic merit. Evidence of any other minimum standards specified by the Faculty of Medicine and Health. For domestic applicants, the Indigenous Facilitated Entry Scheme and the Rural Applicants Facilitated Entry Scheme are available for eligible applicants. Please refer to the Sydney School of Health Sciences Special Admission Pathways Guide for definitions and information on facilitated entry schemes.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 7.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Computer Science
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Computer Science at the University of Sydney offers foundational and specialist computer science units for students with related experience or qualifications who want to build specialist skills. Students can also complete computing professional units required for the Master of Computer Science if they choose to continue their studies.
Graduates take on roles designing, implementing and evaluating computer science solutions across industries, including creating and managing business applications, websites and IT systems for IT companies, consulting firms and financial services. Sydney is ranked first in Australia for computer science and information systems.
admission_requirements: To be eligible for admission, an applicant is required to have: An Australian bachelor’s degree or higher award in a cognate discipline for an equivalent qualification, with a minimum 60 percent average, or Completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate in this discipline or an equivalent qualificationsdeemed by the faculty to be equivalent qualification with a minimum 60 percent average.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Computing
description: The Graduate Diploma in Computing at the University of Sydney, now offered as the Graduate Diploma in Computer Science, is a one-year full-time program for those with related experience and qualifications who want to build specialist computer science skills. It combines technical knowledge, real-world experience and problem solving to develop solutions to technological challenges. Graduates advance in computer science and IT careers. Indicative international tuition is around 55,100 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Diploma in Creative Writing
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Creative Writing at the University of Sydney develops core skills in fiction, nonfiction, poetry and life writing, alongside a deep understanding of relevant literary theory and history. Students complete 48 credit points including selective units and two workshop electives, with access to Sydney's literary life through events such as the Sydney Writers' Festival.
The course suits writers building toward publication as well as those pursuing careers in adjacent fields. Graduates work as fiction and nonfiction authors, poets, journalists, reviewers, editors, publishers and media and communications writers.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature to the course requires: a bachelor's degree with a minimum 60 percent average calculated over the whole degree, from the University of Sydney, including a major in a relevant subject area in the humanities or social sciences, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the requirements for the Graduate Certificate in Creative Writing with a minimum credit (65 percent) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); PTE Academic 64. The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Criminology
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Criminology at the University of Sydney Law School addresses contemporary questions about crime and social control within theoretical and policy contexts, taught by some of Australia's leading criminologists. Students complete four units of study, including the compulsory Explaining Crime unit, with the remainder chosen from a wide range of interdisciplinary electives.
The course suits anyone interested in crime, punishment and criminal justice, and graduates work across criminal justice agencies, government policy, research institutions and non-government organisations.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in Criminology requires a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney; or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Cultural Studies
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Cultural Studies at the University of Sydney examines popular culture, media, gender, sexuality, globalisation and consumer culture, using real-world examples to analyse cultural expressions and their contextual significance. Students complete eight units of study drawn mainly from core electives, gaining insight into identity, self-expression and embodiment.
The course is taught within the Department of Gender and Cultural Studies by scholars including Professor Elspeth Probyn and Professor Catherine Driscoll. Graduates move into government, community, arts, education and communication roles.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in Cultural Studies requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney with a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, including a major in a relevant subject area in the humanities or social sciences, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the requirements for the Graduate Certificate in Cultural Studies with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Cybersecurity
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Cybersecurity at the University of Sydney gives professionals an advanced level of technical knowledge and skills in cybersecurity, along with an understanding of present and emerging trends in the field. Students complete cybersecurity core subjects, computing professional core subjects, cybersecurity specialist electives and an elective or foundation subject.
The course suits professionals developing technical skills for a career in an industry projected to almost triple in size within five years and need over 15,000 additional cybersecurity professionals. Sydney is ranked first in Australia for computer science and information systems.
admission_requirements: To be eligible for admission, an applicant is required to have: a three year Australian bachelor's degree in a cognate discipline with a minimum average of 60 percent, or the University of Sydney Graduate Certificate in Cybersecurity with a minimum average of 60 percent, and a major or minor in information technologies (IT) or computer science, or equivalent in volume of learning as determined by the program directors is required for this discipline
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Data Science
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Data Science at the University of Sydney gives professionals with a strong mathematical or quantitative background an advanced level of knowledge in data mining, machine learning and data visualisation to guide strategic decision making. Students complete data science core subjects, computing professional core subjects, data science specialist electives and elective or foundation subjects.
Graduates can pursue roles including analytics consultant, business analyst, business intelligence specialist, data engineer and data visualisation analyst. Sydney is ranked first in Australia for computer science and information systems.
admission_requirements: To be eligible for admission, an applicant is required to have: a three year Australian bachelor's degree in a cognate discipline that demonstrates a background in computer programming or statistics with a minimum average of 60 percent, or the University of Sydney Graduate Certificate in Data Science with a minimum average of 60 percent.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Design
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Design at the University of Sydney deepens understanding of design's role in the modern business landscape, teaching students to apply design thinking to real-world problems. Core units, advanced core units and electives build skills in communication, information literacy and critical thinking, with a major project focused on either Design Innovation or Strategic Design.
The course provides a foundation for the more intensive theoretical and practical work in the University's Master of Design. Graduates move into roles including strategic designer, design manager, product manager and customer experience designer.
admission_requirements: Admission to this course requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification. Graduate Diploma students may apply to upgrade to the Masters at the completion of their program (with an average mark of at least 70).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Design Science (Building)
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Design Science (Building) at the University of Sydney develops breadth and depth of disciplinary skills for a career as an environmentally sustainable design consultant or in other sustainability and building science-focused roles. Students choose electives applying sustainable design theories and methods to architecture, urban planning, building performance or project management.
The course develops technical, collaborative and cultural competencies to drive world-leading environmental outcomes in interdisciplinary teams. Graduates move into environmentally sustainable design consulting, property development, construction management and urban planning roles.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in Building Performance and Sustainable Design requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate with an average mark of at least 70. Graduate Diploma students may apply to upgrade to the Masters at the completion of their program.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Development Studies
description: The Graduate Diploma in Development Studies at the University of Sydney is offered within the Master of Social Justice (Development Studies). Students address development policy and debate with experts across anthropology, international relations, political economy, public health, human geography, economics and sociology, in a research-driven environment with industry connections. Graduates work in international development, humanitarian and policy roles. Indicative international tuition is around 51,300 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Diploma in Digital Communication and Culture
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Digital Communication and Culture at the University of Sydney examines internet platforms, social media, digital audiences, mobile media, online governance and computer games, building a critical understanding of digital technologies and their cultural contexts. Students study the aesthetics and politics of computer games, the circulation of knowledge in the digital era, and how the internet is regulated, choosing electives that suit their career direction.
The course suits professionals moving into digital content, mobile telecommunications and computer entertainment roles. Graduates work as creatives in television, radio and games, digital and print journalists, and educators.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in Digital Communication and Culture requires: a bachelor's degree with a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the embedded Graduate Certificate in Digital Communication and Culture with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Economic Analysis
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Economic Analysis at the University of Sydney is a challenging program for high-achieving students with a strong background in economics and quantitative methods, covering advanced core and elective studies in microeconomics, macroeconomics, econometrics and mathematical economics. Small class sizes support close interaction with academic staff, and the course can serve as a pathway to the Master of Economic Analysis.
Graduates move into technical roles such as economist, analyst, adviser and consultant with employers including central banks, financial institutions and regulatory authorities. The School of Economics is taught by economists whose research influences policy at the Reserve Bank of Australia and the Treasury.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in Economic Analysis requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, including a major in Economics with a minimum high distinction (85%) average, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the embedded Graduate Certificate in Economic Analysis with a minimum distinction (75%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.5 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 64 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Economics
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Economics at the University of Sydney builds critical thinking, data analysis and problem-solving skills for a career in the public or private sector, suited to students with little or no prior background in economics. Students complete foundation units in microeconomics, macroeconomics, econometrics and quantitative methods, then advanced core units including communication in an economic context, with a pathway to progress into the full Master of Economics.
Graduates move into roles such as analyst, researcher, adviser and consultant with financial institutions, regulatory authorities, government departments and consultancies. The School of Economics is taught by economists whose research influences policy at the Reserve Bank of Australia and the Treasury.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in Economics requires: a bachelor's degree, from the University of Sydney with a minimum 60% average or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the requirements for the embedded Graduate Certificate with a minimum pass average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Educational Studies
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Educational Studies at the University of Sydney lets trained teachers and education professionals choose units across educational management and leadership, educational psychology, international education, special and inclusive education, sports coaching, and teaching English to speakers of other languages. Students complete 48 credit points, split between core and selective units of study.
The course suits teaching professionals, educational administrators, researchers and policymakers who want deeper specialisation than the graduate certificate offers, with a pathway to progress into the full Master of Education.
admission_requirements: Admission to this course requires: (i) a bachelor degree or higher in a cognate discipline from the University of Sydney or equivalent; OR (ii) a bachelor honours degree or postgraduate qualification in a non-cognate discipline from the University of Sydney or equivalent qualification; OR (iii) a graduate certificate in the same stream as that in which the applicant wishes to proceed, or equivalent.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Emergency Nursing
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Emergency Nursing is a specialisation stream within the University of Sydney's Master of Nursing, aimed at registered nurses and graduate-entry students moving into emergency and trauma care. Core units in anatomy, pathophysiology, pharmacology and person-centred clinical practice are paired with emergency-focused clinical placements and coursework.
The program is accredited by the Australian Nursing and Midwifery Accreditation Council and prepares graduates for registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia. Sydney's nursing graduates work across emergency departments, trauma units and acute care settings in Australia and internationally.
admission_requirements: You must have: a previous Australian level bachelor degree (or equivalent) in any discipline other than nursing, AND this qualification has been completed within 10 years prior to applying Overseas nursing qualifications are acceptable. See our Master of Nursing Admissions Guide (pdf, 1.00MB) for more information.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 7.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Engineering
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Engineering at the University of Sydney gives engineering graduates a major component of the higher-level specialisation needed to excel in a chosen field, ahead of a full master's degree. Students complete core and specialist units chosen from disciplines including automation and manufacturing systems, biomedical engineering, civil engineering, electrical engineering and software engineering.
The course suits engineers seeking intermediate career advancement or building toward a master's degree in their chosen engineering discipline at the University of Sydney.
admission_requirements: To be eligible for admission, an applicant is required to have: an Australian Bachelor of Engineering degree in the relevant discipline with a credit average (65 percent) or equivalent qualification, or an Australian Bachelor of Engineering degree in the relevant discipline or equivalent, and five years relevant professional work experience
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in English Studies
description:
The Graduate Diploma in English Studies at the University of Sydney brings contemporary critical theory together with literary narratives across four core approaches: critical reading, literary history, genre, and English as world literature. Students complete 48 credit points spanning medieval to contemporary literature and cultural theory, with the option to take creative writing units.
The course suits research students, secondary school teachers and anyone studying English literature at an advanced level. Graduates move into secondary teaching, journalism, writing, literary criticism and academia.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in English Studies requires: a bachelor's degree with a major in English Literature and a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the Graduate Certificate in English Studies with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Environmental Law
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Environmental Law at the University of Sydney Law School covers one of law's most rapidly expanding areas of specialisation, examining the legal issues arising from natural resource protection, pollution prevention and urban planning. Students complete four units of study, including the compulsory Environmental Law and Policy unit, with students who lack a law degree also completing a foundational legal reasoning unit.
The course suits both legal and non-legal professionals working in or aiming for environmental law, economics, government or social work.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for this course requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney; or an equivalent qualification
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Environmental Science
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Environmental Science at the University of Sydney draws on science-based disciplines from ecology to solar power and analytical chemistry to geomorphology, giving students a grounding in environmental issues. Over one year, students complete eight selective units linking environmental science with politics, law, project evaluation and conflict resolution, choosing electives including marine science, international development and geographic information systems.
The course suits new graduates and professionals wanting formal environmental qualifications. Graduates work as analytical scientists, environmental indicator monitors, policy-makers and catchment managers, with alumni employed across state and federal government bodies.
admission_requirements: For admission into this course, you should have: a Bachelor of Science or higher with a credit average in one of the following disciplines: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Ecology, Climate and Atmospheric Sciences, Marine Science, Geology, Geography, Environmental Studies, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Economics, Environmental Archaeology, Sustainability, Agriculture, Forestry, and Natural Resource Management; or equivalent qualification; or a Bachelor of Science (Honours) or postgraduate qualification in a non-cognate discipline or equivalent qualification; or completion of the embedded Graduate Certificate in Environmental Science, from the University of Sydney, or equivalent qualification. A credit average means a minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 65.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Global Health
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Global Health at the University of Sydney examines the social, environmental, economic and political drivers of ill health and health inequity around the world. Students from health and non-health backgrounds study foundational global health concepts, biostatistics and epidemiology, along with placement opportunities that connect coursework to real global health settings.
The course prepares graduates for roles such as monitoring and evaluation officer, public health policy adviser, and public health officer within government, non-government and international aid organisations. Sydney is ranked first in Australia and tenth globally for public health.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Master of Global Health degree requires: a bachelor's degree with honours or a graduate certificate or graduate diploma from the University of Sydney or an equivalent qualification or a bachelor's degree in the field of medicine, nursing, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, optometry, pharmacy, dentistry, veterinary science, psychology, biological science, medical science, international relations, international development, education, social science, political science, communication and journalism, civil engineering, law, economics or mathematics from the University of Sydney or an equivalent qualification or a bachelor's degree in an unrelated field and two years professional work experience in health or international development.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Health Policy and Planning
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Health Policy and Planning at the University of Sydney gives students a practical understanding of how health systems and policy-making processes work, moving beyond administration into strategic decision-making and systems thinking. Over 36 credit points, four core units and two electives, delivered in intensive mode with weekend workshops and web-based learning, cover health financing, politics, agenda setting and the critical use of evidence.
The course suits people building a career in health policy as well as practitioners wanting to move into strategic roles, preparing graduates for government, advocacy, regulation and health service leadership positions.
admission_requirements: Admission to this course requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, or equivalent qualification and a minimum of 1 year work experience in a health or policy related field; or have completed the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate, or equivalent qualification
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Health Technology Innovation
Graduate Diploma in Heritage Conservation
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Heritage Conservation at the University of Sydney equips graduates to practise heritage conservation as an ethic of care grounded in intergenerational equity and cross-cultural understanding. Coursework develops competencies in documenting and assessing culturally significant places, formulating heritage policy, and understanding the legal frameworks that govern heritage practice, engaging with contemporary debates such as sustainability and climate change.
Graduates work as heritage consultants, planners, policy experts, educators and architectural conservation specialists across the public sector, private practice and community organisations. The University of Sydney is ranked among the world's top 25 universities.
admission_requirements: (a) a bachelor degree from the University of Sydney or an equivalent qualification; or (b) completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate with a credit average mark.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management & Industrial Relations
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management and Industrial Relations at the University of Sydney Business School is based on the University's master's degree but requires fewer units, giving students a sound understanding of employment, HR and ethical leadership issues. It suits students who want to develop skills to respond to changes reshaping local and international workplaces, with a pathway to progress to the full master's.
Core units cover the foundations of HR and industrial relations, emerging workplace challenges, HR strategy and HR data insights, with electives in cross-cultural management and employment law. Graduates move into human resource manager, workplace relations manager and industrial relations advisor roles.
admission_requirements: To be considered for admission, an applicant is required to have: an Australian bachelor's degree or higher (minimum 60 percent average) or equivalent qualification, or an Australian bachelor's degree or higher with a pass average (minimum 50 percent) or equivalent qualification, and satisfactory performance in the GMAT (for guidance, the class average score is 590) or GMAT Focus Edition (for guidance, the class average score is 555) or equivalent Business School approved admissions test, or the University of Sydney Graduate Certificate in Human Resource Management and Industrial Relations with a credit average (65 percent).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Human Rights
description: The Graduate Diploma in Human Rights at the University of Sydney is offered within the Master of Social Justice (Human Rights). Students gain a critical understanding of the roots of human rights violations and the tools and mechanisms used to promote and protect them, and develop skills in research, analysis, communication and advocacy for domestic, regional and international contexts. Graduates work in advocacy, policy, research and humanitarian roles. Indicative international tuition is around 51,300 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Diploma in Information Technology
description: The Graduate Diploma in Information Technology at the University of Sydney, now offered as the Graduate Diploma in Computer Science, is a one-year full-time program for those with related experience and qualifications who want specialist computer science skills. It combines technical knowledge, real-world experience and problem solving to develop solutions to technological challenges. Graduates advance in computer science and IT careers. Indicative international tuition is around 57,900 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Diploma in Information Technology Management
Graduate Diploma in Intensive Care Nursing
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Intensive Care Nursing is a specialisation stream within the University of Sydney's Master of Nursing, for registered nurses and graduate-entry students moving into critical care. It builds on the Master of Nursing's core units in anatomy, pathophysiology, pharmacology and person-centred practice with a focus on intensive and critical care nursing.
The program is accredited by the Australian Nursing and Midwifery Accreditation Council, leading to registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia. Graduates work in intensive care units and high-dependency wards across metropolitan, regional and rural health services.
admission_requirements: You must have: a previous Australian level bachelor degree (or equivalent) in any discipline other than nursing, AND this qualification has been completed within 10 years prior to applying Overseas nursing qualifications are acceptable. See our Master of Nursing Admissions Guide (pdf, 1.00MB) for more information.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 7.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Interaction Design and Electronics Arts
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Interaction Design and Electronics Arts at the University of Sydney builds toward the University's Master of Interaction Design and Electronic Arts, introducing the fundamentals of human-centred design for interactive products and services. Foundation and advanced core units, delivered as design studios and technical workshops, build analytical, design and communication skills for creating and evaluating user experiences.
The course suits people seeking a career in UX, UI or interactive product and service design, or who want to use technology creatively for commercial purposes. Graduates move into roles such as UX/UI designer, interaction designer, product designer and service designer.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Master of Interaction Design and Electronic Arts requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney or an equivalent qualification with a credit average mark across all units; or completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate diploma; or completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate certificate with an average mark of at least 70.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in International Law
description:
The Graduate Diploma in International Law at the University of Sydney Law School prepares students for professional work and academic research in public international law and international policy, developing the skills to navigate legal and policy issues between states, international organisations and individuals. Students complete four units of study, including the compulsory International Law I unit, with the rest chosen from a wide range of electives.
The course suits barristers, judges, solicitors and non-legal professionals in diplomacy, foreign affairs, global business and international relations.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for this course requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney; or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in International Relations
description:
The Graduate Diploma in International Relations at the University of Sydney examines the world's most pressing challenges, including war and peace, social and economic justice, poverty, development and environmental sustainability, through an intellectually rigorous, research-intensive program. Core units introduce key theories, concepts and institutions in international relations, with selective units in specialist areas and electives from related disciplines.
The course suits professionals looking to elevate their understanding of international relations and ground their existing career with practical, skills-building study. Graduates move into international business, consulting, government, journalism and international organisations including the United Nations.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in International Relations requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney with a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the Graduate Certificate in International Relations with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Law
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Law at the University of Sydney Law School lets law graduates and legal practitioners take a broad or tailored program of postgraduate study without committing to a full master's degree, with the option to upgrade later. Students complete four units of study chosen from areas including administrative law and policy, business law, criminology, environmental law, health law, international law, jurisprudence, labour law and taxation law.
The course suits practitioners looking to upgrade their qualifications for career advancement, developing up-to-date legal knowledge and the ability to apply it directly in professional practice.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in Law requires a Bachelor of Laws or Juris Doctor from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Learning Sciences and Technology
Graduate Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Management at the University of Sydney Business School is based on the University's master's degree but requires fewer units, developing specialist skills in one of the world's fastest-growing business sectors. Core units in production and operations management, supply chain analysis, global distribution strategy and sustainable logistics build a future-focused, analytics-driven skillset.
Graduates are in high demand across procurement, manufacturing, shipping, airlines, freight and retail, moving into roles such as logistics manager, supply chain director and procurement manager, with a pathway to progress into the full master's degree.
admission_requirements: To be considered for admission to the Graduate Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Management, an applicant is required to have: a bachelor’s degree or higher qualification (or equivalent) at an institution approved by the Business School and graded at a standard acceptable to the Business School; satisfaction of the English language requirements; and any other minimum standards specified by the Business School; or completion of the requirements of the Graduate Certificate in Logistics and Supply Chain Management from the University of Sydney with a minimum credit average, or equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Marine Science and Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Marine Science and Management at the University of Sydney gives students hands-on experience at leading Australian coastal field sites, covering coastal management, environmental modelling, geographic information science, ecological statistics and marine and coastal law. Students complete 24 credit points of core units and 24 credit points of electives, tackling real-world challenges facing coasts and oceans.
The course suits new graduates building a career in marine science, management or policy. Graduates move into roles including marine ecologist, coastal manager, environmental consultant, marine data scientist and coastal modeller, working with government agencies that manage coastal and marine resources.
admission_requirements: Admission to this course requires: A Bachelor of Science in the discipline of biology, chemistry, physics, mathematics, ecology, climate and atmospheric sciences, marine science, geosciences, geography, geology environmental studies, environmental engineering, civil engineering, aquaculture, agriculture or natural resource management, or equivalent qualification or; Completion of the embedded graduate certificate in this discipline, from the University of Sydney, or equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Media Practice
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Media Practice at the University of Sydney strengthens written and verbal communication skills alongside production skills in print, broadcast and online media, building a sophisticated understanding of media, audiences and global media environments. Students complete 48 credit points, including at least 24 credit points of core units of study.
The course suits practising media professionals and marketing and communications workers who want to update their skills or explore a new career direction. Graduates have established careers in prominent national and international media organisations across journalism, content production and corporate communications.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in Media Practice requires: a bachelor's degree with a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the Graduate Certificate in Media Practice with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Medical Physics
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Medical Physics at the University of Sydney provides specialist postgraduate training in radiation physics, artificial intelligence, dosimetry, imaging, radiobiology and radiation protection for medical conditions including cancer. Students complete 48 credit points of core units spanning radiation and nuclear physics, dosimetry, nuclear medicine, radiotherapy physics and medical imaging physics.
Sydney's School of Physics is the country's leading physics department, with access to supercomputers and modern laboratories. Graduates work across diagnostic systems such as X-ray and ultrasound, and can progress to the Master of Medical Physics to qualify as a clinical medical physicist.
admission_requirements: Admission to this course requires: a Bachelor of Science or a Bachelor of Engineering with a major in the discipline of physics.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 85; PTE Academic 64 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Medicine
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Medicine at the University of Sydney is a staged entry point within the University's Doctor of Medicine, for graduates of any discipline building toward a medical career. Coursework follows the same prescribed sequence of core units used across the MD, covering basic and clinical sciences through eight vertical themes.
Students who complete the diploma and continue to the full Doctor of Medicine become eligible for provisional registration with the Medical Board of Australia. A biomedical science degree is not required to begin, and Sydney is ranked 27th globally for medicine.
admission_requirements: To be eligible for admission to the Doctor of Medicine in 2027, applicants* must meet the following requirements: Satisfactory performance** in an eligible bachelor’s degree at the time of application, as indicated by Grade Point Average (GPA); and Satisfactory performance** in an admissions test - Domestic applicants must submit eligible Graduate Australian Medical School Admissions Test (GAMSAT) results with their application. International applicants must submit eligible GAMSAT or Medical College Admission Test (MCAT) results with their application. *Applicants applying via the Indigenous Facilitated Entry Scheme should refer to Part 3.1 of the Domestic Admissions Guide **Satisfactory performance is defined in the relevant Admissions Guide. Eligible GAMSAT results: The University will ONLY accept GAMSAT results from one or more of the following tests for admission to the MD in 2027: September 2024, March 2025, September 2025 or March 2026. Applicants for the Dubbo Stream must also provide a Personal Statement (docx, 61KB) in the template form demonstrating a genuine interest, intention and aptitude for practising medicine in rural and regional areas. Please note that the Dubbo Stream is available to domestic applicants only. The University reserves the right to ask applicants to participate in further assessment using other selection tools. Applicants will be given due notice of any additional requirements. Please click on the links below for the Admissions Guide: MD Domestic Admissions Guide (pdf, 1.28MB) MD International Admissions Guide (pdf, 696KB) Indigenous Facilitated Entry Scheme (For domestic applicants only) For Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants with a bachelor’s degree. (From 2027 entry onwards, the GAMSAT requirement will be waived for applicants applying via the Indigenous Facilitated Entry Scheme.) For Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants with a postgraduate degree Rural Applicants Facilitated Entry Scheme (For domestic applicants only) For Australian rural origin applicants as defined by the Australian government Please refer to the MD Domestic Admissions Guide (pdf, 1.28MB) for definitions and information on facilitated entry schemes. Important information Disclaimer Please note Sydney Medical School regularly reviews the admission criteria and application processes for its courses including the Doctor of Medicine. It reserves the right to change these criteria and processes without notice. Information on this website provides advice about the currently applicable criteria and processes, and may not be correct for future application periods. Applicants are advised to consult this website on a regular basis for any changes to entry criteria or program updates. Other requirements prior to commencement of the MD Students who accept a place in the MD will be required to provide a current approved First Aid Certificate and meet Clinical Compliance requirements. First Aid qualification (details are outlined in the Admissions Guide) NSW Ministry of Health Compliance Checking NSW Working with Children Check (WWCC) Post-degree Registration Requirements: Learn about registration, internships, and practice in Australia and other countries (pdf, 79KB). Additional costs Additional costs are involved pre-application and during the application process. Admission test fees - GAMSAT / MCAT Domestic UAC Qualifications Assessment Service (QAS) - GPA calculation (please refer to Part 6.3) International application processing fee (University) You can also expect further costs if you enrol in the program: First Aid Certificate and Clinical Compliance (see above). Specific equipment and supplies required for the course. Overseas health cover (international students only). The University provides a guide for living away from home costs . Deferral Applicants should be prepared and ready to commence the course in the year for which they have applied. Applications for deferral of enrolment following offer and acceptance of a place in the Doctor of Medicine will only be considered under exceptional circumstances that could not have been foreseen at the time of application, and require the approval of the relevant delegate. Transfer Transfer of enrolment between medical schools is not possible, other than in exceptional circumstances. Applications for transfer for 2027 close on 30 September 2026. Find more information on transfers and the Transfer Application Form (pdf, 92KB). Change in immigration status International applicants and students who change from international to domestic status can find the relevant rules here (pdf, 106KB). Disability and inclusion The University is dedicated to ensuring that all students have equal access to learning. You are not obligated to disclose a disability or medical condition to the University, but if you would like to access academic or environment-related adjustments, disclosing enables us to determine the kind of assistance that could be most useful to you. All MD students are required to meet the Inherent Requirements for Medicine: https://sydney.edu.au/students/student-responsibilities/inherent-requirements.html Applicants who require adjustments for their future MD studies should contact the Faculty Admissions Office at fmh.admissions@sydney.edu.au in the first instance. The team will guide you to the University’s Inclusion and Disability Services for further information. Impermissible conduct Sydney Medical School reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to reject an application for admission or to vary or cancel an offer of admission if an applicant’s conduct during the admissions process or prior to enrolment causes Sydney Medical School to form the view that the applicant is unsuitable for admission to the MD. Examples of conduct that might make an applicant unsuitable for admission to the MD include (but are not limited to): failure by the applicant to treat University of Sydney employees, students, applicants or other members of the University community with respect and courtesy, including failure to use appropriate language and tone in written or verbal communications; failure by the applicant to act honestly and ethically in their dealings with University of Sydney employees, students, applicants or other members of the University community; conduct that results in the applicant being excluded from another higher education institution, or from a course or program offered by another higher education institution; conduct that gives Sydney Medical School reasonable cause to believe that enrolling the applicant in clinical training may place them, their peers, or members of the public at risk of harm; and conduct that results in the applicant being charged with a criminal offence.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 7.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Mental Health Nursing
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Mental Health Nursing is a specialisation stream within the University of Sydney's Master of Nursing, for registered nurses and graduate-entry students moving into mental health care. It draws on the Master of Nursing's core units in pathophysiology, pharmacology and culturally safe, person-centred practice, with unit selections focused on mental health nursing.
The program is accredited by the Australian Nursing and Midwifery Accreditation Council and leads toward registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia. Graduates work in mental health wards, community mental health teams and specialist services across Australia.
admission_requirements: You must have: a previous Australian level bachelor degree (or equivalent) in any discipline other than nursing, AND this qualification has been completed within 10 years prior to applying Overseas nursing qualifications are acceptable. See our Master of Nursing Admissions Guide (pdf, 1.00MB) for more information.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 7.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 72 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Museum and Heritage Studies
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Museum and Heritage Studies at the University of Sydney gives students a contextual understanding of core historical and theoretical developments in the field, alongside practical frameworks for managing collections and heritage sites. Students complete 48 credit points across core and elective units, building skills in object and site research, significance assessment, archival research and exhibition development.
The course draws on the University's museum collections and ties to institutions including the Art Gallery of New South Wales and the Australian Museum. Graduates move into museum education, collection management, heritage site interpretation and cultural policy roles.
admission_requirements: Admission to candidature for the Graduate Diploma in Museum and Heritage Studies requires: a bachelor's degree with a major in one of Anthropology, Archaeology, Art History, Cultural Geography, Cultural Studies, Education, English, Gender Studies, History, Indigenous Studies or another major with an equivalent skills and knowledge base; and a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the Graduate Certificate in Museum and Heritage Studies with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Music (Opera)
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Music (Opera) at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music, delivered through the Master of Music Studies (Opera Performance), develops the technical and interpretive qualities of the voice as an operatic instrument. Intensive study covers singing, languages, role preparation, repertoire, stagecraft, acting, dance and opera history, with two staged operas performed with orchestra each year.
The course suits advanced graduates and young professional singers extending their operatic performance skills. Located close to the Sydney Opera House, the Conservatorium prepares graduates for careers as opera singers, concert singers, professional ensemble members, singing teachers and music broadcasters.
admission_requirements: Admission requires: a master's degree in an appropriate discipline as determined by the Sydney Conservatorium of Music; or a pass bachelor's degree with a credit average, or an honours bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline as determined by the Conservatorium; or an award of graduate diploma from the University of Sydney, or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline as determined by the Conservatorium; or completion of the requirements of the embedded graduate diploma in this discipline from the University of Sydney, or equivalent qualification; and successful completion of an audition. Available places will be offered to qualified applicants in the order in which complete applications are received, and according to the admissions criteria. Applicants who do not have a recognised tertiary award but who demonstrate an equivalent musical ability and maturity at the audition and interview, and who can show considerable performing experience may be admitted.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Peace and Conflict Studies
description: The Graduate Diploma in Peace and Conflict Studies at the University of Sydney is offered within the Master of Social Justice (Peace and Conflict Studies). Students explore the intellectual and practical challenges of attaining peace with justice, from reconciliation after mass violence to the role of the United Nations in peacekeeping and peace building, tailoring the program to their interests and goals. Graduates work in peacebuilding, humanitarian, policy and research roles. Indicative international tuition is around 51,300 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Diploma in Political Economy
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Political Economy at the University of Sydney examines how political, institutional, social, cultural and historical factors shape economic life, giving students a deeper knowledge of current economic challenges and trends than the graduate certificate. Core units survey the history of economics, economic theory and Australian political economy, with selective units in specialist areas.
The course suits students seeking a career in social or policy analysis and research. The University of Sydney has the largest number of political economists in Australia, and graduates work in state and federal treasuries, research institutions, government and the media.
admission_requirements: Admission to the Graduate Diploma in Political Economy requires: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney with a minimum 60% average calculated over the whole degree, including a major in the social sciences, or an equivalent qualification; or completion of the Graduate Certificate in Political Economy with a minimum credit (65%) average, or an equivalent qualification.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Primary Health Care
description: The Graduate Diploma in Primary Health Care at the University of Sydney, offered as the Graduate Diploma in Medicine (General Practice and Primary Health Care), is a one-year full-time program that extends knowledge and skills across areas such as dermatology, diabetes and metabolic health, paediatrics, internal medicine, mental health and clinical teaching. It is designed for doctors across all levels of experience. Graduates strengthen their general practice and primary care practice. Indicative international tuition is around 48,900 Australian dollars per year.

name: Graduate Diploma in Professional Accounting
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Professional Accounting at the University of Sydney Business School builds toward the University's Master of Professional Accounting and Business Performance, developed with industry input and taught across seven Business School disciplines. Coursework builds analytics, technology and communication skills alongside core accounting expertise, including experience with cloud-based accounting platforms.
The course suits students who want deeper accounting training than the graduate certificate offers, without committing to the full master's immediately. Graduates move into roles such as financial analyst, tax and estate adviser, and financial and management accountant.
admission_requirements: To be considered for admission, an applicant is required to have: Australian bachelor's degree or higher with a credit average (65 percent) or equivalent qualification, or Australian bachelor's degree or higher (minimum 50 percent required) or equivalent qualification, and satisfactory performance in the GMAT (for guidance, the class average score is 630) or GMAT Focus Edition (for guidance, the class average score is 585), or University of Sydney Graduate Diploma in Professional Accounting and Business Performance with a credit average (65 percent).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (minimum 6.0 in each band); TOEFL iBT 96; PTE Academic 72 (minimum 60 in each band). The University of Sydney also accepts its Sydney International College and USYD College pathway programs.

name: Graduate Diploma in Professional Accounting and Business Performance
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Professional Accounting and Business Performance at the University of Sydney Business School is based on the University's master's degree but requires fewer units, exposing students to the organisational, regulatory and market context accountants work within. Students complete six core units and two electives, learning to solve accounting and business problems in innovative ways that drive organisational performance.
The course suits students seeking a substantial accounting qualification without the full master's commitment. Graduates move into roles such as financial controller, company secretary, financial analyst, tax and estate adviser, and auditor.
