admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Mathematics Advanced; any two units of English; any two units of Science. Chemistry, Mathematics Advanced are recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Forensic Science
description:
The Bachelor of Forensic Science at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers crime scene, laboratory, courtroom and intelligence processes through core subjects, then a major in analysing biological traces, chemical substances, crime scenes or digital data. Teaching is by the UTS Centre for Forensic Science, using the Super Lab and crime scene simulation facilities.
Graduates of the chemistry major are eligible for membership of the Royal Australian Chemical Institute and the Australian and New Zealand Forensic Science Society. Study takes three years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 65242 Principles of Forensic Science; 65342 Crime Scene Investigation; 35255 Forensic Statistics; 65312 Forensic Imaging; 65313 Forensic Intelligence; 65314 Complex Cases; 65315 Forensic Research Project.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Mathematics; any two units of English; any two units of Science Chemistry and Biology are recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Games Development
description:
The Bachelor of Games Development at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) builds skills in game design, programming and industry-standard game engines through practical, team-based projects. Students learn problem analysis and decision-making in games development, teamwork, and the ethical, legal and political dimensions of technology.
Commonwealth Supported Places are available to eligible Australian students. Graduates are eligible to apply for Australian Computer Society professional membership, and work in games and the wider software industry. Study takes three years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 31265 Communication for IT Professionals; 43030 Professional Practice in Computing; 31268 Web Systems; 31269 Business Requirements Modelling; 41092 Network Fundamentals; 31271 Database Fundamentals; 31272 Project Management and the Professional.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Additional application and selection procedures apply for the IDeA version of this course. Assumed knowledge: HSC Mathematics Advanced and any two units of English. Mathematics Extension 1 and English Advanced are recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Information Systems
description:
The Bachelor of Information Systems at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) focuses on how technology supports organisations across business, government, health and community settings. It is 144 credit points: 60 credit points of information systems core subjects, 36 credit points of studio subjects, a compulsory stream choice, and 24 credit points of electives.
Graduates are eligible to apply for Australian Computer Society professional membership. Study takes three years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 31266 Introduction to Information Systems; 31265 Communication for IT Professionals; 48023 Programming Fundamentals; 31271 Database Fundamentals; 41092 Network Fundamentals; 41191 Business Intelligence; 31272 Project Management and the Professional.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: HSC Mathematics Advanced and any two units of English. Mathematics Extension 1 and English Advanced are recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Information Technology
description:
The Bachelor of Information Technology at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers software development, data and cybersecurity, and prepares graduates for roles as information systems professionals, systems developers, network specialists and computing researchers. It is 144 credit points and includes industry projects and real-world experience through the UTS network of industry partners.
Graduates are eligible to apply for Australian Computer Society professional membership. Study takes three years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 31265 Communication for IT Professionals; 43030 Professional Practice in Computing; 31268 Web Systems; 31269 Business Requirements Modelling; 41092 Network Fundamentals; 31271 Database Fundamentals; 31272 Project Management and the Professional.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: HSC Mathematics Advanced and any two units of English. Mathematics Extension 1 and English Advanced are recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Information Technology Diploma in Information Technology Professional Practice
description:
The Bachelor of Information Technology Diploma in Information Technology Professional Practice at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) combines the IT degree with a Diploma in Professional Practice, adding paid industry placements to the standard curriculum in network design, systems administration and software integration.
Study takes four years full-time, including the placement periods. Graduates are eligible to apply for Australian Computer Society professional membership. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 40008 Career Management; 41038 Professional Practice Review 1; 41048 Professional Practice Review 2; 31265 Communication for IT Professionals; 43030 Professional Practice in Computing; 31268 Web Systems; 31269 Business Requirements Modelling.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: HSC Mathematics Advanced and any two units of English. Mathematics Extension 1 and English Advanced are recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Landscape Architecture (Honours)
description:
The Bachelor of Landscape Architecture (Honours) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-year degree covering ecology, infrastructure, construction and professional communication, taught through studio-based learning. Students design responses to challenges such as biodiversity loss and climate change, and take part in site visits, field trips, travelling studios and an optional semester exchange.
The course is accredited by the Australian Institute of Landscape Architects, and graduates can begin the pathway to professional registration. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 11119 Landscape Architecture Studio 1; 11128 Communications 1; 11130 Landscape Architecture Studio 3; 11172 Landscape History and Theory 1; 11174 Landscape History and Theory 2; 11177 Botany; 11180 Construction.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. UTS: Design, Architecture and Building may consider applications based on the results of the Special Tertiary Admissions Test (STAT) if students lack academic qualifications but have extensive professional experience. The STAT is conducted through Australian Council for Educational Research (ACER). Students must refer to the inherent requirements for all degrees offered by Design and Architecture in the Faculty of Design, Architecture and Building.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Laws (Honours)
description:
The Bachelor of Laws (Honours) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an exit-only course completed in the final year of the UTS Bachelor of Laws. Students either pursue Honours in Legal Futures and Technology, focusing on how technology and innovation intersect with the law, or complete a supervised research thesis on a legal topic supported by options subjects in areas such as criminology, privacy, media law and jurisprudence.
The course satisfies the academic requirements for admission as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW; students also need practical legal training, taken within the course or separately. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70102 Foundations of Law; 70311 Torts; 70211 Contracts; 70103 Ethics Law and Justice; 70104 Civil Practice; 70327 Introduction to Property and Commercial Law; 70317 Real Property.
admission_requirements: . Assumed knowledge: Proficiency in English.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Management
description:
The Bachelor of Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for students who want strong leadership and management skills alongside a specialisation. Students choose a major early, in an area such as events, sport, sustainable enterprise or entrepreneurship, then complete core subjects including Management Skills, Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Managing Legal Issues, and a Managing for Social Impact capstone.
Study takes three years full-time, with the option to add a second major, sub-major, professional internship or electives. Graduates apply leadership, strategic thinking and problem-solving across industries. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21440 Management Skills; 24109 Marketing and Customer Value; 21654 Socio-political Context of Management; 21227 Innovation and Entrepreneurship; 21665 Managing Legal Issues; 21643 Innovation Lab; 21698 Managing for Social Impact (Capstone).
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Any two units of English.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Marine Biology and Climate Change
description:
The Bachelor of Marine Biology and Climate Change at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers coral reef and aquatic ecosystems, the impacts of climate change, and environmental protection and management, built on eight foundational science subjects in biology, chemistry and the natural world. Students can take electives in policy, law, tourism and business, and complete an internship for academic credit.
The course is recognised by the Australian Marine Sciences Association. Study takes three years full-time. Graduates work in marine ecology, government policy and research. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 60006 Scientific Perspectives for Global Issues; 65111 Chemistry 1; 91107 The Biosphere; 33116 Design, Data, and Decisions; 91123 Nature and Evolution; 91161 Cell Biology and Genetics; 91132 Molecular Biology.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Mathematics; any two units of English; any two units of science.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Mathematical Sciences
description:
The Bachelor of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers pure and applied mathematics, statistics, complex analysis and programming through core subjects, then a major stream aligned to a career direction. Students can earn academic credit through a relevant internship and take electives from across UTS.
Graduates build predictive models, optimise systems and interpret data for roles in finance, technology, research and analytics. Study takes three years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 33130 Mathematics 1; 33230 Mathematics 2; 37242 Introduction to Optimisation; 37181 Discrete Mathematics; 37161 Probability and Random Variables; 35007 Mathematics 3; 37262 Mathematical Statistics.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Mathematics Advanced, any two units of English Mathematics Extension 1 is recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Medical Science
description: The Bachelor of Medical Science at UTS is designed for students seeking to impact human health and pursue further studies in health and science, taught with a hands-on approach by leading researchers and practitioners. The course integrates health science with technical and communication skills, and students specialise in either Medical and Health-related Sciences or Pathology, gaining expertise in pharmacology, immunology and disease treatment, and knowledge of diagnosing diseases, developing medical innovations and communicating scientific information. Learning combines lectures, labs and industry projects with internship opportunities, in the UTS Hive Super Lab and Science Super Lab.

name: Bachelor of Molecular Biotechnology
description:
The Bachelor of Molecular Biotechnology at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) offers a major in either Environmental Biotechnology, covering pollution mitigation, remediation and renewable energy, or Medical Biotechnology, covering molecular biology, microbiology and human genetics. Students can complete an internship for academic credit and take electives from other faculties.
Study takes three years full-time. Graduates work in biomedicine, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics and research. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Mathematics; any two units of English; any two units of Science. Chemistry, Mathematics Extension 1 is recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Nursing
description:
The Bachelor of Nursing at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) prepares students for registration as a Registered Nurse. Core subjects cover anatomy, pharmacology and patient care, alongside clinical placements that build practical experience and skills in critical thinking, communication and patient advocacy.
The program is accredited by the Australian Nursing and Midwifery Accreditation Council and approved by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia. Study takes three years full-time, and graduates work across settings such as intensive care, emergency, community and aged care. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, in line with Board registration standards.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time
Year 1: Foundations of Nursing Practice, Anatomy and Physiology, Health Assessment, first clinical placement block (Session 1)
Year 2: Nursing Care of the Adult, Mental Health Nursing, Child and Family Health, Pharmacology, ongoing clinical placements each session
Year 3: Complex Care Nursing, Aged Care, Community and Primary Health Care, Transition to Professional Practice, final 4–6 week placement block
Total clinical placement: 840 hours embedded across 7 subjects (640 hours on the accelerated pathway for eligible students)
No separate thesis; final session includes a transition-to-practice subject preparing students for graduate nurse programs
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, an Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or an equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. From 2027 onwards, there will be a single Bachelor of Nursing course and course code that applies to both standard entry and entry for Enrolled Nurses (ENs). ENs who have completed a Diploma of Nursing within the past five years are eligible for automatic admission to the Bachelor of Nursing program. Those whose diploma was completed more than five years ago will have their applications reviewed by the course directors to ensure individual consideration. Successful EN applicants will receive Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Assumed knowledge: Any two units of English. Any two units of science and any two units of mathematics are recommended.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Property Economics
description:
The Bachelor of Property Economics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) prepares students for careers in property, valuation, investment and development. Core subjects cover property valuation, corporate real estate management, urban economics, property accounting and financial management, and the urban planning and development process, with related study in construction, law and finance.
Students specialise through a sub-major or broaden their study with electives, and work on real Sydney projects such as Barangaroo and Green Square through UTS industry connections. Study takes three years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 16216 Introduction to Property and the Built Environment; 16218 Corporate Real Estate Management; 16234 Property Valuation; 16264 Property Accounting and Financial Management; 16235 Urban Economics; 16233 Urban Planning & Development Process; 16298 Property Management.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. UTS: Design, Architecture and Building may consider applications based on the results of the Special Tertiary Admissions Test (STAT) if students lack academic qualifications but have extensive professional experience. The STAT is conducted through Australian Council for Educational Research (ACER). Students who have completed a TAFE Diploma in one the following areas will receive five (5) adjustment points: Valuation/Property Services/Applied Commerce/Business/Conservation and Land Management. Assumed knowledge: Mathematics and any two units of English.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Psychological Science (Honours)
description:
The Bachelor of Psychological Science (Honours) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a fourth year of study covering advanced psychology knowledge and a supervised thesis. Students build transferable skills in areas such as behavioural insights, data analysis, human-machine interaction and neuroscience, and an Indigenous graduate attribute runs through the course.
UTS psychology courses are accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council with conditions. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96644 Advanced Research Methods and Data Analysis; 96645 Applied Psychological Assessment and Intervention; 96647 Professional and Ethical Practice in Psychology; 96648 Advanced Topics in Psychology.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline at an appropriate level. Students internal and external to UTS may apply for the stand-alone Bachelor of Psychological Science (Honours) if their average mark across the 10 highest-scoring core psychology subjects is 75+ (for internal UTS students) or 80+ (for external students). Eligibility does not guarantee admission as places are subject to supervisory capacity. Students with an APAC-accredited psychology Bachelor's degree are also eligible to apply for the honours-equivalent UTS Online Graduate Diploma in Psychology (Advanced).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Psychology (Honours)
description:
The Bachelor of Psychology (Honours) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-year degree covering the scientific discipline of psychology and completing APAC Level 1 foundational competencies. Students build skills for further study towards registration as a psychologist and for roles in the mental health workforce, with an Indigenous graduate attribute running through the course.
UTS psychology courses are accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council with conditions. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96630 Introduction to Psychology A; 96631 Developmental Psychology; 96632 Introduction to Psychology B; 96633 Research Methods in Psychology; 96634 Mental Health Conditions and Psychological Wellbeing; 96642 Psychology Career Readiness; 96635 Research Design and Statistics in Psychology.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Any two units of English.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Science
description: The Bachelor of Science at UTS is for aspiring scientists eager to address global challenges such as pandemics, climate change and antibiotic resistance. The course offers flexibility with five majors and a variety of electives, starting with a foundational scientist's toolkit before students learn to critically apply scientific solutions to worldwide issues. Students work in top-tier facilities using industry-grade equipment and engage in real-world applications through internships, fieldwork and global exchanges, gaining scientific expertise alongside professional skills in inquiry, innovation and communication. Learning is interactive and practical, including laboratory work and fieldwork.

name: Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Management
description:
The Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) combines management study with the biophysical and sociocultural foundations of sport and exercise. The degree is 144 credit points, made up of 20 core subjects and four electives, covering structural and functional anatomy, biomechanics, strength and conditioning, data management in sport, and sport and society.
Study takes three years full-time in purpose-built health and exercise facilities with practical placements. Graduates work in sport administration, high-performance support, community sport and the fitness industry. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 92511 Structural Anatomy; 92512 Biomechanics of Human Motion; 92515 Collaboration, Creativity and Critical Thinking; 21655 Sport and Society; 92521 Functional Anatomy; 92523 Strength and Conditioning; 92526 Data Management in Sport and Exercise.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian Year 12 qualification, Australian Qualifications Framework Diploma, or equivalent Australian or overseas qualification at the required level. Assumed knowledge: Mathematics and any two units of English.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Science (Honours)
description:
The Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Science (Honours) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a one-year additional year of study for students who have completed a relevant bachelor's degree and want to build research skills. Students complete a supervised research project alongside advanced coursework in sport and exercise science, working in UTS health and exercise laboratories.
The honours year is a common pathway into higher degree research and into research-oriented roles in sport science, high-performance sport and health. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 92054 Research and Statistics for Sport and Exercise; 92055 Sport and Exercise Science Research Dissertation 1; 92056 Sport and Exercise Science Research Dissertation 2.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline at an appropriate level. Examples include: Successful completion of the Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Science (including C10300, C10302, C10328) or Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Management (including C10301, C10303), with a credit average or better in the final two full-time sessions. In exceptional cases, consideration is given to applicants who have completed the Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Management or Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Science at a pass level. In such cases, outstanding professional achievements are taken into account.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Diploma in Information Technology in Professional Practice
Diploma in Innovation
description:
The Diploma in Innovation at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a project-based course in creative thinking, teamwork and innovation, taken alongside or before a bachelor's degree. Students prototype ideas using design thinking, build minimum viable products, test and iterate, and study business strategy, funding options and pitching.
The course is delivered by the UTS TD School and works with people from a wide range of backgrounds. The skills it builds are valued across sectors, particularly in STEM, health and sustainability. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Applicants for admission must satisfy the selection criteria as specified by the faculty. Admission is only open to UTS undergraduate coursework students. Students enrolled in the Bachelor of Creative Intelligence and Innovation are ineligible for simultaneous admission to the Diploma of Innovation. Applications are handled directly by TD School and independent of the admission criteria for core degrees. Applicants must satisfy the selection criteria as specified by TD School. Admission is only open to UTS undergraduate coursework students. Students enrolled in the Bachelor of Creative Intelligence and Innovation are ineligible for simultaneous admission with the Diploma of Innovation. Applicants not (yet)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Doctor of Philosophy
description: The Doctor of Philosophy at UTS is a rigorous research degree that demands a significant period of supervised study culminating in a substantial and original contribution to knowledge. It is a pathway for those aiming for leadership roles in sectors that rely on research to address real-world challenges, including academia, business, government, and cultural or community organisations. Candidates develop analytical, problem-solving, communication and project management skills that are highly valued for academic careers and for careers in industry, research, government and non-government organisations.

name: Executive Master of Business Administration
description:
The Executive MBA at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is built for managers who are already leading teams and want to move into senior executive roles. Delivered flexibly so it fits around full-time work, the program runs through seven core subjects, including a Strategic Design Studio where students work with a real client on a live business problem, and an optional Global Story Tour covering areas such as sustainable enterprise, workforce transformation and technological disruption.
Entry is by articulation from the UTS Graduate Certificate in Leadership and Strategy, so applicants build a track record before joining the executive cohort. One-to-one executive coaching runs alongside the coursework. Graduates typically move into general management, division leadership, and founder or scale-up roles.
curriculum: Core subjects — 26824 Innovation Lab; 26843 Adaptive Leadership Lab; 26826 Leading Technological Disruption; 26827 Strategic Transformation; 26828 Adaptive Sustainable Enterprise; 26825 Transformation and Renewal; 26819 Strategic Design Studio.
admission_requirements: Completed C11327 Graduate Certificate in Leadership and Strategy, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level. The standard pathway requires completing the C11327 Graduate Certificate in Leadership and Strategy before articulating into the Executive Master of Business Administration. To be eligible for admission to the Graduate Certificate, applicants must meet the following criteria.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Executive Master of Data Science and Innovation
description:
The Executive Master of Data Science and Innovation at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a one-year degree for working professionals. Students learn to analyse socio-technical systems with data science frameworks, assess contemporary trends, design data investigations and communicate findings, working in a transdisciplinary cohort delivered by the UTS TD School.
The course emphasises collaboration, ethical responsibility and leadership. Graduates move into senior analytics and data strategy roles across sectors. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, in a relevant discipline (listed below) AND a minimum of five (5) years full-time, or equivalent part-time, management work experience AND among all work experience, a minimum of two (2) years in a relevant professional occupation (listed below). OR Completed Australian doctorate, master's degree, graduate diploma, graduate certificate, or honours degree, or overseas equivalent, in a relevant discipline (listed below) AND a minimum of five (5) years full-time, or equivalent part-time, management work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Animation and Visualisation
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Animation and Visualisation at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) introduces the working practices of a professional digital production studio. Over 24 credit points, students work on concept and story development, pre-visualisation, modelling, 3D animation and pipeline production for the early stages of a 3D animated short film, mentored by industry practitioners.
The course is a short entry point into 3D animation and visual effects and articulates into the UTS Master of Animation and Visualisation. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study AND advanced skills and aptitude in the nominated specialisation in 3D animation or visual effects production as demonstrated by their portfolio and work experience covered in their Curriculum Vitae (CV)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Applied Human Studies
description: The Graduate Certificate in Applied Human Studies at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Physiotherapy can apply to transfer into this course after completing 24 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate certificate. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Physiotherapy covers musculoskeletal, neurological, orthopaedic and cardiorespiratory physiotherapy, evidence-based and professional practice, and clinical placements, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Certificate in Architecture
description: The Graduate Certificate in Architecture at UTS is for individuals who started a Master of Architecture but have decided against pursuing licensure, yet still want a qualification in the field. It blends theoretical knowledge with real-world application: students tackle complex design challenges drawing on architectural history and theory, refine their problem-solving skills, and learn to critically analyse, synthesise solutions and conduct research. Communication skills are developed through professional oral, written and visual presentations. Learning occurs through hands-on design studios and elective subjects that encourage independent thought and ethical professional design practice.

name: Graduate Certificate in Australian Law
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Australian Law at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for internationally trained lawyers working towards admission as a lawyer in New South Wales. Before applying, students are assessed by the Legal Profession Admission Board of the NSW Supreme Court, which sets the subjects they must complete.
Students then take 30 credit points of core subjects covering ethics and justice, property law, the Australian Constitution and administrative law. On completion, graduates meet the academic requirements for admission to the Supreme Court of NSW, though some also need a separate practical legal training program. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70103 Ethics Law and Justice; 70317 Real Property; 70616 Australian Constitutional Law; 70617 Administrative Law.
admission_requirements: Completed Bachelor of Laws or Juris Doctor from outside Australia OR be admitted to practise as a legal practitioner in a common law jurisdiction outside Australia AND evidence from the NSW Legal Profession Admission Board (LPAB) of equivalency of the applicant's legal qualification for the purpose of admission as a legal practitioner in NSW, and the list of subjects that the LPAB deems necessary for the applicant to complete to seek admission as a legal practitioner in NSW Students who have graduated with a Shari'a law qualification are not eligible to apply for this course. Assumed knowledge: Appropriately qualified knowledge of the common law legal system.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business Administration
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Business Administration at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject entry point into postgraduate business study, drawn directly from the UTS MBA core. Students take Leading People and Change, Accounting for Managers, Economics for Management and Marketing Decision Making, covering strategic thinking, financial literacy, organisational dynamics and decision-making under uncertainty.
The course suits early-career professionals and career changers who want a recognised management qualification in one semester of full-time study, or who need a pathway into the MBA. Each subject is reviewed by an industry board, and students study alongside a cohort from varied industries and backgrounds. Completed subjects credit towards the UTS MBA.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21880 Leading People and Change; 24834 Marketing Decision Making; 23709 Economics for Management; 22800 Accounting for Managers.

This includes roles such as managers, professionals, technicians, community, personal service, clerical, administrative, or sales workers across various industries.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) gives professionals from business or IT backgrounds a working foundation in data analytics over one semester full-time. The four core subjects cover analytics foundations, database design and management, data governance and regulation, and a hands-on studio subject where students solve a real business problem with data.
Graduates can propose, design, run and communicate data analysis for a range of settings, and the course articulates into the UTS Master of Business Analytics for those who want to continue. It is aimed at people looking to move into analytics roles or add data skills to an existing career in a commercial function.
curriculum: Core subjects — 32606 Database; 22804 Business Analytics Foundations; 22805 Data Governance and Regulation.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent OR A minimum of 4 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience AND a general capacity to undertake tertiary education. Relevant professional work experience refers to any current work experience in which you have developed skills, knowledge, and competencies directly related to the course for which you are applying. This includes roles such as managers and professionals across various industries.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

Graduate Certificate in Data Science and Innovation
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Data Science and Innovation at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a short course covering how to analyse and interpret complex socio-technical systems using data science frameworks, with a focus on the human context of data. Students design data investigations, work with ambiguity and communicate findings to non-technical audiences.
The course is delivered by the UTS TD School in a transdisciplinary cohort and articulates into the UTS Graduate Diploma and Master of Data Science and Innovation. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.

Graduate Certificate in Engineering
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Engineering at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 24 credit point course made up of professional engineering, stream and elective subjects. It lets students begin postgraduate engineering study before committing to a full master's degree, following an integrated approach to professional practice through a chosen stream, or major.
The course suits engineers building specialist technical capability or testing a move into postgraduate study, and articulates into the UTS Master of Professional Engineering and related masters. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.

name: Graduate Certificate in Engineering Management
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Engineering Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 24 credit point course, drawn mostly from the core of the UTS Master of Engineering Management. It develops management and leadership capability for engineers and technologists, covering project delivery, strategy and decision-making in technical organisations.
The course is designed for working engineers who cannot commit to a full master's, and articulates into the UTS Master of Engineering Management. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification or overseas equivalent, in any field of study OR Completed Australian associate degree or advanced diploma (AQF 6), or overseas equivalent, in any field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience OR Completed Australian diploma (AQF 5)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Engineering Studies
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Engineering Studies at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 24 credit point course covering professional engineering, a review component and an elective. The program is shaped around each student's interests and settled with an academic adviser before enrolment.
It is used both to build technical capability and to meet the entry requirements for postgraduate engineering study at UTS. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.

english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

Graduate Certificate in Finance
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Finance at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject qualification covering financial management, financial modelling and analysis, investment management and capital markets. It is taught in central Sydney by staff with industry backgrounds and designed with input from financial institutions, giving students a practical grounding in banking, corporate finance and financial technology over one semester of full-time study.
UTS is a CFA Institute University Affiliate on the basis of this course, so the content maps to the early CFA syllabus. The certificate suits professionals moving into finance roles and serves as a pathway into the UTS Graduate Diploma or Master of Finance.
curriculum: Core subjects — 25742 Financial Management; 25705 Financial Modelling and Analysis; 25721 Investment Management; 25741 Capital Markets.

english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Genetic Counselling
description: The Graduate Certificate in Genetic Counselling at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Genetic Counselling can apply to transfer into this course after completing 24 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate certificate. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Genetic Counselling provides the research and clinical training for a career as a genetic counsellor, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Certificate In Good Manufacturing Practice
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Good Manufacturing Practice at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 24 credit point course covering regulation and compliance, product development and quality assurance in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. UTS delivers it with SeerPharma, an industry provider of technical compliance and quality assurance training, so the teaching is practice-based and current.
The course is aimed at people already working in or entering pharmaceutical manufacturing who need a recognised qualification, and can be completed in one semester full-time. It is the only course of its kind in the Asia-Pacific region and articulates into the UTS Graduate Diploma and Master of Good Manufacturing Practice.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience AND Communication skills, interpersonal skills, an interest in an industry where good manufacturing practices are involved, and a commitment to good manufacturing practice as a career, assessed through an interview by the faculty.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Information Technology
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Information Technology at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 24 credit point course made up of a core subject and an 18 credit point stream, so students can concentrate on an area such as data analytics, networking or software development.
The course is aimed at IT professionals upskilling in a specific area, and articulates into the UTS master's programs in the field. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: qualifications in Information Technology: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent. OR Completed Australian associate degree or advanced diploma (AQF 6), or overseas equivalent AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience. Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11247 Graduate Certificate in Information Technology Studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Information Technology Studies
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Information Technology Studies at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 24 credit point course of foundation subjects covering databases, information systems, networking and software development. It is designed for people whose first degree is not in IT and who want to move into technology roles.
The course provides the background needed to progress into the UTS Master of Information Technology and related masters. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 32557 Enabling Enterprise Information Systems; 32555 Fundamentals of Software Development; 32606 Database; 32524 LANS and Routing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent. OR Completed Australian associate degree or advanced diploma (AQF6), or overseas equivalent, AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Laws
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Laws at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject course for law graduates who want focused study in a specific area of Australian or international law. Students choose two subjects from the Law or non-common-law streams, complete a research preparation subject, and write an 8,000 to 10,000 word paper on an approved legal topic.
The course is highly flexible and suits practitioners building specialist expertise or research capability. It articulates into the UTS Master of Laws. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian Bachelor of Laws, Juris Doctor, or doctorate of Law, or overseas equivalent (excluding a Shari’a law degree) OR Passed the Chinese Legal Professional Qualification Examination to practise law OR Completed NSW Legal Profession Admission Board (LPAB) Diploma in Law AND A minimum of 1 year full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant legal experience OR Completed Australian Graduate Certificate in Laws or Australian Graduate Diploma in Laws, or overseas equivalent (excluding a Shari’a law degree)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Legal Studies
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Legal Studies at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for graduates from non-law disciplines who want a working knowledge of Australian law. Students complete three core legal subjects covering how Australian law is made and structured, plus contracts and constitutional law, and build skills in critical thinking, ethics and legal research.
The course does not lead to admission as a lawyer, but gives professionals legal knowledge that applies across industries. It articulates into the UTS Graduate Diploma and Master of Legal Studies. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70102 Foundations of Law; 70211 Contracts; 70616 Australian Constitutional Law.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent OR Capacity to study the course demonstrated through a minimum of 2 years' full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience The qualification must be in a field of study other than law or, if the qualification is in a legal field of study, it shall not be an academic qualification for legal practice.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Marketing
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Marketing at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject introduction to contemporary marketing practice, covering marketing management, customer experience and behaviour, data-driven insights and marketing communications. It is designed for professionals entering marketing or adding formal marketing skills to another discipline, and can be completed in one semester full-time or part-time across Autumn or Spring sessions.
The course emphasises digital channels, measurement and ethical, sustainability-minded practice. Subjects credit towards the UTS Graduate Diploma and Master of Marketing, and graduates commonly work in marketing coordinator and specialist roles across sectors.
curriculum: Core subjects — 24734 Marketing Management; 24710 Customer Experience and Behaviour; 24761 Data-Driven Insights; 24736 Marketing Communications.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent OR A minimum of 4 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience AND a general capacity to undertake tertiary education Relevant professional work experience refers to any current professional work experience in which you have developed skills, knowledge, and competencies directly related to the course for which you are applying. This includes roles such as managers, professionals, technicians, community, personal service, clerical, administrative, or sales workers across various industries.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

Graduate Certificate in Pharmaceutical Sciences (Exit Only)

It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Pharmacy programs provide the professional training required for registration as a pharmacist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Certificate in Planning
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Planning at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a one-semester introduction to urban planning, covering development, planning law and regulation, and a choice of community engagement or urban design. It also builds practical skills in teamwork, cross-cultural collaboration and strategic thinking.
The course sits within the UTS Faculty of Design, Architecture and Building and is designed mainly as a pathway into the UTS Master of Planning. It suits people testing a move into planning or building the background needed for the masters.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 15146 Sustainable Urban Development.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's, bachelor honours degree, or master's degree, or overseas equivalent OR Completed UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Property Development with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 AND A minimum of 1 year full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Professional Accounting
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Professional Accounting at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject course covering accounting for managerial decisions, financial management, contemporary business law and economics for management. It is designed for graduates from non-accounting disciplines who want a foundation in accounting, finance, economics and law, either for managerial work or as a bridge into the Master of Professional Accounting.
Study takes one semester full-time. The content is developed with UTS industry partners and focuses on the practical skills used in day-to-day accounting and financial roles. Graduates move into assistant accountant, financial analyst and finance officer positions, or continue into the masters for professional body recognition.
curriculum: Core subjects — 22747 Accounting for Managerial Decisions; 25742 Financial Management; 79708 Contemporary Business Law; 23706 Economics for Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, in a field of study other than Accounting OR A minimum of 4 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience AND a general capacity to undertake tertiary education Relevant professional work experience refers to any current professional work experience in which you have developed skills, knowledge, and competencies directly related to the course for which you are applying.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Professional Legal Practice
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Professional Legal Practice at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the practical legal training required for admission as a lawyer in New South Wales, taken after a qualifying law degree. From 2026 the NSW Legal Profession Admission Board requires 15 days on campus and 15 days of practical experience.
Students complete three core coursework subjects on professional skills and contemporary legal practice, plus a supervised work placement. The course satisfies the practical legal training requirements for admission to the Supreme Court of NSW. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 75422 Property and Commercial Practice; 75423 Litigation Practice; 75424 Skills and Wills Practice.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian Bachelor of Laws, Australian Juris Doctor, or NSW Legal Profession Admission Board Diploma in Law within the past 5 years OR Completed Australian Bachelor of Laws, Australian Juris Doctor, or NSW Legal Profession Admission Board Diploma in Law more than 5 years ago AND A written assessment of the legal qualification from the NSW Legal Profession Admission Board (LPAB) to ensure the qualification meets the current LPAB admission requirements OR Completed overseas legal qualification AND A written assessment from the NSW Legal Profession Admissions Board (LPAB)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Project Management
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Project Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers four core subjects: project integration management; scope, time and cost management; communication, HR and stakeholders; and risk, procurement and quality management. Over one semester full-time, students build a foundation in the full project life cycle and in leading teams through each stage.
The course is accredited by the Global Accreditation Center for Project Management Education Programs (GAC). It suits professionals taking on project responsibilities in any sector, from banking and government to events and consulting, and articulates into the UTS Master of Project Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15312 Project Communication, HR and Stakeholders; 15319 Project Risk, Procurement and Quality Management; 15316 Project Scope, Time and Cost Management; 15310 Project Integration Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, or Advanced Diploma in Project Management AND Any relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Property Development
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Property Development at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a one-semester introduction to the property development process, covering development feasibility, property transactions, and investment and development analysis. Students model a real development feasibility project and study the economic, legal and environmental factors behind urban development.
The course is designed both as a foundation qualification and as a pathway for people already working in property who lack a relevant bachelor's degree. It sits within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society and leads into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Property Development. Graduates work across government planning, valuation, development and construction.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 12518 Property Transactions; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Quantitative Finance
description: The Graduate Certificate in Quantitative Finance at UTS is for aspiring and established quantitative finance professionals navigating a financial landscape marked by rapid innovation, new risks and major regulatory change. Students obtain core mathematical competencies in time series modelling and stochastic calculus, then explore areas such as financial instruments, derivative securities, quantitative risk management, quantitative portfolio analysis, and interest rate and credit risk modelling. Learning combines current, industry-relevant subjects with hands-on experience, preparing graduates for roles in financial institutions, consulting and government.

name: Graduate Certificate in Science
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Science at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject entry point into postgraduate science study. Students choose two electives in their preferred scientific discipline and complete two professional subjects that prepare them for scientific practice.
The course sits within the UTS Faculty of Science, which has laboratory facilities including the Super Lab, and articulates into the UTS master's programs in science. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 68109 Advanced Communication Skills in Science; 60117 Understanding Data and Statistical Design.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Documentary
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Documentary at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a three-subject course, one core unit and two electives, focused on documentary storytelling and unscripted content. Teaching is studio-based and led by industry practitioners, and electives cover directing, cinematography, editing, producing, curation or an industry internship.
The course suits media professionals upskilling, screen production graduates specialising, or newcomers building a marketable skill. It articulates into the UTS Master of Screen Arts and Production. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in Society and Culture or Creative Arts OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in any field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry AND An interest in the course and demonstrated understanding of the opportunities present in Screen Arts and Production OR A minimum of 4 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Drama
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Drama at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a three-subject course, one core unit and two electives, covering scripted screen production from ideation through design, planning and production. Electives cover screen directing, cinematography, editing, curation, creative producing or an industry internship.
Study is flexible, full-time or part-time. The course articulates into the UTS Master of Screen Arts and Production. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in Society and Culture or Creative Arts OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in any field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry AND An interest in the course and demonstrated understanding of the opportunities present in Screen Arts and Production OR A minimum of 4 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Speech and Language Sciences
description: The Graduate Certificate in Speech and Language Sciences at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Speech Pathology can apply to transfer into this course after completing 24 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate certificate. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Speech Pathology provides the professional training for a career as a speech pathologist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Certificate in Strategic Supply Chain Management
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Strategic Supply Chain Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject introduction to operations and supply chain management, covering strategic supply chain management, operations and quality management, supply chain risk management, and business and social impact. Teaching combines theory with practical application so students can use the material directly at work.
The course takes one semester full-time and is aimed at professionals moving into procurement, logistics, inventory and operations roles. It provides a pathway into the UTS Master of Strategic Supply Chain Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21797 Strategic Supply Chain Management; 21741 Operations and Quality Management; 21947 Supply Chain Risk Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent OR A minimum of 4 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience AND a general capacity to undertake tertiary education Relevant professional work experience refers to any current professional work experience in which you have developed skills, knowledge, and competencies directly related to the course for which you are applying. This includes roles such as managers, professionals, technicians, community, personal service, clerical, administrative, or sales workers across various industries.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in TESOL
description:
The Graduate Certificate in TESOL at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an initial teaching qualification for people who want to teach English as an additional language to adults, to primary and secondary students, or to international students in Australia and overseas. It also gives qualified school teachers a specialisation in the area.
Students complete four core subjects on language, multilingualism and TESOL methodology, plus a supervised practicum in a real teaching setting. Study takes one semester full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have a: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Vision Science
description: The Graduate Certificate in Vision Science at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Orthoptics can apply to transfer into this course after completing 24 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate certificate. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Orthoptics provides the clinical training for a career as an orthoptist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Certificate of Data Science in Quantitative Finance
Graduate Diploma in Applied Human Studies
description: The Graduate Diploma in Applied Human Studies at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Physiotherapy can apply to transfer into this course after completing 48 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate diploma. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Physiotherapy covers musculoskeletal, neurological, orthopaedic and cardiorespiratory physiotherapy, evidence-based and professional practice, and clinical placements, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Diploma in Architecture
description: The Graduate Diploma in Architecture at UTS is for individuals who started a Master of Architecture but wish to pursue a non-licensing qualification in the field. It offers a deeper dive into the essentials of architectural practice than the Graduate Certificate. Students develop critical analysis, synthesis and problem-solving skills by tackling real-world design challenges, learn to research and apply architectural history and theory, and articulate their ideas professionally through various presentation methods. The course emphasises ethical and professional design solutions, autonomy and expert judgement, delivered through an interactive mix of studio work, research and presentations with feedback from professionals.

name: Graduate Diploma in Artificial Intelligence
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers data analytics, data visualisation, machine learning and neural networks, with hands-on AI projects. It is designed for IT and computing professionals, and for graduates from other disciplines, who want to build AI knowledge.
Study takes one year full-time and articulates into the UTS Master of Artificial Intelligence. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 42172 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence; 32555 Fundamentals of Software Development; 32130 Fundamentals of Data Analytics; 32513 Advanced Data Analytics Algorithms; 32146 Data Visualisation and Visual Analytics.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology or Electrical and Electronic Engineering and Technology or Mathematical Sciences OR Completed Australian associate degree or advanced diploma (AQF 6), or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Australian Law
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Australian Law at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for overseas-qualified lawyers seeking to practise in New South Wales. The program is tailored to each student based on an assessment by the Legal Profession Admission Board, which is required before applying.
Students complete a minimum of 48 credit points covering contracts, torts, litigation, evidence and other core areas of Australian law. Graduates meet the academic requirements for admission as a lawyer to the NSW Supreme Court, and some also complete a practical legal training program. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Completed Bachelor of Laws or Juris Doctor from outside Australia OR be admitted to practise as a legal practitioner in a common law jurisdiction outside Australia AND evidence from the NSW Legal Profession Admission Board (LPAB) of equivalency of the applicant's legal qualification for the purpose of admission as a legal practitioner in NSW, and the list of subjects that the LPAB deems necessary for the applicant to complete to seek admission as a legal practitioner in NSW Students who have graduated with a Shari'a law qualification are not eligible to apply for this course. Assumed knowledge: Appropriately qualified knowledge of a legal system.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Business Administration
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Business Administration at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) sits between the graduate certificate and the MBA. Students complete five core MBA subjects plus electives from across UTS faculties, covering leadership, accounting, economics, marketing and finance for managers, along with strategic analysis, business planning and organisational change.
The diploma takes one year full-time and suits professionals who want more depth than a certificate without committing to the full MBA. Subjects credit towards the UTS MBA for students who choose to continue. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21880 Leading People and Change; 22800 Accounting for Managers; 23709 Economics for Management; 24834 Marketing Decision Making; 25799 Finance for Managers.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11008 Graduate Certificate in Business Administration.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the mid-length award in the UTS business analytics sequence, sitting between the graduate certificate and the Master of Business Analytics. It covers analytics foundations, database systems, data governance and regulation, and studio subjects where students apply technical skills to practical projects, without the full research or specialisation load of the masters.

The course suits professionals from business or IT backgrounds who want more depth than a certificate in one year of full-time study. Completed subjects credit towards the UTS Master of Business Analytics. Graduates work in data analyst and business intelligence roles.
curriculum: Core subjects — 32606 Database; 22804 Business Analytics Foundations; 22805 Data Governance and Regulation; 43031 Python Programming for Data Processing; 32146 Data Visualisation and Visual Analytics.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Construction Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Construction Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers the work of senior construction professionals: regulation, communication, cost planning, contract management and risk. Coursework is aligned with the Project Management Body of Knowledge, and students use industry tools for cost estimating and building information modelling.
Study takes one year full-time. Students choose one disciplinary elective in areas such as real estate, asset management or entrepreneurship, and with four further subjects can progress to the UTS master's degree in the field. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 12511 Construction Technology and Regulation; 12537 Construction Management; 12591 Construction Cost Planning and Control; 12003 Time, Quality and Risk Management; 15312 Project Communication, HR and Stakeholders; 15362 Managing Project Contracts; 15310 Project Integration Management.
admission_requirements: Completed UTS Graduate Certificate in Construction Management OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent. OR A minimum of 5 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience.
