The certificate provides an entry pathway to a marketing qualification for people with extensive work experience but no bachelor degree, and units completed are transferable toward the Master of Marketing. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Organisational Change Management
Graduate Certificate in Performance-based Building and Fire Codes
description: The Graduate Certificate in Performance-Based Building and Fire Codes at Victoria University is a fully online course for building surveying and design professionals working on the approval of performance-based buildings in light of national and international fire codes. Students gain an in-depth understanding of key concepts and alternative frameworks for performance-based building in fire codes, and develop skills in the assessment of performance-based building design and the application of fire codes, including an appreciation of legal, statutory and design integrity requirements and the need for design compliance.

name: Graduate Certificate in Supply Chain Management
description: The Graduate Certificate in Supply Chain Management at Victoria University helps professionals update and expand their knowledge of supply chains, transport and logistics. Students develop a specialised body of knowledge to prepare for professional or highly skilled work in the growing fields of logistics and related management, which can support progression into senior leadership positions or further postgraduate study. The certificate is nested within the Master of Supply Chain Management and also provides a pathway to VU's MBA. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Tourism and Destination Management
Graduate Diploma in Business (Accounting)
description: The Graduate Diploma in Business at Victoria University equips students with advanced knowledge in contemporary business and is designed for professionals who want to advance their careers or move into a more specialised area. Business specialisations include accounting, business analytics, enterprise resource planning, finance, marketing management, supply chain management and tourism, complemented by workplace skills in problem solving and creativity. Graduates can progress to a master's degree in their chosen specialisation with credit from the diploma. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Business Administration
description: The Graduate Diploma in Business Administration at Victoria University is created for people without a current business qualification and is academically focused and professionally applicable. It provides a path to the MBA (Global) for those with relevant professional experience. Students develop advanced knowledge in contemporary business, exploring core management disciplines including accounting, statistics, marketing, economics, people management, and ethics and sustainability, along with critical thinking, problem solving and creativity. The course is designed to help students develop a global business perspective, and is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Construction Management
description: The Graduate Diploma in Construction Management at Victoria University builds an advanced practical skillset over one year of full-time study, preparing graduates for leadership roles in the construction industry. The program has a specific focus on sustainable building practices and forms part of a series of postgraduate courses aimed at future leaders in building and civil engineering projects. Through case studies and practical exercises, students learn to plan projects from start to finish, covering scoping, scheduling, costing, risk, quality and safety, and explore emerging technologies such as data analytics, robotics, artificial intelligence and advanced materials. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Cyber Security
description: The Graduate Diploma in Cyber Security at Victoria University prepares students to work as IT security professionals with specialised cyber security expertise. The course covers the essential areas of the field, including cyber security fundamentals and architecture, cyber security technologies, cloud security, enterprise security, and cyber security regulation, policy and law. Students learn from experienced academic staff and guest lecturers with current industry experience and a strong research track record. It is offered at VU in Melbourne and provides an internationally recognised qualification.

name: Graduate Diploma in Early Childhood Education
description: The Graduate Diploma in Early Childhood Education at Victoria University is a one-year course that allows graduates of other degree programs to become early childhood teachers. It is tailored to applicants with an undergraduate qualification in a discipline other than early childhood, and with Victoria's three-year-old kindergarten expansion, it positions graduates well to apply for work as kindergarten teachers. Students study units focused on children from birth to five years and complete hands-on work experience in settings including childcare and kindergartens. Domestic students can study online. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Education
description: The Graduate Diploma in Education at Victoria University extends career prospects for trainers and teachers in education, community, government and industry, building on existing qualifications or experience to prepare students for higher roles. The course combines hands-on practice with education theory, covering designing and implementing learning programs, educational leadership, e-learning, evaluation and assessment, and vocational training, and includes the opportunity to conduct workplace research aimed at improving training or influencing policy. It is the second of three graduate courses and successful completion gains admission to the Master of Education. This course does not provide registration to teach in Australia.

name: Graduate Diploma in Global Public Health
Graduate Diploma in International Community Development
description: The Graduate Diploma in International Community Development at Victoria University is a practical postgraduate course that develops leadership skills in real-world settings for community development work at a local or international level. Open to graduates with a bachelor degree, it builds expertise in community development theories and practices, project design, planning and management, social research and evaluation, globalisation and its impacts on communities, peace and conflict resolution, capacity building, advocacy of gender and human rights, and leadership. It gains credit toward VU's Master of International Community Development and is offered in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Migration Law
description: The Graduate Diploma in Migration Law at Victoria University prepares graduates to register as a migration agent and is Australia's longest-running migration law program, with VU recognised as a leading provider of migration law education. Over one year, students build knowledge and skills in migration law and policy, legal research and drafting, submission writing, professional and interpersonal communication, and understanding of the migrant experience and human rights issues. The course is designed for working professionals and offers flexible study. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Project Management
description: The Graduate Diploma in Project Management at Victoria University is one of a suite of courses designed for current or potential project managers. Students learn specialised project management principles and techniques that apply across sectors including administration, business, engineering and construction, and information technology, with all teaching underpinned by the internationally recognised Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK Guide). Strong industry connections give access to current work-based scenarios. Graduates aiming for leadership or high-level management roles can progress to the Master of Project Management. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Public Health (Global Nutrition and Active Living)
Graduate Diploma in Sport Business and Integrity
International Foundations at VU
description: The International Foundations program at Victoria University prepares international students for tertiary study and offers a guaranteed pathway into the first year of selected undergraduate degrees and higher education diplomas at VU, subject to meeting course entry requirements. The course is comparable in standard to the Australian Year 12 curriculum and provides a supportive environment for students adjusting to living and studying away from home. Key learning areas are mathematics, science and technology, the arts, and business and legal studies. It is offered at VU's City Campus in Melbourne.

name: Master of Applied Information Technology
description:
VU built this course for people who already have a degree in something else and want to pivot into IT without starting from zero. It runs on the university's block model, which means you study one unit at a time over four weeks rather than juggling four subjects across a semester, a format VU has been refining since 2018 after seeing first-year fail rates drop by roughly 40% under it, and the same intensive structure now applies right through postgraduate coursework.

The course covers programming, database design, systems analysis and network fundamentals before moving into electives in areas like cybersecurity or data analytics, aimed at getting career-changers to a point where they can sit entry-level developer or analyst interviews. Because it's pitched at non-IT graduates, the first few units spend more time than a typical postgrad program would on foundational coding literacy before the pace picks up.

Classes run out of VU's Footscray Park and City campuses, both a short train ride from Melbourne's CBD tech employers, and the course carries professional-year options that matter to international graduates chasing post-study work rights.
curriculum:
Trimester 1: Programming Principles, Database Systems, IT Project Management, Networking Fundamentals
Trimester 2: Systems Analysis and Design, Web and Mobile Application Development, Cloud Computing Foundations, Elective (Cybersecurity or Data Analytics stream)
Trimester 3: Enterprise Architecture, Advanced Elective, IT Capstone Project
Optional: Professional Year pathway units for eligible international graduates
admission_requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant or any discipline (typical Australian postgrad IT/CS entry bar used as approximate default, not program-specific verified).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (typical postgrad bar used as approximate default, not program-verified).

name: Master of Applied Psychology (Community Psychology)
description: The Master of Applied Research at Victoria University is designed for bachelor graduates from any discipline and provides a solid foundation in research methods before students undertake a thesis related to health or sport. Students study research methods, ethics, project design and disciplinary expertise relevant to their research, and on passing the core units with a 70 percent average begin their own research aligned with VU's focus areas. Within the Institute for Health and Sport, students can work toward a qualification in disciplines including biomedical sciences, biotechnology, business, nursing, food science, sport science and social sciences. VU is highly ranked in sport and health research.

name: Master of Applied Research
description: The Master of Applied Research at Victoria University suits bachelor graduates from any discipline who want a structured entry into research in health or sport. The course begins with core training in research methods, ethics and project design, plus disciplinary study relevant to the student's chosen field. On passing the core units with a 70 percent average, students undertake their own supervised research project within one of VU's focus areas. Research can be pursued within the Institute for Health and Sport across disciplines such as biomedical sciences, biotechnology, nursing, food science, sport science and social sciences, and VU is ranked above world standard in sport and health fields.

name: Master of Business Administration
description:
VU's MBA is aimed at working professionals rather than fresh graduates (most cohorts expect several years of prior work experience) and runs core units in strategy, finance, marketing and leadership before students pick electives to angle the degree toward their own industry. Delivery follows VU's block model even at MBA level, so units run intensively rather than stretching across a full trimester, which suits people fitting study around a job better than a semester-long weekly-lecture format would.

The program doesn't carry the brand weight of a Melbourne Business School or AGSM MBA, and VU doesn't try to compete on that ground. Its pitch is a more affordable, flexible MBA aimed at Melbourne's west and at international students wanting an Australian postgraduate business qualification with a manageable course load and strong migration-relevant skills assessment outcomes.

A capstone consulting project in the final trimester has students working on a real business problem, often for a small-to-medium enterprise rather than a large corporate client, which keeps the project grounded in the kind of business VU's own graduate network tends to run.
curriculum:
Trimester 1: Strategic Management, Managerial Finance, Marketing Management, Leading People and Organisations
Trimester 2: Business Analytics, Operations Management, Elective units (industry-specific)
Trimester 3: Global Business Environment, Elective units, MBA Capstone Consulting Project
admission_requirements: Bachelor's degree plus relevant work experience
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Master of Business Analytics (Professional)
description: The Master of Business Analytics at Victoria University builds practical skills for applying data to solve business problems. Students learn the principles of data science, data visualisation, machine learning and artificial intelligence, and work with open-source environments R and Python and cloud platforms including AWS and GitHub, supported by VU's global partnership with SAP. Through strong connections with local businesses and international partners, the course gives hands-on experience solving real-world problems and turning analytical skills into business value. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Change, Innovation and Leadership
Master of Clinical Exercise Science and Rehabilitation
description: The Master of Clinical Exercise Science and Rehabilitation at Victoria University prepares graduates to work as accredited exercise physiologists. Students learn to assess and prescribe exercise and physical activity for people with chronic conditions or complex care needs, and to work in community and clinical settings with clients who have musculoskeletal injuries, neurological, metabolic or cardiovascular conditions, and comorbidities. The evidence-based program includes significant practical experience through clinical placements, and an optional research component that provides a pathway toward a PhD. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Construction Management
description: The Master of Construction Management at Victoria University provides practical, up-to-date skills to lead large-scale building projects, taking into account environmental, social and cultural factors. Through case studies and hands-on exercises, students learn to plan complex building works and address project risks while managing schedules, costs and building quality, and explore emerging technologies such as data analytics, robotics, artificial intelligence and advanced materials across all project stages. The course includes 600 hours of professional work placement, and graduates are prepared to demonstrate real-world skills to employers. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Counselling
description: The Master of Counselling at Victoria University develops a deep understanding of the theory and practice of counselling, with experience in adult, child and adolescent counselling. Students focus on counselling and psychological theory, counselling interventions and psychological therapies for adults, children, adolescents and families, and practical skills through industry-based learning and placement. The course covers a range of presenting issues including depression, anxiety, grief, loss and addiction, the ethics of counselling, and completion of a practice-based minor thesis. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Education
description: The Master of Education (by coursework) at Victoria University builds on experience as an education professional through the study of current theory, underpinned by a focus on social justice, sustainability and ethical action. Students develop the skills and confidence to address challenges and opportunities across schools, universities, community, government and industry, furthering their expertise in learning and teaching practice under experienced educators. The course is designed for teachers, principals, community educators, youth workers, policy-makers and other professionals whose work has an educational component. It does not provide registration to teach in Australia.

name: Master of Enterprise Resource Planning
description: The Master of Enterprise Resource Planning at Victoria University develops specialised, sought-after expertise as a SAP specialist, and VU describes it as the only course at this level in Australia. Students gain practical, up-to-date knowledge of SAP software with hands-on experience and online access, learning the latest SAP solutions including S/4HANA, Fiori, Business Information Warehouse, Business Objects Business Intelligence, SAP Analytics Cloud, Customer Relationship Management and Solution Manager. The course helps existing SAP professionals advance and provides IT and computer science graduates a bridge into a corporate profession. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Enterprise Resource Planning Management
Master of Global Public Health
description: The Master of Global Public Health at Victoria University gives students the knowledge and skills to find solutions to current and emerging health challenges. Students learn to appraise public health evidence and contribute to collaborative programs and policies, and graduate skilled in developing public health solutions for sustainable development and inclusive policy and practice, including ensuring Indigenous views are heard. Work-based learning builds problem-solving and people skills. The course suits recent graduates aiming to work in health policy and programs and health professionals enhancing their practice. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Industrial Relations and Human Resource Management
Master of International Community Development
description: The Master of International Community Development at Victoria University combines study with practical experience to prepare graduates for careers in community development in local or international settings. Key study areas include community development theories and practices, project design, planning and management, social research and evaluation, globalisation and its impacts on communities, peace strategies and conflict resolution, capacity building, advocacy of gender and human rights, and leadership and governance of local and international organisations. It is the final stage of a three-course sequence following the graduate certificate and graduate diploma. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Marketing
description: The Master of Marketing at Victoria University develops the expertise to work in the increasingly digital marketplace. Through industry connections and experienced lecturers, students learn to create and execute marketing strategies for local and global businesses and not-for-profit organisations, and to formulate and implement industry projects that address complex marketing problems and inform management decision-making. Graduates have advanced skills in marketing planning and strategy, marketing analytics, marketing communication, consumer behaviour, international marketing management, brand management, not-for-profit marketing, and social media and digital marketing. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Professional Accounting
description: The Master of Professional Accounting at Victoria University develops advanced accounting expertise, offering specialist knowledge and a deep understanding of sustainability issues and global accounting trends. Students execute case studies and business plans, complete a substantial research project or evidence-based capstone activity, and adapt cross-disciplinary knowledge to evaluate business decisions, developing specialist knowledge in accounting, economics and finance. Graduates are prepared for senior accounting positions. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Professional Psychology
description: The Master of Professional Psychology at Victoria University provides an accredited pathway to register with the Psychology Board of Australia as a practising psychologist, and concludes five years of university training that is followed by a required year of supervised practice at an external internship. Accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council, the course combines in-depth learning with supervised placements, including providing psychological services under supervision at the VU Psychology Clinic to a culturally diverse community. Students can practise face-to-face and via telehealth and facilitate group psychotherapy programs. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Project Management
description: The Master of Project Management at Victoria University equips current and aspiring project managers with advanced techniques that apply across industries including construction, engineering, health services, information technology, private business and the public sector. As one of the first Australian universities to establish a project management master's degree, VU has long-held industry connections, and work-based scenarios provide opportunities for specialised research and professional experience. The program is endorsed by the Australian Institute of Project Management, and all teaching is underpinned by the PMBOK Guide. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Public Health (Global Nutrition and Active Living)
Master of Research
description: The Master of Research at Victoria University can be completed in 18 months in the areas of health and sport, and is tailored to graduates with a related bachelor degree or an honours degree in a different discipline. Study is individualised according to academic background, with core skills in research ethics and project design followed by either further research methods or a disciplinary component. On passing the units with a 70 percent average, students undertake their own supervised research within the Institute for Health and Sport, across disciplines including biomedical sciences, biotechnology, nursing, food science, sport science and social sciences.

name: Master of Sport Business and Integrity
Master of Supply Chain Management
description: The Master of Supply Chain Management at Victoria University takes a holistic, hands-on approach to the strategies that underpin the global supply chain. Designed for professionals in operations, procurement, warehousing, global trade and transport, it develops real-world experience through internships and industry visits, with access to SAP-SCM and SAP-PP software for planning, sourcing and delivering goods. Graduates gain expertise in complex supply-chain models, concepts and strategies, specialising in global procurement and operations management and green logistics and supply chain strategies. The Graduate Certificate in Transport Systems provides a pathway into the course. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Tourism and Destination Management
Master of Tourism Hospitality and Events Management
Undergraduate Certificate in Early Childhood Education
description: The Undergraduate Certificate in Early Childhood Education at Victoria University provides a recognised qualification within six months, letting students upskill quickly and providing a fast track toward a new career and a stepping stone to a bachelor qualification. Covering learning theory and national frameworks, the certificate develops understanding of learning concepts, education practices and social influences, the teacher's role in play and development, academic writing conventions, and the National Quality Framework and other rights-based and ethical charters. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Associate Degree in Early Years Education (Exit Only)
description: The Associate Degree in Early Years Education at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Education (Early Childhood), which is accredited by the Australian Children's Education and Care Quality Authority and highly ranked nationally. The parent degree leads to a career teaching children from birth to five years. Graduates use the associate degree in early childhood support and educator roles or as credit toward completing the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 110869J.

name: Associate Degree in Education (Primary) (Exit Only)
description: The Associate Degree in Education (Primary) at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Education (Primary). The parent degree includes hands-on school experience from the first year and prepares graduates to teach Kindergarten to Year 6 in government and non-government schools. Graduates use the associate degree in education support roles or as credit toward completing the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 103728C.

name: Associate Degree in Educational Studies (Secondary) (Exit Only)
description: The Associate Degree in Educational Studies (Secondary) at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Master of Teaching (Secondary), which combines on-campus theory with school-based placements to prepare specialist graduates as secondary teachers. Graduates use the associate degree as recognition of partial study or as a foundation for further education study. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year.

name: Associate Degree in Health Support (exit only)
description: The Associate Degree in Health Support at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Health Science. The parent degree combines study with hands-on experience and majors in public health, health promotion, health services management, recreational therapy and clinical sciences. Graduates use the associate degree in health support and community health roles or as credit toward completing the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 39,600 Australian dollars per year.

name: Associate Degree in Policing (exit only)
description: The Associate Degree in Policing at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Policing, described by the university as the only policing degree in metropolitan Sydney. The parent degree prepares graduates for careers in policing, criminal and community justice, corrective services, border protection, intelligence, security and forensics, with access to a crime scene investigation facility. Graduates use the associate degree in justice and security support roles or as credit toward the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 044801C.

name: Associate Degree in Social Science (exit only)
description: The Associate Degree in Social Science at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Social Science. The parent degree develops knowledge through theory, research and practical application, with industry projects and placement opportunities including overseas placements in countries such as Nepal, India, Indonesia and Fiji, and majors including child and community. Graduates use the associate degree in community and social service roles or as credit toward the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 041159D.

name: Associate Degree in Youth Studies (exit only)
description: The Associate Degree in Youth Studies at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Youth Work, a program developed with industry partners that trains professional youth workers. The parent degree draws on the humanities and social sciences to understand the challenges young people face and how to respond. Graduates use the associate degree in youth and community support roles or as credit toward the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 31,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 114846F.

name: Bachelor of Accounting
description: The Bachelor of Accounting at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that builds in-depth knowledge of accounting alongside law, economics, finance and statistics, with an emphasis on creative problem solving and building lasting business relationships. It holds triple accreditation with CPA Australia, Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand, and the professional accounting body. Graduates work as accountants and financial advisers across practice, industry and government. Indicative international tuition is around 35,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 087773B.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Medical Science
description: The Bachelor of Advanced Medical Science at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that offers the flexibility of the medical science degree with an added research focus, designed for high-achieving students who want to extend themselves. From second year, students work with internationally recognised researchers on extended individual research experiences. Graduates work in medical research, diagnostics and industry, or continue to graduate-entry health programs and higher research degrees. Indicative international tuition is around 39,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 075674D.

name: Bachelor of Advanced Science
description: The Bachelor of Advanced Science at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree for students who want to be challenged and extended and are considering a career in scientific research. Inquiry-based research is introduced for all science students in first year, and from second year advanced science students work directly with world-renowned researchers on individual research experiences. Graduates work in scientific research, industry and government, or continue to higher research degrees. Indicative international tuition is around 39,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 118443D.

name: Bachelor of Agricultural Science
description:
The Bachelor of Agricultural Science is taught at WSU's historic Hawkesbury campus, home to the university's working farm, biodiverse bushland, and facilities for plant breeding, greenhouse technology, biotechnology and soil research, genuinely hands-on infrastructure that traces back to the site's history as Hawkesbury Agricultural College, one of the oldest agricultural education institutions in Australia. The course takes a multidisciplinary approach that integrates the social, economic and environmental dimensions of agriculture rather than treating it as a purely production-focused science degree.

Students get direct exposure to modern precision-agriculture tools (satellite and drone-derived data, decision-support software) alongside the traditional soil science, plant and animal production fundamentals, reflecting how much the discipline has shifted toward data-driven farm management over the past decade. A work internship for science professionals, providing around 100 hours of placement depending on the student's major, connects coursework to real industry experience.

Graduates typically move into agronomy, farm and land management, agribusiness, biosecurity, or further postgraduate research, with the Hawkesbury campus's genuine working-farm environment being a meaningful point of difference from agricultural science programs taught mostly in a classroom setting.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time
Year 1: Introduction to Agricultural Science, Soil Science, Plant Biology, Animal Science Fundamentals
Year 2: Plant Production Systems, Animal Production Systems, Agricultural Biotechnology, Farm Business Management
Year 3: Precision Agriculture (satellite/drone decision-support tools), Biosecurity, advanced electives, Work Internship for Science Professionals (approx. 100 hours placement)
Facilities: University Farm, greenhouse and biotechnology labs, biodiverse bushland field sites
Capstone: applied agricultural project or research subject in final year
admission_requirements: ATAR 60 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Applied Data Science
description: The Bachelor of Applied Data Science at Western Sydney University is an add-on degree taken concurrently with any Western Sydney University bachelor degree, rather than as a standalone qualification. Students complete their first degree plus an additional 80 credit points of data science study, learning to extract information from digital data. Graduates from many disciplines add data analysis and analytics capability to their primary field. Indicative international tuition is around 40,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 105990F.

name: Bachelor of Architectural Design
description: The Bachelor of Architectural Design at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that relates architectural design directly to the urban transformation of contemporary cities. Students build the technological and intellectual skills to create sustainable, resilient and well-designed environments, from homes and public spaces to landmark buildings. It provides the foundation for the professional Master of Architecture required for registration. Graduates work in architectural practice and continue to postgraduate architecture study. Indicative international tuition is around 40,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 097540C.

name: Bachelor of Arts
description: The Bachelor of Arts at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree with 27 majors across the humanities and social sciences. Students build a study plan around their interests and can take an internship for real-world experience, study abroad for credit, or complete a community service project. Graduates work across media, communications, government, education, community services and business. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 040992A.

name: Bachelor of Business
description:
The Bachelor of Business at Western Sydney University is built around a broad first year of shared foundation subjects before students commit to a major. Accounting, finance, marketing, management, international business, and a few others are typically on offer, with the option to combine two majors within the same degree rather than being locked into one professional identity from day one.

WSU's School of Business runs primarily out of Parramatta City campus, in the heart of what's increasingly called Sydney's "second CBD," and the course leans on that location for placement and internship partnerships with the growing corporate and government presence that's moved into Parramatta over the last decade (several state government departments have relocated headquarters there, along with a number of corporate regional offices).

A work-integrated learning subject is standard in the final year, and accounting-track students need to check their specific subject combination against CPA Australia or CAANZ requirements to ensure it satisfies those professional body pathways, since the degree's flexible major system means not every combination automatically ticks every accreditation box.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time
Year 1: Accounting Principles, Economics for Business, Marketing Principles, Management, Business Statistics
Year 2: Major subjects begin (Accounting / Finance / Marketing / Management / International Business), Business Law
Year 3: Advanced major electives, Work-Integrated Learning subject, capstone strategy subject
Majors (choose one or combine two): Accounting, Finance, Marketing, Management, International Business, Human Resource Management
CPA/CAANZ accreditation pathway available depending on major selection
admission_requirements: ATAR 60 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Business Analytics and AI Management
description: The Bachelor of Business Analytics and AI Management at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that combines applied analytics and artificial intelligence fluency with core business skills. Students learn to integrate data-driven decision making with generative AI and machine learning tools to support organisational performance and digital transformation, working at the intersection of technology and social purpose. Graduates pursue roles in business analytics, AI-enabled operations, consulting and digital strategy. Indicative international tuition is around 35,900 Australian dollars per year.

name: Bachelor of Clinical Science (Medicine) (Exit Only)
description: The Bachelor of Clinical Science (Medicine) at Western Sydney University is a three-year qualification offered as an exit award within the five-year Bachelor of Clinical Science (Medicine) and Doctor of Medicine program, an undergraduate-entry pathway to becoming a medical intern in Australia and New Zealand. The parent program is taught through purpose-built clinical schools with access to research facilities. Graduates use the exit award as a science degree or as credit toward completing the combined program. Indicative international tuition is around 85,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 097592B.

name: Bachelor of Communication
description:
WSU's Bachelor of Communication covers journalism, public relations, and digital/social media as its main specialisation streams, taught with a practical, portfolio-building emphasis rather than a purely theoretical media studies approach. The program's Sydney-wide industry placements pull from both metropolitan mastheads and broadcasters and Western Sydney's own growing local and community media outlets, giving students exposure to a genuinely different regional media landscape alongside the standard capital-city options.

The course includes media law and ethics, writing and content production, and research methods subjects across the early years, before students specialise and undertake a work-integrated learning placement in their final year. WSU has also built out digital content and social media production facilities across its campuses in recent years, reflecting the shift in graduate employment away from traditional broadcast roles toward digital-first content and communications work.

Graduates commonly move into journalism, public relations, corporate and government communications, or digital marketing roles across both Sydney metropolitan employers and organisations based in the growing Western Sydney business corridor.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time
Year 1: Introduction to Communication and Media, Writing for Media, Media Law and Ethics, Media Research Methods
Year 2: stream selection (Journalism / Public Relations / Digital and Social Media), Content Strategy, Media Industries
Year 3: Advanced stream subjects, Work-Integrated Learning placement, capstone portfolio or campaign project
Streams: Journalism, Public Relations, Digital and Social Media
Capstone: industry placement-linked portfolio or campaign project
admission_requirements: ATAR 60 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Computer Science
description:
WSU's Bachelor of Computer Science covers the expected core sequence (programming, data structures, algorithms, systems and databases), with the option to specialise later in areas like software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity or networking. The degree is taught primarily out of the Kingswood and Parramatta campuses, and WSU has invested in growing its cybersecurity and cyber-physical systems research groups over recent years, which flows down into some of the specialisation electives available to undergraduates.

The university draws a large proportion of its student cohort from Greater Western Sydney itself, meaning many computer science students are first-in-family university attendees, and WSU's course design leans on strong first-year academic support (peer mentoring, transition subjects) to account for that rather than assuming a cohort that arrived with strong prior computing exposure.

A final-year capstone or industry project subject gives students a portfolio piece for graduate job applications, and placement partnerships lean on Western Sydney's logistics, health, and government-services employers as much as CBD tech firms.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time
Year 1: Introduction to Programming, Discrete Mathematics, Computer Systems Fundamentals, Web Technologies
Year 2: Data Structures and Algorithms, Database Systems, Software Engineering Principles, Networks
Year 3: Specialisation electives (Artificial Intelligence / Cybersecurity / Software Engineering / Networking), Capstone Project
Capstone: industry or research-based final-year project
Electives available across cross-disciplinary computing subjects
admission_requirements: ATAR 65 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Construction Management (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Construction Management (Honours) at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time degree that prepares graduates to manage building and construction works. It combines theory with practical knowledge of how the construction industry operates, including building technology such as acoustics and heat flow. Graduates work as construction managers, project managers and contract administrators in the building industry. Indicative international tuition is around 40,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 100687G.

name: Bachelor of Construction Management Advanced (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Construction Management Advanced (Honours) at Western Sydney University is an accelerated three-and-a-half-year full-time pathway of the Bachelor of Construction Management (Honours), for high-achieving students. It combines theory with practical knowledge of how the construction industry operates and a research component. Graduates work as construction managers, project managers and contract administrators in the building industry. Indicative international tuition is around 46,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 100687G.

name: Bachelor of Construction Management Studies (exit only)
description: The Bachelor of Construction Management Studies at Western Sydney University is a three-year qualification offered as an exit award within the combined Bachelor of Construction Management Studies and Bachelor of Laws. The construction management component mixes work experience with study, including practical experiments in building technology such as acoustics and heat flow, producing knowledge valued in the construction industry. Graduates use the exit award in construction industry roles or as credit toward the combined degree. Indicative international tuition is around 40,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 108428H.

name: Bachelor of Creative Leadership
description: The Bachelor of Creative Leadership at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time cross-disciplinary degree for students who want to enter the workplace with refined creative and critical thinking skills. It offers a transformative learning experience with internships, student-led projects, and sessions with prominent real-world leaders and industry figures that connect learning to real challenges. Graduates work in creative, leadership and entrepreneurial roles across sectors. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107741G.

name: Bachelor of Criminal and Community Justice
description: The Bachelor of Criminal and Community Justice at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree designed for people working in or entering corrections, probation and parole. Developed in collaboration with Brush Farm, the training academy of Corrective Services NSW, it draws on criminal justice, criminology, psychology and social work. Graduates work in community corrections, offender management and related justice roles. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 083030G.

name: Bachelor of Criminology
description: The Bachelor of Criminology at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree exploring criminology, crime, and criminal justice institutions and practices. Students graduate with an understanding of crime prevention, victimisation, juvenile justice, prisons and punishment, along with the specialist skills to enter the professional workforce. Graduates work in policy, research, community services, corrections and related justice roles. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 079498E.

name: Bachelor of Cyber Security and Behaviour
description: The Bachelor of Cyber Security and Behaviour at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree, described by the university as the only cyber security degree in Australia that analyses both the technical and human side of security. Students learn through hands-on work led by industry experts to keep company, national and individual data secure. Graduates work as security analysts, consultants and in cyber policy and risk roles. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 094541D.

name: Bachelor of Data Science
description: The Bachelor of Data Science at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that equips graduates to convert data into valuable information. Students learn to design experimental studies, build and fit models for analysis, visualisation, estimation and prediction, and apply machine learning. Graduates work as data scientists and analysts across finance, health, government and technology. Indicative international tuition is around 40,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 089203J.

name: Bachelor of Design (Visual Communication)
description: The Bachelor of Design (Visual Communication) at Western Sydney University, now offered as the Bachelor of Design, is a four-year full-time degree grounded in design history and contemporary practice. Students build capabilities in branding, typography, image-making, design thinking, user experience and digital storytelling before specialising in branding and strategy, data and design, or another area. Graduates work as visual communicators, brand and UX designers across industry. Indicative international tuition is around 34,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 00917K.

name: Bachelor of Design and Technology
description: The Bachelor of Design and Technology at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that provides comprehensive knowledge across design areas including product design, packaging, rapid prototyping, 3D modelling and exhibition design, with the flexibility to specialise. It reflects how designers now work across digital experiences and emerging technologies. Graduates work in product, industrial and experience design, and can pursue design teaching with additional study. Indicative international tuition is around 40,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 041034F.

name: Bachelor of Design Studies (exit only)
description: The Bachelor of Design Studies at Western Sydney University is a three-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Design. The parent degree is grounded in design history and contemporary practice, building capabilities in branding, typography, image-making, design thinking, user experience and digital storytelling. Graduates use the exit award in design and communication roles or as credit toward completing the honours degree. Indicative international tuition is around 34,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 00917K.

name: Bachelor of Education (Primary)
description: The Bachelor of Education (Primary) at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time initial teacher education degree with hands-on school experience from the first year. It prepares graduates to teach Kindergarten to Year 6 in government and non-government primary schools in Australia. Graduates are prepared for registration and work as primary school teachers, and for related roles in curriculum and education administration. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 103728C.

name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
description: Western Sydney University Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) is a four-year degree of 320 credit points with majors in advanced manufacturing, civil, construction, electrical, materials, mechanical, robotics and mechatronics, and sustainability engineering. Five majors (civil, construction, electrical, mechanical, and robotics and mechatronics) hold full Engineers Australia accreditation at the professional engineer level at the Penrith and Parramatta campuses, and three (civil, electrical and mechanical) at the Sydney City campuses. Western Sydney also offers an Advanced (Honours) version for high-achieving students. Entry requires English and mathematics at Band 5 or higher, or equivalents. Indicative international tuition is around A$40,900 per year. Graduates work as professional engineers in their chosen field.

name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) - Civil Engineering
description:
WSU's Civil Engineering (Honours) degree is taught out of the Penrith (Kingswood) campus and is accredited at Professional Engineer level with Engineers Australia, covering the standard civil engineering spine (structures, geotechnical, water, transport) with an emphasis on infrastructure that reflects the region's own construction boom. Western Sydney has been the site of enormous infrastructure investment over the past decade (the new international airport, associated road and rail corridors, new housing release areas), and the program's project-based subjects and industry placements draw directly on that pipeline rather than needing to import case studies from elsewhere.

Students complete mandatory industry work experience as part of the accreditation requirements, and the degree's honours component is built into the standard four-year structure rather than requiring an additional year, with the fourth-year engineering project functioning as the capstone research and design piece.

Graduates commonly move into roles with the major infrastructure contractors and state government agencies working on Sydney's western growth areas, which gives the degree a genuinely strong local employment pipeline relative to some engineering programs based further from where the actual construction is happening.
curriculum:
Duration: 4 years full-time
Year 1: Engineering Fundamentals, Mathematics for Engineers, Mechanics, Introduction to Civil Engineering
Year 2: Structural Analysis, Geotechnical Engineering, Fluid Mechanics, Surveying
Year 3: Structural Design, Transport Engineering, Water Engineering, Construction Management
Year 4: Advanced Structural Design, Engineering Project (capstone), Professional Practice, electives
Requirement: mandatory industry work experience placement
Accreditation: Engineers Australia (Professional Engineer level)
admission_requirements: ATAR 70 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Engineering Advanced (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Engineering Advanced (Honours) at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time degree for high-achieving students, built on the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) with an added advanced and research focus. Students address real-world challenges through technical solutions and can specialise in majors such as advanced manufacturing, civil, electrical, mechanical, mechatronic and robotics engineering. Graduates are prepared for professional engineering practice and research. Indicative international tuition is around 40,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 089429B.

name: Bachelor of Engineering Science
description: The Bachelor of Engineering Science at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that prepares engineering technologists, whose focused learning and practical skills are used across industry. It responds to strong demand in the growing Western Sydney region for technologists across a range of engineering specialisations. Graduates work in technical engineering roles or transfer into an accredited Bachelor of Engineering (Honours). Indicative international tuition is around 40,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 074195E.

name: Bachelor of Entrepreneurship (Games Design and Simulation)
Bachelor of Graphic Design (Pathway to Teaching Secondary)
Bachelor of Health and Physical Education
description: The Bachelor of Health and Physical Education at Western Sydney University, now offered as the Bachelor of Health, Physical Education, and Sport, is a three-year full-time degree that brings together the university's former health and physical education and sport degrees. With a strong focus on young people, students build contemporary health knowledge and the confidence to lead informed conversations on emerging health issues. Graduates work as health and physical education teachers and in sport, health promotion and coaching roles. Indicative international tuition is around 34,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 00917K.

name: Bachelor of Health Science
description: The Bachelor of Health Science at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that combines study with hands-on experience. Students major in one or two specialisations across public health, health promotion, health services management, recreational therapy and clinical sciences, with the flexibility to switch majors after first year. Graduates work in health promotion, community health and health services roles, and the degree is a pathway into other health degrees. Indicative international tuition is around 34,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 044779G.

name: Bachelor of Humanitarian and Development Studies
description: The Bachelor of Humanitarian and Development Studies at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree, described by the university as the only degree of its kind in Australia. Developed in consultation with non-government organisations and taught by academics including United Nations and international agency practitioners, it prepares the next generation of humanitarian and development aid workers. Graduates work in humanitarian response, development programs and aid coordination. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 088714E.

name: Bachelor of Industrial Design
description: The Bachelor of Industrial Design (Honours) at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time degree that prepares students for the profession through a student-centred approach, design studio and project-based learning, and applied design research. Graduates create and innovate by adding value to experiences, interactions, products, businesses and systems, working as design entrepreneurs and experts who solve ambiguous problems. Indicative international tuition is around 40,900 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107743E.

name: Bachelor of Information and Communications Technology
description: The Bachelor of Information and Communications Technology at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree accredited by the Australian Computer Society. Students gain skills in a practice-based learning environment with real-world project experience and a solid grounding in ICT theory, meeting business demand to compete and innovate in a fast-changing area. Graduates work as software developers, systems analysts, network specialists and IT consultants. Indicative international tuition is around 38,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 064013K.

name: Bachelor of Information Systems
description: The Bachelor of Information Systems at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that teaches students to plan, develop and integrate applications and information systems within a global business environment. The curriculum combines information technology with its strategic integration into business, covering the exchange of knowledge, goods, services and payments. Graduates work as business analysts, systems analysts and information systems consultants. Indicative international tuition is around 38,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 079492M.

name: Bachelor of Information Systems Advanced
description: The Bachelor of Information Systems Advanced at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree built on the Bachelor of Information Systems with an added advanced and research focus for high-achieving students. Students learn to plan, develop and integrate applications and information systems within a global business environment. Graduates work as business analysts, systems analysts and information systems consultants, or continue to research. Indicative international tuition is around 38,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 079492M.

name: Bachelor of International Studies
description: The Bachelor of International Studies at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree examining the relationships of nations, cultures, languages and systems of government within the international system. Students analyse the historical development of relations among nation states and contemporary issues such as globalisation, transnationalism and migration. Graduates work in government, international organisations, trade, media and community sectors. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 064562C.

name: Bachelor of Laws
description:
Western Sydney University's Bachelor of Laws covers the full Priestley 11 sequence required for admission to legal practice in NSW, taught out of the Parramatta campus where the university's law school sits close to the Parramatta courts precinct, genuinely useful for students who want to sit in on real proceedings as part of their studies rather than relying purely on moot exercises. The school runs a legal clinic where students under supervision provide advice to real clients from the local community, which functions as both a practical skills subject and a piece of access-to-justice work given the significant unmet legal need across Greater Western Sydney.

WSU Law markets itself around social justice and diversity in the profession. A meaningful share of its cohort are the first in their family to study law, and the school has built subjects and support structures (including an Indigenous-focused unit and community legal partnerships) around that reality rather than assuming a cohort of students already embedded in legal or professional family networks.

As with all Australian law degrees, graduates need to complete practical legal training after finishing the academic component before being admitted as a solicitor or barrister.
curriculum:
Duration: 4 years full-time
Core subjects: Foundations of Law, Contracts, Torts, Criminal Law, Property Law, Constitutional Law, Administrative Law, Equity, Evidence, Civil Procedure, Corporations Law
Practical subjects: Legal Clinic (supervised real-client casework), Dispute Resolution
Electives: Family Law, Immigration Law, Native Title and Indigenous Legal Issues, Employment Law
Post-graduation requirement: Practical Legal Training before admission as a legal practitioner
Final year typically combines electives with clinic or advanced practice subjects
admission_requirements: ATAR 80 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Mathematics
description: The Bachelor of Mathematics at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that develops the ability to discover, describe and analyse patterns using abstraction and logic. Students learn to model, analyse and solve problems across sectors from finance and engineering to medicine and politics, taught by academics with research strength in the field. Graduates work in data analysis, finance, research, modelling and teaching. Indicative international tuition is around 38,200 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 103731H.

name: Bachelor of Medical Research
description: The Bachelor of Medical Research at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree for students enrolled in the Doctor of Medicine, taken as a leave of absence after completing the first two years of the MD to gain deeper experience in medical research than the standard program provides. Students undertake a supervised research project. Graduates return to the MD with strengthened research skills and are prepared for clinician-researcher careers. Indicative international tuition is around 37,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 063557G.

name: Bachelor of Medical Science
description:
WSU's Bachelor of Medical Science lets students choose one of three primary majors: Biomedical Science, Anatomy and Physiology, or Human Nutrition. The flexible elective structure means students can add a second major (80 credit points) or minors like Environmental Health, Infectious Diseases, or Microbiology from the university's broader science and health offerings. It's a three-year science degree rather than a clinical or professional program, aimed at students heading toward postgraduate medicine, allied health, research, or laboratory science careers rather than direct clinical registration.

The Biomedical Science major builds an integrated foundation across biochemistry, cell biology, genetics, physiology and anatomy, while Anatomy and Physiology leans specifically into the structural and functional basis of human health and disease. WSU's science teaching draws on strong ties to Western Sydney's public hospital network for research placements and honours pathways, given the university's location across a region served by several major teaching hospitals.

Students completing the degree with strong results commonly progress into a fourth-year Honours program or graduate-entry medicine, dentistry, or other health professional degrees, with the flexible major/minor structure letting students shape their science background toward whichever pathway they're aiming for.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time (6 years part-time)
Core subjects: Human Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Physiology, Research Methods in Science
Major (choose one): Biomedical Science / Anatomy and Physiology / Human Nutrition
Electives: second major (80cp) or minors (40cp each) — Environmental Health, Infectious Diseases, Microbiology available
Final year: advanced major subjects, independent research or laboratory-based project subject
Pathway options after completion: Honours year, graduate-entry medicine/dentistry, allied health postgraduate study
admission_requirements: ATAR 75 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Music
description: The Bachelor of Music at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that takes an eclectic, modern and inclusive approach to repertoire, performance, sound design, songwriting, composition and musicology. It offers high-level training in music performance, composition, sound technologies, theory, arranging and music production. Graduates work as performers, composers, sound designers, music educators and in the wider music industry. Indicative international tuition is around 34,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 065052F.

name: Bachelor of Nursing
description:
WSU's Bachelor of Nursing is a 240-credit-point degree made up of 24 nursing subjects, with a minimum of 800 clinical placement hours (excluding public holidays) required across the three years to meet AHPRA registration requirements. Skills and knowledge are built first in on-campus simulated clinical settings before being consolidated in real placements across hospitals, aged care facilities, general practice, and community health teams. It's a staged model rather than throwing students into full clinical settings from day one.

Given Western Sydney's rapidly growing population and its multiple major public hospitals (Westmead among them being one of the largest hospital precincts in the state), students get placement exposure to a genuinely high-acuity, high-volume health system, and the university's nursing program has consistently ranked well nationally partly on the strength of those clinical partnerships.

An Enrolled Nurse pathway variant exists for students who already hold EN qualifications, letting them complete the degree on a accelerated timeline with credit for prior clinical experience, which is a meaningfully different cohort experience from the standard-entry three-year structure.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time, 240 credit points, 24 nursing subjects
Year 1: Foundations of Nursing Practice, Anatomy and Physiology, Health Assessment, on-campus simulated clinical practice
Year 2: Adult Health Nursing, Mental Health Nursing, Pharmacology, Child and Family Health, clinical placement blocks begin
Year 3: Complex Care Nursing, Aged Care, Primary Health Care, Professional Practice Experience, final placement block
Total clinical placement: minimum 800 hours across hospitals, aged care facilities, GP practices, community health teams
Alternate pathway: Enrolled Nurse entry with accelerated/credit-bearing structure
admission_requirements: ATAR 65 or equivalent, National Police Check and Working with Children Check required
english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 (no band below 7.0)

name: Bachelor of Occupational Therapy
description: The Bachelor of Occupational Therapy at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time accredited degree that prepares graduates to find solutions to movement difficulties and environmental barriers so people can participate fully in work, play and life. The first two years combine occupational therapy study with biomedicine and health sciences, followed by discipline-specific study and clinical placements. Graduates are eligible for registration and work as occupational therapists across health, disability and community settings. Indicative international tuition is around 37,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 086212K.

name: Bachelor of Paramedicine
description: The Bachelor of Paramedicine at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that prepares graduates to work as paramedics responding to emergencies across diverse settings. It has a strong evidence-based focus and uses blended learning and assessment. Graduates are prepared to work in ambulance services, the private paramedical industry and the defence forces. Indicative international tuition is around 42,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107742F.

name: Bachelor of Physiotherapy
description: The Bachelor of Physiotherapy at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time degree focused on the relationship between therapist and client. Students gain a thorough understanding of the technical aspects of physiotherapy alongside the capacity to work with colleagues and patients, taught with a strong evidence-based approach to health sciences. Graduates are eligible for registration and work as physiotherapists across hospital, community, sports and private practice settings. Indicative international tuition is around 37,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 101790K.

name: Bachelor of Podiatric Medicine (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Podiatric Medicine (Honours) at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time degree in which students treat foot problems and play a growing role in managing chronic conditions such as diabetes, with patients ranging from children to athletes to older adults. Graduates complete extensive clinical practice experience and are accredited by the Podiatry Board of Australia, and an honours pathway is available to high-achieving students. Graduates work as registered podiatrists. Indicative international tuition is around 37,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 101793G.

name: Bachelor of Policing
description: The Bachelor of Policing at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree, described by the university as the only policing degree in metropolitan Sydney. Students gain skills for careers in policing, criminal and community justice, corrective services, border protection, intelligence, security, fraud management and forensics, with access to a crime scene investigation facility. Graduates work across policing and the wider justice and security sector. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 044801C.

name: Bachelor of Psychological and Social Sciences
description: The Bachelor of Psychological and Social Sciences at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that gives students a thorough scientific understanding of psychology alongside social sciences study. It builds skills fundamental to the theory and practice of psychology, replacing assumptions and popular myths with evidence-based approaches, and is a foundation for further psychology and behavioural study. Graduates work in human services, research, human resources and community roles. Indicative international tuition is around 37,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107229A.

name: Bachelor of Psychological Science (Honours)
description:
The Bachelor of Psychological Science (Honours) at WSU is an APAC-accredited four-year sequence that folds the honours research year into the standard degree, meaning students don't need to apply separately or complete an additional bolt-on year to get the accredited honours qualification required to continue toward psychologist registration. The final year centres on an independent research thesis, supervised individually, alongside advanced coursework in psychological assessment, ethics, and professional issues.

WSU's psychology research strength includes work in areas like mental health, addiction, and Indigenous psychology, and honours students often end up attached to active faculty research programs for their thesis rather than working in isolation, which gives some students a pathway into PhD study or research assistant roles straight after graduation.

As with all APAC-accredited honours degrees in Australia, completion is the first of several steps toward registration as a psychologist: graduates still need to complete further supervised practice or postgraduate training (a Master's or the 4+2 internship pathway) before they can register and practise independently.
curriculum:
Duration: 4 years full-time (Honours embedded)
Year 1: Introduction to Psychology, Research Methods 1, Biological Psychology, Social Psychology
Year 2: Cognitive Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Psychological Assessment, Research Methods 2
Year 3: Abnormal Psychology, Personality and Individual Differences, advanced electives, research preparation
Year 4 (Honours): Advanced Research Methods, Professional and Ethical Issues in Psychology, Honours Thesis (independent supervised research)
APAC-accredited; graduates proceed to further supervised practice or postgraduate training for registration
admission_requirements: ATAR 70 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Psychological Studies (exit only)
description: The Bachelor of Psychological Studies at Western Sydney University is a three-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Psychological Science (Honours). The parent degree combines biological, cognitive, neurological, social, developmental and personality theory with statistical expertise and practical experience, with access to specialist facilities and local and international placements. Graduates use the exit award in human services and research roles or as credit toward the honours degree. Indicative international tuition is around 37,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 107232F.

name: Bachelor of Psychology
description: The Bachelor of Psychology (Honours) at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time accredited degree for students who want to understand how the mind works and why people behave as they do. It combines scientific study of individual abilities, attitudes, personality and emotional states with research training and practical experience. Graduates are positioned to progress toward registration as psychologists or to work in research, human services and related fields. Indicative international tuition is around 37,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 106080C.

name: Bachelor of Research Studies [exit only]
description: The Bachelor of Research Studies at Western Sydney University is a one-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Master of Research, which combines advanced research training with an independent research project across disciplines spanning arts, business, education, health, science and technology. Graduates use the exit award as recognition of research training or as credit toward completing the masters. Indicative international tuition is around 36,600 Australian dollars per year.

name: Bachelor of Science
description: The Bachelor of Science at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that develops the skills to investigate scientific disciplines from astronomy to zoology. Students gain confidence through lab and field work, use specialist teaching labs, and have opportunities to take part in research. Graduates work across scientific research, industry, government and education. Indicative international tuition is around 39,600 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 041144M.

name: Bachelor of Screen Media (Arts and Production)
description: The Bachelor of Screen Media (Arts and Production) at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that immerses students in art design, photography studios and media facilities. Students learn to write, produce, direct and edit original content and build a portfolio through real community and industry projects. Graduates work in screen production, post-production, photography and content roles. Indicative international tuition is around 34,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 089386G.

name: Bachelor of Social Science
description: The Bachelor of Social Science at Western Sydney University is a three-year full-time degree that expands knowledge through theory, research and practical application, offering a deep understanding of a complex, culturally diverse world. Students access industry projects and placements, including overseas placements in countries such as Nepal, India, Indonesia and Fiji, and choose their own majors and minors. Graduates work in community services, policy, research and government. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 041159D.

name: Bachelor of Social Work
description: The Bachelor of Social Work at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time degree that develops the skills to nurture people's self-reliance and problem-solving abilities and to make a difference for individuals, families, groups and communities. It combines research and theory with practical field education. Graduates are eligible for professional recognition and work as social workers across community, health, child protection and policy settings. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 013975D.

name: Bachelor of Speech Pathology
description: The Bachelor of Speech Pathology at Western Sydney University is a four-year full-time degree in which students learn to assess and treat disorders of communication and swallowing in children and adults. The first two years combine evidence-based speech pathology study with biomedical and health science, linguistics and psychology to build professional competencies, followed by clinical practice. Graduates are eligible for registration and work as speech pathologists across health, education and disability settings. Indicative international tuition is around 37,800 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 100189M.

name: Bachelor of Teaching/Bachelor of Education (Primary)
description:
WSU's combined Bachelor of Teaching/Bachelor of Education (Primary) is a 320-credit-point program built around embedding professional experience from the very first year rather than saving classroom placements for later in the course. Students are in schools observing and assisting well before they're leading lessons themselves.
